m920094.……嘘です。\nあなたは堕天使……悪魔です。\n私をたぶらかし、地獄に引きずり込: …That's a lie. You're a fallen angel… a demon. You're trying to tempt me and drag me into hell.
m920094.……天使長！！\nなぜ分からないのですか……？\n本当はもう気が付いているはずで: …Angel-Leader!! Why can't you see? Deep down you already know…!
m920094.……年貢の納め時ってやつかしらね。\nそうね、長い話になりそうだし\nどこか落ち:
…I guess it's the time for tribute payments.
Yeah, it'd be a long story, so why don't we move somewhere quieter to talk?
m920094.……是非も無い。\n王子、どうやら貴様と協力せねばならぬようだな。: …There's no choice. Prince, it seems we must cooperate.
m920094.……無力感、かぁ。\nデシウスもこんな気持ちを感じたのかもしれないわね。\nそし: …Feeling powerless, huh. Decius probably felt the same way, and maybe that's why he began craving power relentlessly.
m920094.……王子、ごめんなさい……。\n酒呑童子は力を取り戻してしまったわ……。\n私で: “…Prince, I'm sorry… Wine Cellar Boy has regained his power… I couldn't possibly match him… Ouch…!”
m920094.……王子たちには、\n闇ギルドの構成員に間違われて\n一緒くたにやられちゃったの: …but the princes mistook me for a guild member and wiped me out along with everyone else.
m920094.……王子は、そんな道は選ばないと信じてる。\n王子の戦いと選択をずっと見てきたか:
...I believe the Prince would never choose such a road.
I've watched his battles and choices all this time, so I know.
m920094.……王都脱出で「過去の」部下を守れた事？\nあ、時の魔女であるココロちゃんの頼み: …Protecting the “past” subordinates during the capital escape? Oh, the one where you time-traveled at Kokoro-chan's request, the witch of time.
m920094.……結局、そんな必要もなかったわね。\nただわたしが痛い思いをしただけで終わっち: …In the end, it turned out I didn't need to do any of that. It just ended with me getting hurt.
m920094.……良かった、合流できました！\nクレイブさん、大丈夫ですか！？: ……Good, we've linked up! Kreve, are you alright!?
m920094.……行っちゃったね、アンナさん。\nデーモンはまた時空の門を使って過去へと\n跳: ……She's gone, Anna. The demon used a time-gate to jump back to the past again. We have to hurry…….
m920094.……貴方には、迷いがないのですね。\n己の信念に裏打ちされた瞳が、ただ美しい\n: …You have no doubt, do you? Your eyes, backed by conviction, are simply beautiful… I too want to be beautiful… to be righteous…
m920094.……酒呑童子様！\nぬらりひょんを倒した王子という人間が\nこちらに向かって来て: Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: “…Lord Wine Cellar Boy! The Prince who defeated Nurarihyon is heading this way!”
m920094.……首だけで生きる上、首無しの体が暴れまわるなんて、\n酒呑童子は本当に化け物ね: …Living only as a head while a headless body runs amok—Shuten-douji is truly a monster. Seeing that up close was honestly shocking.
m920094.「勝てばオレの『大部族長』への道が開ける。\n負ければ其方の領内から引き上げる。: If we win, my path to becoming the Great Tribal Leader opens. Lose, and I'll pull back from your lands. Let's see who's strongest—how about a duel?
m920094.「勝手だが、これはオレが大部族長になる試練でもある。\n魔物が領内に滞在している:
“It's up to you, but this is also my trial to become that great tribal leader.
If monsters are rumored to linger in our lands, you'll lose face as well.”
m920094.「王子よ、其方の度重なる武勇は聞いている。\n魔界でも名を轟かせている王子軍を打:
“Prince, I've heard of your countless feats of bravery.
If you've already defeated the Prince's army that made a name for itself even in the demon realm,
then I shall become the chief of chiefs, the great tribal leader.”
m920094.『妖怪猫娘よ。決起の時は来たれり。\nあまねく妖怪の力を結集し、再び千鬼夜行を巻: “Yōkai cat-girl, the time of uprising has arrived. Gather all yōkai power and once again unleash the Thousand-Demon Night March. Meet me on the next full moon, in the eastern lands.”
m920094.『生死は問わぬ』とね。\n我が主ながら実にユーモアがある。\n不死者に生死を問わ: “Life and death matter not,” he said. My master does have a sense of humor. To claim that the undead are beyond life and death… heh.
m920094.『追伸\n こたびの夜行には復活を果たした鬼の大将\n 酒呑童子も加われり』: “P.S. This night march also includes the resurrected demon general, Shuten-Dōji.”
m920094.あ、あなたが王子？ 敵の本隊が来るよ！\nこの義賊サヨ……じゃなくて、\nえっと: Ah, you're the Prince? The enemy's main force is coming! This rogue Sayo… no, uh, I'll fight too…!
m920094.あ、でも次は華の国の戦いの話をさせてね。\n昔から順番に記憶を思い出してるから。: Oh, but next I'll tell you about the battle in the Land of Flowers. I've been recalling the memories in order ever since.
m920094.あぁ、そうさせて貰えると助かる。\n……あとはこの道を真っすぐだ。\nどうか、皇:
Ah, that'd be a big help.
...Just go straight down this path.
Please, we're counting on you to take down the Emperor!
m920094.あいたたた……。\nムチャしすぎたわね……。\n鎧が無ければ危なかったわ。: Ouch… I went too far… If I hadn't had armor, that would've been dangerous.
m920094.あそこでわたしに出来たのは結局そのくらい。あの時\n王子達がエーリカさんを見つけ:
That's about all I could do back there. I'm truly grateful the Prince and the others found Erica.
Thanks for saving her, Prince.
m920094.あなたの戦いを見てきた思い出話もこれで最後。\nわたしの話にここまで付き合ってく:
This is the last memory story I've shared about watching your battle.
Thanks for staying with my tale this far.
m920094.あなた達ッ！！ 生きてたのね！？\nもうっ！ どれだけ心配させるのよ！\n少しだ: You there!! You're still alive!? Oh, come on! How many times must you worry me! I was a little lonely, you know?
m920094.あのまま戦場に倒れていたら、カボチャ達と一緒に\n魂を捧げられてたかも。倒れてる: If she'd just collapsed on the battlefield, she might've been sacrificed along with the pumpkins. Carrying a fallen Erica out of the battlefield was a huge hassle.
m920094.あの姿……魔王を見間違えるはずがありません……。\nですが、未だ魔王は完全体では: I can't be mistaking that form for the Demon King… But he isn't in his full form yet. If we act now, we might still be able to push him back!
m920094.あの巨大なハエのような魔物は\nベルゼビュートの眷属ですね。: That huge fly-like monster is a minion of Belzebuth.
m920094.あの戦いの後、妖虎仙は倒れた。\nけれど、また新たな敵も現れて、\n仙人と邪仙に: After that battle, Youkosen fell. But new foes have appeared, and the war between the sage and the evil sage remains chaotic.
m920094.あの戦いは、オークに捕まったソーマさんが、\nオークからの言付けを\n預かってき: That battle began when Soma was captured by the orcs and brought back a message from their leader.
m920094.あの敵の周囲は病原菌で重度に汚染され、\n抗体を服用していても体力を奪われます。: The area around it is heavily contaminated with pathogens— even if you're taking antibodies, it'll drain your health. Let's meet it with a formation that won't hinder our recovery.
m920094.あの日……復活した魔物が王城に押し寄せた日、\nわたしは王城にいたの。そして、\: That day… when the revived monsters swarmed the castle, I was there. And I learned about you fleeing the capital.
m920094.あの日から、ずっとあなた達の戦いを間近で見てきたわ。\nあなた達が戦ってきた魔物: Since then, I've been watching your battles up close. I've even hidden among the monsters you fought… Heh, you never noticed, did you?
m920094.あの時、わたしは暗黒騎士に変装……と言うか、\n一体を言いくるめて中に入ってただ:
Back then, I disguised myself as a Dark Knight—well, more like I fooled a certain creature and slipped inside.
I even heard Decius's thoughts.
m920094.あの時は、いざとなれば王子だけでも助けようと、\nデーモンに変装していたんだけど: Back then, I even disguised myself as a demon, ready to save the Prince if needed…
m920094.あの時は、空を飛ぶファーに気を取られて、\n地上からあなたを尾行する\nわたしの: Back then, I was so distracted by the flying Far that you didn't notice my disguise trailing you from the ground.
m920094.あの時は魔物退治の遠征中に妖虎仙の娘、\nメイリンに奇襲された事から、\n妖虎仙: Back then, during a monster-clearing expedition, I was ambushed by Youkosen's daughter Meiling, which sent us marching toward Youkosen's Flower Kingdom.
m920094.あの時わたしはアークデーモンに化けていたの。\n聖霊の祝福を受けた王子たちには\:
Back then I was disguised as the Arch Demon.
The princes blessed by the spirits got taken down together with the demon…
m920094.あの混戦じゃなかったら、\n流石にバレていたかもしれないわね。\n……気付かれず: If it hadn't been that chaotic, I probably would have been found out. ...I'm glad I managed to stay hidden.
m920094.あら、博士。王子軍を殺す支度はできたのかしらぁ？: Ah, Doctor. Have you prepared to kill the Prince's forces?
m920094.ありがとうございます。魔物に立ち向かおうとした\n前ギルド長の恩義に報いるために: Thank you. In order to repay the former guild leader's kindness for standing up to the monsters, we can't ignore what the current Dark Guild is doing.
m920094.あれだけの数のゴブリン軍団に加えて、\n騎獣戦車まで倒しちゃうんだから、\n王子: Defeating that massive goblin legion—and even the beast-mounted tank—shows just how incredible the Prince's forces truly are.
m920094.あれだけ賑やかだったのが、嘘のようですね。\n……少し、寂しい気もします。: It feels surreal that the place was so lively just a moment ago… It's a little lonely now.
m920094.あれは……そんなまさか、\n魔王を召喚したというの！？\n魔王は、アイギス姉様が: That… could it be? You've summoned the Demon King!? He was sealed by Aegis… yet…
m920094.あんな面倒な術は魔導書を見なければ使えないわ。\nゴブリン軍の強化の為に、また新: That troublesome spell can't be used without the spellbook. We'll have to devise a new method to strengthen the goblin army.
m920094.いいタイミングじゃない。ほら、そこのゴブリンも、\n何をコソコソとワタシの魔導書: Perfect timing. Hey, you goblin over there, what are you sneaking around my spellbook for? Deploy quickly… or I'll have you executed!
m920094.いざという時は、最後の手段を使うしかないカボね。\n王子の魂がなくとも、カボチャ:
When push comes to shove, we'll have to use the last resort, Kabo.
Even without the Prince's soul, if we sacrifice two Pumpkin Monster souls,
we should be able to summon Lord Bifrons' spirit form, Kabo.
m920094.いたた……。王子たち、先に行ったみたいね。\n王子たちが『悪霊の迷宮』に向かうっ: Ouch… The princes went ahead, huh. I was waiting for them to head to the Maze of Evil Spirits, and then… who would have thought the Demon King would revive.
m920094.いや、失礼。\nさすがは伝説の英雄の子孫！ 実に健気だ！\nいいだろう、英雄らし: My apologies. As befits the descendant of a legendary hero, you're truly admirable! Very well, die with a sword in hand, just like a true hero!
m920094.いや、良いのだ……我らリビングアーマーは死を迎え、\n怨念だけが鎧に宿った魔物。: No, it's fine… We, the living armor, are meeting death; only the grudges remain lodged in the armor, a monster. It's just the proper death…
m920094.う、ぐぁぁあッ……。\nそんな……ばか……な…………。\n完璧な計画……だった…: Ugh… gaaaah… This… foolish… plan… was… perfect…
m920094.うぅーッ！！ 今はとにかく\n魔獣たちを無力化して元の平和な森に戻すしかないぞ！: Ugh!! Right now, we have no choice but to neutralize the beasts and restore the forest to its peaceful state!
m920094.うるさいな。このじいさんをぶっ倒した後に\n相手してやるよ。\nさあ、じいさん、: ???: Shut up, after I knock this old man down I'll deal with you. Come on, old man, over here!
m920094.うるっさーーーーーいッ！\n過去を変えてはいけない、それが辛く悲しい過去でも。\: Shut up!!! We mustn't change the past, no matter how painful or sad it was. That's what… my master always said…
m920094.うッ、ぁ……ぁぁ……。もう……いや、だ……。\nやめてくれ……。\nもう、われに: Ugh… ah… no… stop… please… I have no power left…
m920094.うム、なんとか予算の範囲内に収まったナ。\n今回はクイーン様の唐突な提案もなク、: Umm, we managed to stay within budget. Thanks to the Queen's sudden proposal, we might even have some extra funds.
m920094.え、エリアス！？\nなぜ帝国の治癒士がこんな場所に……？\nまさか……白の帝国の:
Eh, Elias!?
Why is the Empire's healer here…?
Could it be… reinforcements from the White Empire have arrived!?
m920094.えっと、その……あたしも、\n王子様たちと協力した方が良いと思います……。: Um… I think it'd be best if I also teamed up with the Prince…
m920094.お、おい……皇帝に寄り添ってる魔物達を見ろよ……。\nゴブリンクイーンだぞ……そ: Hey… look at those monsters swarming the Emperor… Goblin queens, and even the queen ant… They've teamed up to make the Emperor their slave.
m920094.お、おいっ！ デシウスのヤツ、鎧を召喚して……！\n一人であの軍勢に挑むなんて無: Hey! Decius is summoning armor…! Challenging that army alone is reckless! …Prince?!
m920094.おいっ！！ 馬鹿野郎ッ！！\n俺の首も持って行かんかァッ！\nこちとら今は身体が: Hey!! You idiot!! Don't take my head with you! I don't even have a body right now—understand that!
m920094.おう王子、怪しい奴がいたんで、とっ捕まえておいたぜ。\nゴブリンに変装して、店の: Hey Prince, we caught a shady one. He was disguised as a goblin, trying to steal food from the market.
m920094.おや、愚昧とは言え、女神の加護を受けし男が\n暗黒騎士と肩を並べるとは、面白い取: Well, it's amusing—though you're foolish, a man blessed by the goddess standing shoulder to shoulder with a Dark Knight. If we destroy together, it'll be most convenient. Then, meet your death.
m920094.お前がここに封印されていた魔物か。\nうーむ、想像と少し違うな……。\n何者だ名: So you're the monster sealed here, huh? Hmm, not quite what I imagined… Who are you? State your name!
m920094.お前らァ……絶対に許さんぞぉぉぉぉッ……！！: You all… I'll never forgive you!!!
m920094.お力が戻られた様で何よりです、酒呑童子様。\n「鬼切」の娘が切り込んできた時は驚: Shunrai Four Heavenly Kings: “It seems your strength has returned, Lord Wine Cellar Boy. We were shocked when the ‘Oni-giri' girl charged, but now you're no more than a mosquito to us.”
m920094.お待たせして、本当にすみませんでした。\n既に、後陣の準備は完了しています。:
I'm truly sorry to have kept you waiting.
The rear camp is already prepared.
m920094.く……英雄の末裔め……。\n力を失ったアイギスの加護ごとき、\n取るに足らないと: H… descendant of heroes… I thought the lost Aegis blessing was nothing… but…
m920094.くそっ……。\n魔物どもめ……、一体どれだけ倒せば……！\n王子、ここは私達が引: Damn… these monsters… how many must we slay…! Prince, we'll keep holding the line!
m920094.くそっ……。ケラウノスのやつめ、\n魔物を召喚し始めている……！ 我輩の祖国にし: Damn it… Keraunos is already summoning monsters…! It's the same fate I brought upon my own homeland…! Damn you…!
m920094.くちおしや……。くちおしや……。\n妖怪の総大将たるわしが……。\n鬼なんぞに…:
...you speak... you speak...
As the Grand General of the Yokai...
To think I'd be betrayed by a demon...
m920094.くっ……リンゴ飴に気を取られた挙句、\n捕まっちゃうなんて……。\nこの義賊サヨ: Damn… I got distracted by a candied apple and ended up caught… This Robin Hood Sayo has made a lifelong blunder!
m920094.くっ、我が時代の王子たちか……！\n手下共よッ、奴等の相手などするな！\n狙うべ: Damn, the princes of my era…! Minions, don't bother with them! Target only one: the kid Prince of this age—go!
m920094.くっくっくっ……。\n首を落とした程度で、\n俺を殺したつもりかぁぁぁッ！？: Heh heh heh… You think cutting off my head will kill me!?
m920094.ぐっ……鬼の奴らは何をしておるんじゃ？\nこれ以上はさすがのわしも……！:
Guh... what are those demons doing?
I can't go on any further!
m920094.こうして、オークの軍勢を魔界に退けて。\n次の戦いは妖怪総大将、ぬらりひょんとの: With the Orc army driven back to the Demon Realm, the next showdown is with the Grand General of Yokai, Nurarihyon.
m920094.こうやって、立場が違う相手でも、\n少しずつ分かり合えていければ良いよね。: If we can keep understanding each other, even with different positions, that'd be great.
m920094.ここは……まさか、王都……？\n魔物が城に攻め込んできた、\nあの時に戻ってきた: This… could this be the capital…? Monsters are storming the castle; we've returned to that moment…
m920094.ここは魔術の力の出番のようですな。\n魔法使いや魔法剣士の攻撃を集中し、\n動き: It looks like it's time for some magical firepower. Let's focus the mages' and magic-swordsmen's attacks and cripple it before it even gets moving.
m920094.このリンゴ飴、可愛いし美味しい……\n……これをあのモーティマさんが作ってるって: These candied apples are cute and delicious… And to think Mortimer made them—that's quite the contrast.
m920094.このリンゴ飴がなければ、\nこうして王子と話す事もなかったのよね。\n不覚だった: If it weren't for these candied apples, we'd never have gotten a chance to talk like this. It was a slip on my part, but maybe it turned out for the best.
m920094.この戦いの途中から、もしかして、と思ってたわ。\n天使兵団との戦いの時、天使の中: I've been wondering since the middle of this battle—maybe it was during the fight with the Angel Legion, when you infiltrated the angels? I learned a few things then.
m920094.この戦いの道中で、ケラウノスと戦う前から、\nデシウスがケラウノスに対して仇のよ: Even before we faced Keraunos, Decius was already speaking of him as if he were a sworn enemy. Seeing Decius's obsession made me realize that the gods are the true foes.
m920094.この時、わたしなんかが力を貸そうとしなくても、\n王子は大丈夫なんだな、\nって: At that moment I thought, even if I didn't lend a hand, the Prince would be okay… and I felt a little lonely.
m920094.この闇の聖霊はすでにワシのものなのだ。\n離すわけないだろう。:
This Dark Holy Spirit is already mine.
There's no way I'd let her go.
m920094.この頃から、王子は悪い人じゃない、一緒に\n魔物を倒さないといけないんだって感じ: Since then I've felt the Prince isn't a bad person; we have to fight monsters together…
m920094.これで一段落……？ \nううん、遠くから行軍の土煙。ここに向かって、\nこれまで: That should wrap things up…? No, I see dust from a distant march. More troops than ever are heading this way…!
m920094.これまでの、戦いの記憶に。: Let's revisit the memories of the battles we've fought.
m920094.こんな時に！ 王子、まずは魔物を倒しましょう。\n雲に乗った魔物も戻ってくるかも: At a time like this, Prince, let's take them down first. The cloud-riding monster might come back, so please consider the airborne foes in your strategy.
m920094.ごめんなさい、そして……ありがとうございます。\n王子が再起するためには、皆さん: I'm sorry, and…… thank you. For the Prince to rise again, we need everyone's strength. For now, let's focus on surviving!
m920094.ご心配には及びませン。あの様な魔術などなくとも、\nゴブリンクイーン様には私の頭: No need to worry. Even without such magic, Goblin Queen, I have my intellect. All you need to do is give me orders.
m920094.さぁ、次は魔法都市での戦いの話をさせてちょうだい！: Now then, let me tell you about the battle in the Magic City!
m920094.さて、それじゃこの辺りで一度休憩にしましょうか。\n長話に付き合ってくれてありが: Well then, let's take a break for now. Thanks for listening to my long story… although there's still a lot more to tell.
m920094.さて、全部の戦いを振り返るのは時間が足りないから、\n印象深い戦いに絞って話すわ:
Well, we don't have time to review every battle, so I'll focus on the ones that left a mark.
One of those is the fight over the Dark Holy Spirit.
m920094.さて、次の戦いの話ね。次の出来事と言えば……、\nあのぬらりひょんの娘、シノさん: Now, about the next battle. The next event… that daughter of Nurarhyon, Shino, came to visit the Prince.
m920094.さて、汚らわしい人間共の相手は、\n我が僕に任せるとしましょう。さぁ姿を現しなさ: Now, let my filthy human foes be dealt with by my servant. Show yourself… My loyal darkness embodied—Demon King!
m920094.し、しかし……神の命じられたことです……。\n私がそれに背くなど……主は、間違わ: B-But it's what God commanded... I can't defy it... The Master never makes a mistake... He shouldn't be wrong... yet...
m920094.せ、政務官殿！？ それに王子まで……？\nどうしてここにおられるのですか？\n王: M-Madam Minister! And the Prince too…? Why are you here? Weren't you supposed to have escaped the capital?
m920094.そ、そんなバカなぁぁぁぁ……！\nワ……ワシが、人間ごとき……に……！！\nく…:
N-no, this can't be…!
I… I, a mere human…!
It's… so… frustrating…!
m920094.そうして、これまでの王子の戦いをずっと見てきたの。\nあなたが本当に英雄の末裔に: All this time I've observed the Prince's fights, judging whether you truly deserve to be called a hero's descendant.
m920094.そうだ、一度、わたしの方から王子に聞いていい？\n王子の印象に残っている戦いを教: Right, may I ask you something, Prince? Tell me a battle that left an impression on you. There must be many, just pick one.
m920094.そうです。ちょっとお待ちください。\nあなたは何者ですか。: That's right. Please hold on a moment. Who are you?
m920094.そうですよ、エリアスさん。\nベルゼビュートに困ってる国同士、協力しましょう。: That's right, Elias. Nations troubled by Belzebuth should work together.
m920094.そうね。団長が今のデシウスに変わった後も、\n暗黒騎士団とその団長は彼らなりの考: Right. Even after the commander became Decius, the Dark Knight Order and its leader fought according to their own convictions.
m920094.そう言えば、長い封印で名前も覚えていなかった彼女に\n『ファー』って名付けたのは: Speaking of which, wasn't it you who gave her the name “Far” since we'd forgotten her real one after the long seal?
m920094.そして、お互いの道を譲れないなら……、\n戦うことだってある。: And if neither of you will yield… then fighting becomes inevitable.
m920094.そして、この戦いの後も、妖怪軍団拡大を図る\nぬらりひょんとは何度か戦う事になる: And after this battle, we'll have to face Nurarihyon again as he keeps expanding his yokai army…
m920094.そしてレーゼルさんもこの後、帝国猟兵ではなく\n一個人としての協力を約束してくれ: And after this, Rösel promised to cooperate not as an Imperial hunter but as an individual. Your actions moved Rösel's heart.
m920094.その上、鎧が溶けてしまう程の凄まじい炎熱を\nまとっており、近づくだけでダメージ: Moreover, it's surrounded by scorching heat intense enough to melt armor, so just getting close will damage you.
m920094.その姿は、アダマス様……なのか！？: That figure… is it you, Adamas…!?
m920094.その怪我で戦線で立つのは難しいでしょう。\n案内は安全な所までで大丈夫です、\n:
With those wounds, you won't be able to stay on the front lines.
Just get to a safe spot; you can receive treatment at the rear.
Please hurry.
m920094.その通りです。ですから皇帝にして帝国最強の兵である\n陛下が出陣されたのですが…: Exactly. That's why the Emperor himself, the empire's strongest soldier, led the charge… Wait, that statue—! No way!
m920094.それから、さらに過去へと移動したクロノデーモンを追って\n王子たちも過去に移動し: After that, we chased the Chrono Demon further back in time, and the Prince and his companions also traveled to the past—back to when the Prince was still a child.
m920094.それから、堕天したミルノさんを守るために、\n彼女を断罪に来た大天使長と戦って…: Then, to protect the fallen Miruno, you fought the Archangel General who came to condemn her… Wait, wasn't the Archangel General absent when you fought Miruno?
m920094.それじゃ、わたしは影に戻るわ。\nでもいつでも傍にいるって事はわすれないでね。\:
Then I'll slip back into the shadows.
But don't ever forget that I'm always by your side.
...Ah, someone's coming. Well, see you later!
m920094.それに、ベルゼビュートの眷属が直接、\n白の皇帝を襲撃した事もあるみたいなの。: It also seems that one of Belzebuth's minions directly assaulted the White Emperor.
m920094.それに、王子達について過去に戻ったわたしは\nデーモンに変装して王子達を見ていた: And after I went back in time, I disguised myself as a demon to watch the Prince.
m920094.そんな……どうして、この様な仕打ちを……。\nどうか目をお覚まし下さい、姉様……: No… why… such a fate… Please, awaken, sister… It's not too late yet… we can still…
m920094.たとえ神に背いて堕天する事になってでも、\n人を守る道を選んでくれた堕天使のみん: Even if it means betraying God and becoming a fallen angel, they chose the path of protecting humanity. Angel-leader Miruno was one of them.
m920094.だいぶ長く思い出話に浸っちゃったわね。\n少し疲れて来たんじゃない？\n次の話で: We've been reminiscing for a long time. Feeling a bit tired, aren't we? Let's take a break before the next story.
m920094.だから、この国はどうなのだろうと、\nある日わたしは王城に忍び込んだの。: So I wondered about this kingdom, and one day I snuck into the royal castle.
m920094.だから、陰から王子を支えようと思って、\n王子たちを追いかけるようになって……そ: So I decided to support the Prince from the shadows, started following the princes… and then I fought the demon commander, Wine Cellar Boy, again.
m920094.だから王子、天使たちが人間を襲う前に、\nここで食い止めよう。: So, Prince, let's stop them here before the angels can strike humans.
m920094.だけど、彼は、そんな部下を自分の力の糧とした。\n何が彼をそうさせたのか……。\: But he used those very subordinates as fuel for his own power. What drove him to that… I couldn't figure that out.
m920094.だって、結論を出すにはまだ早すぎるでしょ。\nあなたが辿ってきた道はまだまだ途中: Because it's far too early to draw any conclusions. Your journey is still far from over.
m920094.ち、ちょっと、王子！\n国同士の大事な取り決めです！\n相槌だけじゃダメですよっ: W-wait, Prince! This is an important diplomatic agreement between nations! Just nodding isn't enough!
m920094.ちなみにわたしはデーモンに変装して、\n王子の戦いを見届けてたのよ。\n熱い戦い: By the way, I disguised myself as a demon to watch your fight. It was a heated battle… in many ways.
m920094.ちょ、ちょっと！ そう言うあなたの体が\nどんどん消えていってるじゃない！\nな: Hey, wait! Your body keeps disappearing…! We have to…!
m920094.って、そうよね。魂が残っていれば\n何度だって蘇るのが不死者ですもの。\nあぁ、: Right, that's it. As long as a soul remains, an undead can rise again and again. Ah, I'm such a simple…
m920094.てっきりサヨさんもいるのかと思っていたのですが。\nもう帰られた後だったのですね:
I assumed Sayo would be here too.
But you'd already left, hadn't you… Prince?
What are you doing, looking around like that?
m920094.ですが、帝国軍は貴方達と馴れ合う気はありません。\nそれは忘れないでください。: But the Imperial troops have no intention of getting cozy with you. Don't forget that.
m920094.ですが、状況は悪化しています。\n我が姉ケラウノスが活動を開始しました。\nそれ: However, the situation is worsening. My sister Keranos has begun her activities, and the Demon King is showing signs of revival.
m920094.でも、あの戦場……邪仙が支配する華の国の都には、\n邪仙、屍解仙の罠が張り巡らさ: Yet that battlefield… the capital of the Flower Kingdom under Youkosen was riddled with traps laid by Youkosen and Shikai-sen.
m920094.でも、この後も幾度となく戦う事になる妖怪達と、\n手を取り合い共に戦う道を開いた: Still, I think it's amazing how the Prince has opened a path to cooperate with the very youkai he'll keep fighting over and over. …I'm not saying he's a hero yet, though.
m920094.でも、ヒバリさんを正式に仲間に加えて、\n王子軍もさらに強くなったのよね。\nし: “Still, we officially added Hibari to our ranks, and the Prince's forces grew stronger. We'll face Wine Cellar Boy again later…”
m920094.でも、今は違うから。王子の事を、\n誰よりも近くでずっと見て来たから。\n貴方の: But that's over now. I've been watching you up close—closer than anyone else. I know you better than anyone in the world.
m920094.でも、王子の近くに居ると、\nわたしの知らなかった新しい世界が見れるの。\nこの: But being near the Prince lets me see a world I never knew. Like now, there are scary events, but…
m920094.でも安心なさい。お前の国の人間だけではなく、\nいずれ全ての人間を滅ぼしてあげま: But fear not. I'll wipe out not just the people of your land, but eventually all humanity. Come, Holy Spirit of Eternal Darkness, aid me in annihilating mankind.
m920094.でも王子はオークの大群が迫る中、\n最初は非協力的だったレーゼルさんを見捨てる事:
But you, Prince, never abandoned Rösel, who was initially uncooperative, even as the massive orc horde closed in,
and in the end you worked together to drive the orc army back.
m920094.と、突撃兵の中から人間が……！？\nいや、人間が化けていたのか……。\n倒されて: From the charging troops, a human…!? No, a human was disguised… Even when defeated, their existence doesn't vanish.
m920094.とにかく、急いで王子たちを追わないと！: Anyway, we have to hurry and catch up with the princes!
m920094.どうした、ぬらりひょん？\nまだ鬼が助けにくるとでも思っておるのか？:
What's wrong, Nurarihyon?
Did you still think the demons would come to your aid?
m920094.な、なんだと……！ よ、よかろう。\nわしは妖怪総大将ぬらりひょん様じゃ。\nさ: W-what… Very well. I am the Great General of Yokai, Nurarihyon himself. Now, lower your proud head.
m920094.なぜ……天使長である私が、\n人間などに……負けるの、ですか……？\nわからない: Why… why would I, the Angel-Leader, lose to a human…? I don't get it… I can't comprehend it…
m920094.なに、気にするな。無理はするでないぞ。\n……思えば、兵達とは\n随分長く共に戦: No need to worry. Don't overdo it. …Come to think of it, we've fought alongside the troops for a long time.
m920094.ならば、わしがすぐに孤独を思い出させてやるわぃ。\n宝剣の担い手として、永劫の番: Then I'll remind you of solitude right away. As the bearer of the sacred blade, I'll become your eternal guard, cherishing and pitying you until death.
m920094.ならばこの光景は何なのですか！？\n見なさい、貴方達が産み落とした戦火を！\nこ: Then what is this sight?! Look at the war you've unleashed! If this isn't hell, what is?
m920094.なんだ、このじいさん。\nオレの名前を知りたきゃ、\nまず、お前が名乗れよ。: ???: What's this old man? If you want to know my name, first you tell yours.
m920094.なッ！？ 奴の姿が見えねぇ！？ 気配もない……。\n一体どういう――グ……ァァ…: What!? I can't see his form! No presence at all… What on earth—G… AA… AA! When did… he get into my arms…?
m920094.ぬらりひょん……昔妖怪に変装して、\n奴の許に潜入した事もあったけど。あの人、\: Nurarihyon… He once disguised himself as a youkai to infiltrate their ranks. He actually has a surprisingly kind side when it comes to youkai.
m920094.ぬらりひょんが没した後、\n王子たちが酒呑童子と戦ったあの日。:
After Nurarihyon fell,
the Prince and his allies fought the Wine Cellar Boy that day.
m920094.は、はいィッ、酒呑童子様！\nた、ただちに撤退いたします！: Y-yes, Lord Shuten-douji! We'll withdraw immediately!
m920094.はぁ……はぁ……。\nお、おのれ……逃がしたか……。: Haa… haa… You… you let her escape…?
m920094.はい……ココロさん。次の時代へ行きましょう。\n何としても私達の歴史を、そして過: Yes…… Kokoro. Let's go to the next era. We must protect our history—and the past Prince—no matter what.
m920094.はい。如何にも私が女神アダマスです。\nこの迷宮に長らく囚われていましたが、\n: Yes. As you can see, I am the goddess Adamas. I was trapped in this labyrinth for a long time, and though only a spirit now, I have managed to return.
m920094.ふふ……よくぞここまで辿りつきました、不浄な人間達よ。\n私がこの地に封印したア: Heh… Well done, filthy humans, for making it this far. You've come to release the Adamas I sealed here, haven't you? …If you wish to set him free, I'll break the seal for you.
m920094.ふふ、愚かで不浄なる人間達を滅ぼす事に、\n何をためらう必要があるというのです、: Heh, what hesitation is there in eradicating foolish, impure humans, Adamas? It's you who needs to awaken.
m920094.ふふふ、あの戦いでわたしの変装術も、\nついに動物に化ける境地に達したわ。\n…: Hehe, that fight finally let my disguise technique reach the level of turning into an animal. ...I can't run at tiger speed, though.
m920094.ふふふ。アレこそ騎獣戦車のパワーに\nクイーン様の遠距離魔法が備わった\n最強の: Heh heh. That's the beast-tank's power combined with the Queen's long-range magic—the ultimate beast-tank!
m920094.ふん、お前の未熟な槍など役に立たぬ。\n……この戦いが終わったらもっと鍛えてやる: Hmph, your immature spear is useless. …After this battle, I'll train you harder, so be prepared.
m920094.へー、オレの主になりたいっていうのか。\nいいだろう、オレよりも強かったら\n手: ???: So you want to become my master? If you're stronger than me, I'll become your subordinate.
m920094.べ、別に怒ってなんかいないわよ。\n王子が無事だったのなら、それが何よりでしょ。: I'm not angry or anything. As long as the Prince is safe, that's all that matters.
m920094.ほう、自ら我が前に歩み出るとはな……。\nその潔さだけは褒めてやろう。: Hmm, you actually stepped forward to face me… I'll commend you for that bravery.
m920094.ほら、一度は退けた魔神アモン。\n奴がパワーアップしてやって来た時。\nあんなの: You know, the demon Amon we'd once driven back—when he came back all powered up. I was wondering how we'd even fight something like that.
m920094.ほんと王子って、何があっても王子なのね。\nあんなに大事な時でも、いつも通り。\: Really, you're always a prince no matter what. Even at such crucial times you act the same… but that's just… what makes you… you.
m920094.ま、待て！ この時間を操る力があれば、\n過去は何度だってやり直せるのだ！\nき: Wait! With this power to control time, I could redo the past over and over! I could even move to the world where your master lives—
m920094.まぁ、それは別の戦いの話だし。\n何はともあれ、\nこうして、第二次妖怪大戦は終: “Well, that's a story for another battle. Anyway, the Second Great Youkai War is finally over.”
m920094.まぁ、別に恨み言を言う気はないんだけど。\nこんな時代に人間同士で争うなんて、悲: Well, I'm not holding a grudge. It's sad enough that humans are fighting each other in these times. We have to restore peace and build a world where people can trust one another.
m920094.まぁ、王子の戦いを見届けるってきめたから。\n一度決めた以上、意地でも付いて行く:
Well, I decided to see the Prince's fight through.
Once I made that decision, I'd stubbornly stick with him.
Next up, the battle with the Wine Cellar Boy too.
m920094.まぁそんなこんなで、それからもずっと貴方を見て来た。\n王子を見定める……そんな: Well, anyway, I've been watching you ever since. The pretense of judging… I've long forgotten that.
m920094.まぁ良い。どれ、少し待っていろ。\n調子が悪いなら馬を持って来てやろう。: Fine enough. Hold on a moment. If you're feeling off, I'll fetch a horse for you.
m920094.まさか、我と戦う気なのか？\nそのオモチャの剣で？\nグハハハハハハハハハハハッ: So you intend to fight me? With that toy sword? Gahahahahahaha!!
m920094.まずい……。\nあやつめ、この地で死んでいった者の怨念を\n自身に取り込んでおる: This is bad… He's absorbing the grudges of those who died on this land into himself…
m920094.また、同様の力を備えた眷属も従えているようです。\nこれまでとは比べ物にならない: It also has minions with the same power. We're looking at a battle far more brutal than anything we've faced before.
m920094.また、魔界蟻の軍勢の中には\nオークやマーマンの姿も混ざっているとの\n目撃情報: We've also received reports that among the demon-ant forces are orcs and mermen.
m920094.む……また勝手に先走りおって……。\n屍解仙がキョンシーどもを残したまま\n姿を:
Hmph… always rushing ahead on your own…
I'm worried that Shikai-sen vanished after leaving those jiangshi behind, but…
m920094.むむ、そこのフラフラとした貴様！\nこんなところで何をしておる！\nさっさと配置:
Hmph, you there, wobbling fool!
What are you doing here!
Get into position right now!
m920094.もしあの時王子たちが間に合わなければ、\nヒバリさんは殺されてたかも。無理を承知: “If we hadn't made it in time, Hibari might've been killed. I was ready to charge in recklessly, so I'm really relieved.”
m920094.ようやく来たな、王子。今日こそは勝たせてもらうぞ！\n我輩の最後の切り札……その: At last you're here, Prince. Today I'll finally win! Behold my final trump card… you'll see it with your own eyes! …In this battle, I'll gain even more power!
m920094.わが師よ……。\n何故……なぜ、このデシウスに\n奥義を伝授しなかったのですか？: My master… Why… why didn't you pass this ultimate technique on to me?
m920094.わしが……こんなところで……逝くことになるとは……。\nだれか居らぬか……この気: I… to think I'd meet my end here… Is anyone there… this presence… a hungry spirit?… Will you hear the final request of your Yokai Grand General…?
m920094.わしの秘術で周囲の妖気を取り込んだ今、\nお前が出ずとも王子軍など蹴散らしてやる: Now that I've drawn in the surrounding demonic energy with my secret art, I can crush the Prince's army even without you. Stay out of my way, Meiling.
m920094.わずかな望みがあるとすれば、\n二柱の神の加護を受けし者達。聡明な貴方ならば、\: If there is any hope, it lies with those who bear the blessings of the two divine pillars. You, being wise, must already understand everything, right?
m920094.わたし、あの時は闇ギルドを成敗しようと、\nローグに変装してギルドに潜入してたん: Back then I tried to bring the Dark Guild to justice by disguising myself as a rogue and infiltrating them…
m920094.わたしが見てきたわたしとあなた達の記憶。\nその思い出話に付き合ってくれる？: I've seen the memories of both you and me. Care to join me in reminiscing?
m920094.わたしに出来る事と言えば変装くらい。\nそんなわたしが、今更、姿を現して協力する: All I can do is disguise myself. I couldn't even bring myself to say I'd show up now and help.
m920094.わたしの変装術に加えてあの妖怪の数。\nわたしが居た事に気づかなくても仕方ないわ: With my disguise technique plus those countless youkai… No wonder they didn't notice I was there.
m920094.わたしは、メトゥスさんが不死者として人々にしてきた\n罪過も見てきたわ。それは王: I've seen the sins Metus committed as an undead against people—Prince must have seen the same. Yet the Prince accepted her.
m920094.わたしはこの後、シノさんを探し出して、長ドスを届けて、\nそれからヒバリさんと王:
After that I went looking for Shino, delivered the long spear, then chased after Hibari and the Prince.
...Catching up was really hard.
m920094.わたしはトロルに変装してたんだけど、\n猫背で窮屈で……中々に難しい変装だったわ: I was disguised as a troll, but the hunched posture was so uncomfortable... It was a pretty tough disguise.
m920094.わたしは父の戦死を知って悲しむシノさんの姿を\n知ってるの。だから、りんと立ち直: I know Shino's grief over her father's death. Seeing her bounce back so quickly made me think she was okay.
m920094.わたしは王子が英雄の末裔、王に相応しい人間かを\n見届けるために尾行してた訳なん: I was tailing the Prince to see if he truly is the hero's descendant, worthy of the throne… but the Land of Flowers ruled by Youkosen was the opposite—a downright villainous capital.
m920094.ウフフ……何て精神力なのかしら。\nここまでワタシの催眠術をはね除けた人間なんて:
Heh heh... what kind of willpower is that?
I've never had anyone resist my hypnosis before.
m920094.ウフフ。予算を抑えるのも貴方の使命よ。\n次に作るのはとびきり凶悪な武器、でお願: Hehe. Keeping costs down is part of your job. Make the next weapon as vicious as possible, okay? Come on, goblins, let's go.
m920094.エリアス殿、ここは王国領内です。\n彼らが協力してくれるというのなら、\nこちら: Lord Elias, this is kingdom territory. If they're willing to cooperate, there shouldn't be any downside for us…
m920094.オスの魔物ばかり……ですね。\n女王蟻のフェロモンに誘惑された魔物と\n魔界蟻の: All male monsters, huh…? Tempted by the queen ant's pheromones, they've formed a mixed army with the demon ants.
m920094.オマエはここで死ぬんだよ、ぬらりひょん。\nそうすれば酒呑童子様が妖怪の頂点に君:
You'll die here, Nurarihyon.
Then Wine Cellar Boy will reign supreme over the Yokai.
Heh heh heh... it was fate from the start.
m920094.オークの大群が密林に攻めてきた時も、\n彼らはジャングルを守る為に戦っていた。: When a massive horde of orcs stormed the jungle, they were fighting to protect the jungle.
m920094.オーク勇者と王子の一騎打ち。\nすごかったわ。戦いに目を奪われて、\nわたしはす: The duel between the Orc Hero and the Prince—wow, it was amazing. I was so captivated by the battle that I got knocked down by Soma right away.
m920094.カ、カボッ！\n（魂を捧げる？ ……このまま\nただ見ている訳には行かないみたい:
K-Kabo!
(Offer our souls? …Looks like we can't just stand by.)
m920094.カスミ……姉であるシノに……、\nお前の事を伝えてやれぬ父を、許せ……。: Kasumi… tell my sister Shino… forgive a father who couldn't tell you….
m920094.ギャ、ギャギャ！\n（……悔しいけど、ここは一旦言う事を聞くフリをして、\nまた: Gy… gyagyā! (…It's frustrating, but I'll just pretend to obey for now and look for another chance.)
m920094.ギャギャ！ ショウカク！ ショウカク！\n（鋭い観察眼だわ……。さすがゴブリン博: Gyagyā! Shōkaku! Shōkaku! (What sharp eyes… As expected of Goblin Doctor. It'll be impossible to keep deceiving him…)
m920094.クイーンサマ！\nマホウガキエタ！ マホウガキエタ！: Queen! The magic's back! The magic's back!
m920094.グフフ……何をバカなことを言っている？\n我輩の必殺剣は完璧だ！\n貴様の父と同:
Heh heh... what nonsense are you spouting?
My Ultimate Sword is flawless!
I've attained the same power as your father!
m920094.ケイティさん、ダメです……。私たち癒し手の力は\n悪霊に妨害された状態のようです: Katie, it's no use… Our healing power is being disrupted by the evil spirits…
m920094.ケラウノス姉様……魔物の女王までも使うなんて……。\n王子、私の加護を受けた皇帝: Sister Keranos… using even the monster queen… Prince, the Emperor under my protection is a formidable foe.
m920094.ケラウノス姉様は、皇帝を手中におさめていると\n言っていました。居場所は姉様が知: Sister Keraunos said she has the Emperor in her grasp. She should know his whereabouts. I'll lead the way. Let's pursue Sister Keraunos!
m920094.ココロちゃんの師匠を殺し、力を奪ったクロノデーモン。\nその力で過去を変えようと: The Chrono Demon who killed Kokoro-chan's master and stole his power. You all chased that demon, which was trying to rewrite the past, by moving back in time as well.
m920094.コロス……人間ハ、ミナゴロシダ……。\n我ガ主ビフロンス様の御心のママニ……。: I shall kill… humans, all of you… as my master Bifrons wills.
m920094.サヨさん……と言うのですか？\nあの、サヨさんはどうしてゴブリンに変装など？:
Sayo… is that what you're saying?
Um, why would you disguise yourself as a goblin, Sayo?
m920094.シノに、我が娘に……この長ドスを渡してくれんか……。\n一言……。夢の道半ばで逝: To Shino, to my daughter… will you give them this long-spear? One thing… forgive me for dying halfway through my dream… Please…
m920094.スクハさんの国に伝わる宝剣、干将剣と莫邪剣。\nお互いを引き寄せる夫婦の逸話を持: In Sukuha's land there's the legendary swords, the Ganjiang and the Mo Ye. They share a tale of a couple drawn together. Do you remember the battle with Youkosen over those swords?
m920094.チクショウ……。やはり身体と切り離されたままでは、\n本気は出せそうにないぜ……: Damn… Without my body I can't give it my all… Four Heavenly Kings! We'll retreat for now!
m920094.デ、デシウス……様！ \nあ……えっと、ちょっと身体が重たくて。\nか、風邪でし: D- Decius… sir! …uh, my body feels heavy. Could it be a cold?
m920094.デシウス、お前は大切な者を失い、\n復讐心に駆られていた。その念が消えぬ者にとっ: Decius, you lost someone precious and were consumed by vengeance. For a soul that can't let go, that technique is a double-edged blade… I was thinking of you.
m920094.デシウスがお手製の挑戦状を送ってきて。\nわたしはそれを知ってすぐ、暗黒騎士団に:
Decius sent his homemade challenge letter.
As soon as I heard it, I infiltrated the Dark Knights.
This time I just put on ordinary armor and disguised myself—
m920094.デシウスが力を求める理由を察せる出来事も\nこの後起こったけど……。: An event later on will shed light on why Decius craved power…
m920094.デシウスの選んだ道は間違ってる。\n大切なモノを守るためであったとしても、\nそ:
Decius's chosen path is wrong.
Even if it's to protect something precious, sacrificing everything else is unacceptable.
m920094.デシウスはアイギス様の姉神様「ケラウノス」の名前を\n口にしていましたが、一体ど: Decius mentioned the name of Aegis' sister deity, Keraunos. I wonder what their connection is—
m920094.デシウスは神に対抗できる力を求めている。\n信じていた神に裏切られ、大事なもの全: Decius is hunting for power that can stand up to the gods. Betrayed by the deity he trusted and having lost everything he held dear, his grief and frustration are immeasurable.
m920094.デシウスも、そして王子も\nそれぞれが正しいと思った道を進んでる。: Both Decius and you, Prince, are each walking the path you believe is right.
m920094.デーモンだと……！？\nくそっ……ここまで……なのか……？\n王子は……王子はご: A demon…!? Damn… is it really… this far…? Prince… is the Prince safe!?
m920094.ハッ、ゴブリンクイーン様。\n騎獣戦車の準備が出来ましタ。ゴブリンたちにハ、\n: Ha! Goblin Queen. The beast-tank is ready. We've equipped the goblins with weapons infused with magic.
m920094.ハッ！ ……あの、クイーン様。\n新たな武器を作るにあたってなのですガ、\nもう: Huh! …Um, Queen, about the new weapon… I'd need a bit more funding, if you could…
m920094.ヒッ……！\nく、首が……酒呑童子の首が、喋っています……！: Huh…! The head… the Head of Shuten-douji is talking…!
m920094.ヒバリ殿……！\nその深手は……！\n早くこちらへ。酒呑童子は私達がなんとか――: “Hibari! That grievous wound—! Come quickly! We'll handle Wine Cellar Boy ourselves—”
m920094.ビフロンスに魂を操られる事がないように……\n操られる苦しみから解放するために…: So she wouldn't be controlled by Bifrons' soul... to free her from that suffering... she erased Ritch, who was more than family to her.
m920094.フェロモンの洗脳を解除できれば、\n魔物の軍勢も解散させられるかも、と考えてたん: I figured if we could break the pheromone mind-control, we might disperse the monster army. But the only way to stop the pheromones was to kill the queen.
m920094.フシュゥ……さすが、王子カボ。\nこのままじゃ刈り取られて食用にされるカボ……。:
*huffs*… as expected, Prince Kabo.
If we keep going, the pumpkins will be harvested and turned into food, Kabo…
Pumpkins, retreat for now!
m920094.フハハハッ！ さあ、決着をつけようではないか、王子！\n貴様を殺し、我輩の力の一: Fuhahaha! Come now, Prince, let's settle this! I'll kill you and make you part of my power! All troops, charge! Let's crush the Prince's army here!!
m920094.フフ、ビフロンス様より与えられた\nこの強大な力をもって、\n貴方達を殺し尽くし: Heh, with this overwhelming power granted by Bifrons, I shall wipe you all out.
m920094.ヘクターさん、こんなにボロボロになるまで戦って……。\n今、治療しますね。: Hector, you fought until you were this battered... Let me heal you now.
m920094.ミルノさん！\nお願いです！ 天使達を止めてください！\nこのままでは、本当に全: Miruno! Please! Stop the angels! If this continues, everyone will truly...!
m920094.ミーティア、必ず貴方の師匠の魂を救おう。\n王子、ここでデシウスとの決着をつける:
Meteor, we must save your master's soul.
Prince, let's settle this with Decius here.
m920094.モーティマさんがカボチャを食材にしてやるって\n凄んでた戦いね。: Mortimer was so eager to turn pumpkins into ingredients for his cooking—what a fierce battle that was.
m920094.モーティマさんと甘いモノと言えば、\nカボチャの軍勢が王子の魂を\n狙ってきた事: Speaking of Mortimer and sweets, do you remember when the pumpkin troops tried to snatch your soul?
m920094.不死者であるメトゥスさんとは最初、敵対してたのよね。\nだけど、彼女の助手である: At first we were at odds with Metus, the immortal, but then her assistant, the lich, came to the Prince.
m920094.不死者のままだとビフロンスに魂を操られる、\nだけど人間に戻れば、いつか死んでし: If we remain undead, Bifrons will manipulate our souls, but if we become human again, we'll eventually die. Metus-san, I'm really torn, Prince...
m920094.不死者を操る魔神ビフロンスから彼女を助けてくれ、と。\nそれで、不死者を人間に戻: She begged us to free her from the demon Bifrons, who controls the undead. So we set out to obtain the Relic of Rebirth, the jewel that can turn the undead back into humans.
m920094.中でも、自慢の娘に対しては甘々で……と、\nいけない。これはまた別の話だったわ！: And when it comes to his prized daughter, he's downright sweet… Oops, that's a different story!
m920094.中でも天使と堕天使は同じ天使同士で、\n完全に人間の敵と味方で分かれちゃってる。: Among them, angels and fallen angels are both angels, yet they've split completely into enemies and allies of humanity.
m920094.中には神に逆らい、堕天使となる天使も居るけど……。\nあの軍勢の天使は冷酷な天使: Some angels defied God and became fallen, but that army is made up only of ruthless angels. I don't think there's any room for negotiation or understanding.
m920094.主よ……ここにざんげします。私は、貴方ではなく、\n己に従うことを選びました……: Master… I surrender here. I chose to follow my own heart, not yours… Please forgive this heart that was born suddenly, and my compassion for others…
m920094.久しぶりね、アダマス。滅び行く人間達の無残な姿を、\n我が愚妹であるアイギスとあ: It's been a while, Adamas. To show you and my foolish sister Aegis the pitiful sight of humanity's downfall, I've unsealed you now.
m920094.了解しました……王子、どうかご無事で。\n再び、神殿の森にてまみえましょう。: Understood…… Prince, please stay safe. Let's meet again in the forest temple.
m920094.互いに仲間として、同じ志の許に集ったという結束力を高め\n連携の強化を目指し、戦:
By strengthening the bond that brings us together as comrades sharing the same ideals,
we aim to enhance our coordination and boost our overall strength.
I hope this will be a fruitful exercise.
m920094.互いに競い合い、また協力し合うことで、\n種族や立場のわだかまりを超えた絆が生ま: By competing and cooperating, we felt a battle that forged bonds beyond race and status, and watched them grow.
m920094.交換条件に出されたのは、王国領内に潜む\nベルゼビュートを自軍で討伐したい帝国の: “In exchange, we allowed the White Empire's troops to operate in our kingdom so they could hunt down Belzebuth lurking within our lands.”
m920094.人の心を完全に捨ててしまったようだね……。\nいいよ……同門のボクが終わらせてあ:
Looks like you've completely cast aside your humanity...
Fine. I'll finish this, as a fellow disciple.
I'll cut away all your suffering and sorrow.
m920094.人の気持ち、魂、肉体まで弄ぶような卑劣な奴ら、\n許せないわ。ただ、そんな邪仙の: Those despicable ones who toy with people's feelings, souls, even bodies… I can't forgive them. Still, protecting Meiling from those Evil Spirits was one of the few blessings of that fight.
m920094.人を支配するためだけに、強さを求める支配者は\n沢山見てきたけど、この戦いの中で: I've seen many rulers who seek strength only to dominate others, but watching this fight, I realized the Prince is different.
m920094.人を滅ぼせと言う神の命令を絶対とし、\n課された命を果たさんとするのが多くの天使: Many angels see the divine command to annihilate humans as absolute and strive to fulfill that mission... but there are also angels who trust humans and want to protect them.
m920094.人間と聖霊が力を合わせた時、\nどんな困難ものり越えることができる。\nそれを証:
Radiant Holy Spirit Fest: When humans and spirits combine their strength,
any obstacle can be overcome.
Prove it!
m920094.人間には原罪が内包されるのと同時に、愛があります。\nそれは、天使や神すら持ち合: Humans carry original sin, but they also hold love. Isn't that the one true brilliance of this world—something even angels and gods lack?
m920094.人間の力だけじゃなくて、\n女神アイギス様や聖霊の力も合わせて、\n王子たちは戦: Not just human strength, but also the power of Goddess Aegis and the holy spirits—together, the princes have fought.
m920094.人間の魂は、魔物数体分の\n魂に匹敵するカボ……そこのカボチャ、あの人間に\n逃: A human soul equals the souls of several monsters, Kabo… you pumpkin over there, make sure that human can't escape; keep a close watch, Kabo!
m920094.人間ふぜいが……畜生……\n妖怪の……理想郷をつくる……。\nわしの夢……ここで:
Humans... vermin...
Yokai... an ideal realm to create...
My dream... ends here...?
m920094.今ので魔物は全て討伐できたようですね。\n……ん、アレは？: Looks like we took care of all the monsters… Huh, what's that?
m920094.今の君には、敗北の理由も、\n強さの意味も、何も理解はできないだろうね。: You probably can't grasp the reason for defeat, or the meaning of strength, right now.
m920094.今はゆっくりと休まれて下さい。\n王子、お疲れ様でした。:
Please take your time to rest now.
Prince, thank you for your service.
m920094.今までろくに話せなくて溜まった分、\nこの機会に語りつくしちゃうんだから。\n休: Since we haven't been able to talk properly before, I'll use this chance to spill everything. After the break, you'll stay with me, okay?
m920094.今回も、王子達が女王蟻を倒す姿を見てるだけだった。\n陰から支えようって思ってる: This time I could only watch the Prince and his allies defeat the queen. I wanted to support from the shadows, yet I could do nothing…
m920094.仕方ありませんね……。\n我が主は私にこうも言っていました。: It can't be helped… My master once told me this.
m920094.仲間同士助け合い、力を合わせてきたからこそ、\n強大な敵にも打ち勝ってこれた。\: It's because we've helped each other and combined our strength that we've been able to defeat such formidable foes. Seeing you all, I really believe that.
m920094.休憩も挟んだし、話を再開するわね。\n戦いを続ける中、王国とは別に魔物と\n戦う: Now that we've had a break, let's resume. While the war raged on, we encountered a nation that fights monsters apart from the Kingdom… the White Empire.
m920094.伝令！\nオーク軍団の接近を確認しました！\n皆さん、臨戦態勢をとってください！:
Messenger!
We've confirmed the approaching orc legion!
Everyone, assume battle stations!
m920094.何が時を超越した、よ！\n人様の大切な師匠の身体を奪って、\n力を利用して……ふ: What do you mean “transcends time”! You stole a precious master's body, used their power… Don't you dare!
m920094.何を言っておる、\n暗黒騎士は肉体が無いのだから、風邪などひかぬだろう。\n調子: What are you babbling about? Dark Knights have no flesh, so you can't catch a cold. You're mistaking your poor condition for a living sensation.
m920094.内部に潜入して分かったんだけど、\nデシウスは、部下に慕われていたんだよね。\n: I learned from infiltrating them that Decius was actually respected by his subordinates. He also cared about them.
m920094.出会いもあれば別れもあり。\nまぁ、敵と別れるのは良い事かもしれないけど……。\:
Meetings and partings go hand in hand.
Well, parting with an enemy might be a good thing, but… we finally settled things with Decius's Dark Knights.
m920094.前団長もデシウス様も、\n我ら怨念から生まれた亡者に目的を与えて下さった。\n団: The former commander and Decius gave purpose to us revenants born of grudges. If I could become the commander's strength, that would be my fulfillment…
m920094.力が……溢れてくる……！\n聖霊のみなさん！\nありがとうございます！:
The power… is surging…!
Spirits of the holy, thank you!
m920094.力を使い果たしたか。\nこれではもう助からぬ。\n年貢の納め時でござるな。:
Have we exhausted our power?
At this rate we can't be saved.
It's time to pay the tribute, I suppose.
m920094.十分な鍛練、編成を準備された上で\nこちらに布陣しているとは思いますが、\nその: I'm sure you've prepared ample training and formation, but please command carefully.
m920094.印象に残る戦いって言ったらさ、\n王子軍の強さに一番驚いたのはあの戦いだよ。: When you think of a battle that left an impression, the one that shocked me most with the Prince's army's strength was that fight.
m920094.危険が迫る中、自分の身を顧みず誰かを助ける。\n王子が他人を見捨てられない人だっ:
When danger is near, you risk yourself to help others.
Through this battle I realized that you're someone who can't turn his back on anyone.
m920094.吸魂の力……死した魂の力を我が物とする外法か。\nそれで仮初の必殺剣を得てどうす: The soul-draining art… a forbidden method that makes the dead's power yours. And with that, you obtain the Provisional Ultimate Sword—what will you do with it? Decius, is this truly the answer you sought?
m920094.地上界は絶望的といっても過言ではありません……。\n今や、アイギス姉さまも私も、: To say the mortal realm is desperate would be an understatement… Now both Sister Aegis and I have lost most of our power…
m920094.堕天使に身をやつした者の言うことなど……。: The words of someone who has become a fallen angel...
m920094.報告によると、敵は炎に包まれた鳥の頭を持つ魔物で\n並外れた戦闘能力を誇っている: Reports say the enemy is a monster with a bird's head wreathed in flames, boasting extraordinary combat ability. Stopping its advance seems nearly impossible.
m920094.報告！ 前方から敵が迫ってきています！: Report! Enemies are approaching from the front!
m920094.変装は完璧とは言え、\n怪しまれる行動は避けないとね。\n……あら、あそこに見え: The disguise is decent, but I still have to avoid any suspicious behavior. …Ah, what's that over there?
m920094.大きな騎獣による戦車なんて兵器も初めての事なの。\n王子たちの強さは私たちドワー: It's the first time we've seen a war-beast-mounted tank, either. The Prince's strength is already known throughout the dwarven lands, but we can't afford to let our guard down.
m920094.大丈夫、私たちの祝福を貴方達に授けましょう。: Don't worry, we'll grant you our blessings.
m920094.大丈夫です……私がついています。\n自らの心奥に問いかけるのです……。\n貴方の: It's okay… I'm with you. Ask the depths of your own heart… What does it scream you want to do?
m920094.大太刀の「鬼切」をこうも速く操るだとッ！？\nこ、小しゃくなァッ！ ……ぐおおォ:
You swing the great sword "Oni-giri" that fast!?
You… little brat!
...Guuuh!
m920094.大量の敵との交戦が予想されますので、\n効果的な部隊運用を心がけてくださいね。\: Expect heavy enemy numbers, so manage your troops efficiently. Then, let's march out, Prince!
m920094.天使から人々を守っている王子を見て。\n……わたしは、やっぱり王子を信じたいって: Watching you protect people from the angels… I realized I still want to believe in you.
m920094.天使が人間を滅ぼそうとしてるなんて、\n最初は自分の目を疑ったわ。: At first, I couldn't believe my eyes that angels were trying to wipe out humanity.
m920094.天使製のゴーレム……と言ったところでしょうか。\nあの巨体に装甲、悔しいですが、: You could call it an angel-crafted golem. That hulking, armored body… it's a shame, but trying to cut it down with swords would be reckless.
m920094.天使達と戦おうとする王子をみて、\nやっぱり王子は悪者なんじゃないかって、\n信: When I saw the Prince ready to fight the angels, I almost convinced myself he was the villain, but that feeling wavered.
m920094.天使長……私は私の意思をもって、貴方を止めます！\nこれこそが堕天した者にしか果: Angel-Leader… I'll stop you of my own will! I now understand that this is a duty only a fallen one can fulfill.
m920094.女王蟻はいつも取り巻きを連れていたから、\n近づく事すら出来なかったし、そうして: The queen ant always stayed surrounded by her guards, so we couldn't even get close. While we were stalling, the battle started and we were thrown onto the front lines.
m920094.妖怪と人間が手を取り合う姿みたいに、\n未来に希望が持てる瞬間を見せてくれる。\: Just like yokai and humans joining hands, it shows moments where we can have hope for the future. That's really amazing.
m920094.妖怪の分際でえらそうに。\nよく聞け、オレの名は……ん？\nオレの名は……あれ、: ???: Acting all high-and-mighty for a yokai, huh? Listen up, my name is… huh? My name is… wait, what was it again?
m920094.妖怪総大将、ぬらりひょんを討ったのは、\nそんな戦いでの事だったよね。: Defeating the Grand General Nurarihyon happened in one of those unexpected fights, didn't it?
m920094.妖怪総大将のクソジジイを倒した奴らだなァ！？\n肩慣らしには丁度いい！ ここで俺: “Those who took down the Great General of youkai, huh!? Perfect warm-up! I'll take you on right here. Come at me, humans!!!”
m920094.妖虎仙よ。\nまさか、妖気を取り込むぬしの秘術でも敗れるとはのぅ。\nさて、この:
Youkosen…
To think your secret art that absorbs demonic energy could be defeated…
At last, I've been waiting for this moment… DIE――!!
m920094.妖虎仙！？ ……私はもう独りではない。\n朋友が、このスクハを支えているのだから: Youkosen!? ...I'm not alone anymore. My friends support me now!
m920094.姉様……未だにその様な事をお考えなのですか！？\nやはり今度こそ私の神器によって: Sister… you still entertain that thought?! As expected, this time I must cut down that evil heart—with my divine weapon, along with you.
m920094.差出人に妖怪総大将って書いてるんですが、\n私を誰かと勘違いしているのでしょうか: The sender signs as “Grand General of the Yōkai,” but I wonder if they've mistaken me for someone else.
m920094.帝国のこちらに対する態度は\n相変わらずのようですけどね……。: The Empire's attitude toward us seems to be the same as always…
m920094.帝国軍が自分たちの手で魔神を討つ事に\nこだわってたのは、君主を侮られた事に対す: The Empire's insistence on defeating the demon themselves might stem from a fierce loyalty born of being looked down upon by their ruler.
m920094.常闇の聖霊、力を使い果たしましたか。\nでは代わりに、聖霊の力で強化しておいた\: Holy Spirit, have you exhausted your strength? Then, using the power of the spirit, I'll summon the monsters I've fortified here and make them my pawns.
m920094.幸い、過去に一度戦った後にフェロモンへの抗体を\n準備できたから、王子や王子軍の: Fortunately, after that earlier battle we managed to develop an antidote to the pheromones, so the Prince and his troops avoided being enthralled….
m920094.幾多の戦士が帰らぬ者となった『悪霊の迷宮』……。\nそれでもアダマス信仰国の帝国: The Labyrinth of Evil Spirits, where countless warriors have fallen… Yet for the empire that worships Adamas, reviving Lady Adamas is a long-held ambition.
m920094.強そうな相手ですけど……、\n絶対、私の研究成果である魔導書を\nゴブリンクイー: It looks like a strong opponent, but I'll definitely get my research, the spellbook, back from the Goblin Queen!
m920094.待て、デシウス！\n……くっ、逃げられたか……！:
Hold it, Decius!
...Ugh, did he get away...!
m920094.心配いらないよ。\n人間の力だけで、どうしようもなかったらね。\nそんな時は、聖:
No need to worry.
If human strength alone can't do it, then…
Just borrow the spirit's power.
m920094.必殺剣……そうか、師匠の魂を宿したんだね？\nだけど、星の心を解さない君では、\:
The Ultimate Sword... so it's housing your master's soul, huh?
But without unlocking the heart of the stars, you can't properly wield that technique!
m920094.急に軍を止められて、どうされました、王子？\nあ、あれは……デシウス？\nそれに: Suddenly the troops were halted—what's the matter, Prince? Ah, that's… Decius? And who's the woman beside him?
m920094.悪霊が戦士たちの力を封じる『悪霊の迷宮』……。\nここでは癒し手の皆さんが力を封: The “Maze of Evil Spirits” seals the warriors' power… It looks like the healers' abilities are sealed here, too. Prince, please lead while keeping an eye on the troops' stamina.
m920094.愛……？ わからない……私には、そのようなもの……。\nいいえ、天使長である私が: Love…? I don't understand… I have nothing like that. No, as the Angel-Leader, I must never doubt God!
m920094.我が軍の力の源は何か、\nそれを再確認できる演習になったかと思います。\n王子、: I think this drill let us reaffirm what the source of our army's strength is. Prince, thank you for your hard work this time.
m920094.我ら四天王が復活を果たした今、\nお前はもう用済みなのじゃ！\nガーーッハッハッ:
Now that we've revived, the Four Heavenly Kings, you are no longer needed!
Ga—hahaha!
m920094.我輩は一足先に退かせてもらうとしよう。\nまだまだ我輩には、やらねばならぬことが: I'll withdraw for now. I still have many things to accomplish. I must obtain even greater power—power that surpasses the gods.
m920094.戦いと言えば、復活した魔物以外にも\n獣や魔獣と戦っている時もあったわね。: Speaking of battles, besides the revived monsters, we've also faced beasts and magical beasts.
m920094.戦いの後、王子を主と認めた空飛ぶ魔物……\n……いえ、魔物じゃなくて仙猿だったわ: After the fight, the sky-borne monster that recognized you as its master… no, it wasn't a monster at all, it was the sealed celestial monkey, Far. She'll be joining us too.
m920094.戦いの後で調べたんだけど、この時、\n帝国軍は王国に攻め入る意思は無かったみたい: After the battle I looked into it, and it seemed the Imperial forces had no intention of invading the kingdom. They were only preparing to fight the demon.
m920094.戦いの末になんとか鬼たちを倒したものの、\n酒呑童子を封印することはできなかった: “We managed to defeat the demons in the end, but we couldn't seal Wine Cellar Boy. He escaped.”
m920094.戦うことは、避けられないのですね……。\n王子、ミルノさんを迎え撃ちましょう。: So fighting is inevitable… Prince, let's meet Miruno head-on.
m920094.戦わないで解決できればそれが一番なんだけど。\n……穏やかな魔物だっているし、い: It would be best if we could settle things without fighting. …There are gentle monsters out there, and someday we'll meet goblins who can understand us, too.
m920094.戦時中でのささやかなお祭りでしたが、\n激戦続きの兵たちにとって、\n良い慰安に: It was a modest celebration amid wartime, but I think it gave our hard-fighting troops a nice morale boost.
m920094.戯れるな、妖虎仙！ 私は、もう逃げません！\n宝剣が導いた新たな仲間との絆の許に: Don't toy with me, Youkosen! I won't run away any more! With the bond forged by the sword's guidance, I'll strike you down! Prepare yourself!
m920094.援軍……こんなに大勢の方々が……。\n王国の為に力をかしてくれる仲間がこんなに\: Reinforcements… so many of you… Friends willing to lend their strength for the kingdom… It can't be a dream, can it?
m920094.撤退はしない、か。ありがとう、王子。\n独りだった私に力を貸してくれて。\n私も:
Not retreating, huh? Thank you, Prince.
For lending me strength when I was alone.
I want to fight alongside you all to the very end.
m920094.改めて自己紹介させてもらうわね。わたしはサヨ。\n魔物が現れる前は義賊として、時: Let me reintroduce myself. I'm Sayo. Before the monsters appeared, I was a Robin Hood-type—sometimes punishing corrupt merchants, sometimes handing their riches to the poor.
m920094.敵として戦った相手であっても、\n助けを求める者に助けの手を差し伸べる。\nまさ:
Even when they're enemies, you still reach out to those who ask for help.
That's truly the mark of a king.
m920094.敵対した事すらある我が帝国へのご助力、感謝の言葉も\nありません。女神アダマス様:
I have no words to thank you for aiding our empire, even though we've clashed before.
Having learned that Goddess Adamas is sealed here, His Majesty himself went to the front himself, but…
m920094.新しい仲間を増やして、新しい敵と戦って。\nだけど、仲間が増える大変さもあったよ:
We gained new allies and faced new foes.
But having more comrades also brought its own challenges.
m920094.昔、帝国領内に現れたベルゼビュートに\n街が襲われ、病で沢山の犠牲者をだしたんだ: Long ago, when Belzebuth appeared in Imperial lands, a city was attacked and many died from the disease. The antibody medicine we use was apparently developed back then.
m920094.普段は魔物使いが森の魔獣たちをぜーんぶ管理して、\n悪さしないようにしてるんだ。: Normally, the Beast Tamers keep all the forest beasts under control so they don't cause any trouble.
m920094.暗黒騎士団はデーモンから命令されて\n王子を狙ってたみたいだけど、デシウス個人が: The Dark Knights were ordered by a demon to target the Prince, but Decius's personal reason for seeking power was something else.
m920094.暗黒騎士団や妖虎仙のように、\nお互いに決戦に臨む事もあれば、\n思わぬ戦いで命: Just like with the Dark Knights and the Demon Tiger Sage, sometimes we face each other head-on, other times we fall in unexpected battles.
m920094.暗黒騎士団を崩壊させ、部下を犠牲にしてまで、\nデシウスが力を求めていた理由。\: He tore down the Dark Knights, sacrificing his subordinates, all in pursuit of power. We caught a glimpse of that motive in the next battle, didn't we?
m920094.最後の話をする前に、ちょっとだけ休憩しない？\n……もうすぐわたしの話も終わりと: Before I finish my story, why don't we take a short break? …Thinking my tale is almost over makes me a little reluctant to end it.
m920094.本当はずっと前から、今まで見て来た連中とは、\n違うのかもって、そう思ってた……: Honestly, I've wondered… maybe I'm not like the people I've watched… maybe because I've seen so many as a Robin Hood.
m920094.案内ありがとうございます。この広い迷宮で、\n逃げ延びた方と遭遇できたのは幸運で:
Thank you for guiding us. In this huge labyrinth, it's lucky we ran into you survivors.
...Still, those injuries are terrible.
m920094.次の話はオークの部族長に挑戦された時の事ね。\nレーゼルさんを助けた時を超える、:
The next story is when the orc chieftain challenged us.
A grand clash that even surpasses the time we saved Rezel—an all-out war against a massive orc army.
m920094.次は……え、メトゥスさんの助手である\nリッチに頼まれて、彼女を助けにいった時の: Next… huh, you mean the time we were asked by Metus's assistant, the lich, to go rescue her? That battle definitely left an impression.
m920094.正々堂々とオークの挑戦を受け止めた、\n王子の戦う姿を見て、\n王子の力は皆を守: Seeing the Prince accept the Orc's challenge honorably, I understood his power is meant to protect everyone.
m920094.死体を弄ぶ邪仙、屍解仙。わたしが見てきた\n支配者の中でも、あんな邪道は初めて見: Youkosen, who toys with corpses, and Shikai-sen… Among all the rulers I've seen, that kind of wickedness was brand new to me. It left a huge impression.
m920094.死霊使いに分身する仙人にリビングアーマー。\n……王子の仲間って、\nほんとに色: A necromancer with a living armor, a sage who can split himself… Prince's companions really are a diverse bunch, huh… yeah.
m920094.沢山の魂を捧げれば、\nより強固な召喚も可能になる筈カボ。: Offer enough souls, and we can perform an even stronger summoning, Kabo.
m920094.流石ワタクシ。早速、クイーン様に報告ヲ……。\nン？ そこのゴブリン兵士。\nお: As expected of me. I'll report to the Queen right away… Huh? You goblin soldier over there. You… aren't you missing something big?
m920094.消えてしまいました……。\nそんな、せっかく出会えた女神が、\n私たちの敵となる: She's gone… After finally meeting a goddess, she ends up as our enemy…
m920094.清濁併せ呑む……それは同時に両方の敵対者と\n戦う事にもなりかねない道。: Swallowing both purity and impurity... that path could also mean fighting both sides' enemies.
m920094.滅ぼされた国の中には、ケラウノスの信仰国もあって、\nケラウノスを降臨させた結果: Among the nations that were wiped out were some that worshipped Keraunos, and after they summoned him their lands were destroyed. Back when we fought the Angel Legion I couldn't believe it… but now it makes sense.
m920094.父の仇は直接手を下した王子たちじゃなく、\n父の信頼を裏切り、戦死を強要した鬼の: The princes didn't kill his father's foe directly; it was the demon faction that betrayed his father's trust and forced his death. Understanding that, Shino asked the Prince for help.
m920094.父の無念だとぉ？ ……その妖気、ぬらりひょんの娘か。\nったく、妖怪ってのは何奴: Avenge your father's grievance? …That eerie aura, you're Nurarhyon's daughter, huh. Damn, you yokai are all idiots. I'll kill you just like that old bastard…
m920094.父様、王子たちが来たみたい。メイリンも頑張るよ！\n父様仕込みの槍術で、王子たち: Father, it looks like the Prince and his men have arrived! I'll do my best too! With the spear technique you taught me, I'll take them down!
m920094.王……と言うよりは部族の代表だけど。\n次はオークとの戦いの思い出ね。:
He's more a tribal chief than a king, really.
Next up is the memory of the battle with the orcs.
m920094.王国を敵対視している帝国からの交換条件だったから、\nどんな条件を出されるかとす: It was a condition from the Empire that was hostile toward our kingdom, so I was really worried about what they'd demand…
m920094.王城を襲ったデーモンの一体が、\nまさかわたしが変装していたデーモンだなんて……: One of the demons that attacked the royal castle… was actually me in disguise… …I never saw that coming.
m920094.王子、こっちだ！\n妖怪総大将、ぬらりひょん。\n……何か、言い残す事はある？:
Prince, this way!
Yokai Grand General, Nurarihyon.
...Do you have anything left to say?
m920094.王子、やりました！\n魔導書を取り戻しましたよ！: Prince, we did it! We've recovered the spellbook!
m920094.王子、今の酒呑童子は「鬼切」をもってしても、\n全く歯が立たなかった……。人があ: “Prince, even with ‘Oni-giri,' the revived Wine Cellar Boy was unbeatable… If a person took that blow, they'd be finished. We must be cautious.”
m920094.王子、夏祭りも盛況の内に終わりました。\n踊りに、肝試しに、余興に……皆さん、\: Prince, the summer festival wrapped up nicely. We had dancing, a test of courage, side acts… Everyone seemed to have enjoyed it, which is the best outcome.
m920094.王子、彼女を助けないと！\nでも一体、どうすれば……。:
Prince, we have to save her!
But… how can we…?
m920094.王子、急ぎ迎撃しましょう！\n癒し手の皆さん、\n回復魔法の準備はどうなっていま: Prince, let's intercept them at once! Healers, how's the recovery magic coming along?
m920094.王子、雲に乗った魔物がぬらりひょんと戦場を離脱！\nまた、魔物の群れがこちらに\: Prince, a monster on a cloud has left the battlefield with Nurarihyon! A swarm of monsters is heading this way again!
m920094.王子、魔王とケラウノスが退いていきます！: Prince, the Demon King and Keraunos are retreating!
m920094.王子、魔神が後退していきます！\n……なんとか、魔神を退けられたようですね。: Prince, the demon is retreating! …It looks like we managed to drive it back.
m920094.王子たちが酒呑童子に迫る直前、\nヒバリさんは、果敢にも一人\n酒呑童子へと挑ん:
Just before the Prince closed in on the Wine Cellar Boy,
Hibari boldly charged alone toward him.
m920094.王子たちの戦いは魔物だけじゃなく、\n人間同士で戦うこともあったよね。: The princes' battles weren't only against monsters; they even fought each other at times.
m920094.王子に何かあったら、王子軍のみんなも全員で協力して\n解決を目指すと思う。だって: If anything happens to the Prince, I'm sure everyone in the Prince's army will band together to sort it out. After all, the Prince is just as beloved by his comrades as the Emperor is.
m920094.王子に倒された者達の負の念を力に変えているのだ……。\n恐らく、この戦いで我らが: He's turning the negative feelings of those the Prince has slain into power… He'll probably even convert the grudges of the enemies we defeat in this fight into power…
m920094.王子の戦いを見届けるのとは別に、\n盗られた物を取り返すのは義賊としての使命だわ: Besides watching the Prince's battle, retrieving the stolen item is our duty as righteous thieves. To get the spellbook back, we have to find the Queen first.
m920094.王子の戦いを語るうえで、\n暗黒騎士団の存在は良くも悪くも外せないわね。: When we talk about the Prince's battles, the Dark Knight Order is impossible to ignore, for better or worse.
m920094.王子の選択の結末、それを見届けるために\nわたしの戦いも続いていくわ。: I'll keep fighting to see the outcome of the Prince's choice.
m920094.王子はあまり気にしてないみたいね……。\nけど、ケイティさんは\nその辺りで結構:
The Prince doesn't seem too concerned about that...
But Katie appears to be struggling quite a bit with it.
m920094.王子は誰かのために戦ってる印象が強いけど、\nスクハさんを助けに行軍した時もそう: The Prince always seems to fight for someone else, and that was true when we marched to rescue Sukuha.
m920094.王子も妖怪と共存する道を選んで、シノさんが\n父の後を継げるように、一緒に東の国: The Prince chose to coexist with youkai, and together they headed east so Shino could inherit her father's legacy. There they ran into a demon army—
m920094.王子を本当に英雄なんだと思った一つの区切り。\n最後の話は白の帝国兵の救援依頼が:
It's a true turning point that made me think the Prince really is a hero.
The final story was triggered by a rescue request from the White Empire soldiers—
m920094.王子？ あの……私を見つめても、何もでませんよ？\n……そ、そんなに見つめられる:
Prince? Um... staring at me won't get you anything.
...If you keep looking at me like that,
I'm going to get embarrassed...
m920094.王都を、魔物に明け渡すというのですか……！？\nいえ……王子の指示ということであ: You're saying we should surrender the capital to the monsters…!? No… if it's the Prince's orders… I have no objections….
m920094.現世代の英雄、これほどまでの力とは……。\nまあいいです。地上を滅ぼすには、まだ: Hero of this age, such power… Very well. There are still plenty of ways to lay waste to the world. I'll take my leave for now.
m920094.生まれや国、種族にも囚われずに仲間を増やしている\n王子だけど、妖魔の軍勢とはそ: The Prince gathers allies without caring about birth, nation, or race, but that doesn't seem to work against the youkai horde. He even fought a goblin army while rescuing the dwarves.
m920094.生物として雄であれば何者であろうと魅了する\n妾のフェロモンにも抗い続けるとは…:
For a male creature to resist my pheromones, no matter who he is... how delightful.
Emperor of the Empire... I can't wait for the day you fall.
m920094.病も解決して、次の話は天使の軍勢、\n天使兵団と王子が戦った時の事ね！: With the disease solved, the next story is about the angelic forces—the Angelic Legion—and the Prince's battle against them!
m920094.皇帝が持つ剣。アレはあらゆる護りを貫き、\n離れた相手さえ切り裂く我が神器です。: The sword the Emperor wields—its blade pierces every defense and can even slash foes from afar. It's my divine relic. Be careful when you face it.
m920094.目の前の光景をしっかりと見てください、天使長！\nこれがあなたが仕える、神と呼ば: Look closely at what's before you, Angel-leader! This is the true heart of the one you serve, the so-called God!
m920094.神ならば人間の願いを聞き入れるはずなどと、\n思いあがった愚か者たちに天罰を下し: If you claim to be a god, you should grant humanity's wishes. You fools, drunk on hubris, have only earned divine punishment.
m920094.神に従い、自らを偽るか……。\n神に背き、自らを正すか……。\nミルノ……苦しく: Obey God and lie to yourself… or defy God and stay true… Miruno… even if it hurts, you have to choose.
m920094.神の名の下に、人間を滅ぼしに来る。\nでも、神の命令だからって一方的に\n人間を: They come under God's name to destroy us. Still, just because it's a divine command doesn't make it right to wipe out humanity unilaterally.
m920094.神様の考えなんて判らないわ。\nでも、目の前にいる人をただ助けたいって、\nただ: I can't grasp God's motives, but you always fight with everything you've got just to help those in front of you.
m920094.神様は、悪を罰するもの。そういう教えは、\nどこにでも言い伝わってるものだもの。: God punishes evil—that's a teaching you hear everywhere.
m920094.祭りの後の静けさにはまだ早いようですね。\n王子、応戦をお願いします！: The calm after the festival is still premature. Prince, please engage the enemy!
m920094.私がいる王国のドワーフは昔からゴブリンの侵攻を\n押し返してきたけど、あんな勢い: The dwarves of my kingdom have repelled goblin invasions for ages, but I've never seen goblins so organized and driven.
m920094.私が偵察中にオークさんたちに捕まってしまって……、\nオーク部族長から王子への言: While I was scouting, the orcs captured me… They agreed to release me on the condition that I deliver the chieftain's message to you, Prince.
m920094.私は……世界が美しくあってほしい……。\nそして、私は正しく……ありたいのです…: I want the world to remain beautiful… And I want to be righteous… If that means… I have to betray…?
m920094.私は……助けたい……人を、助けたいと、\n願ってしまっている……こんな、ことって: I… I want to help… I want to save people… I never wanted any of this… I don't want to see a hell like this…
m920094.私はビフロンス様の忠実なる配下の一人、\nリッチロード。主の命によりメトゥス様を: I am one of Bifrons' faithful servants, the Lich Lord. By my master's command, I have come to fetch Metus-sama.
m920094.私も貴方のように神を信じていました。\nですがあの方は、人間を罰するべき愚物と決: I, too, once believed in God like you. But that person dismissed humans as foolish beings who should be punished, refusing to see anything else.
m920094.立派な国王と、うたわれた者であっても、\n裏で悪事に手を染めているなんて、\n日: It was a daily sight to see even a great king or a chosen hero dabbling in shady deeds behind the scenes.
m920094.笑わせないで、アダマス。あなたの神器もその使い手も、\n今や我が手中。そして精神: Don't make me laugh, Adamas. Your divine weapon and its wielder are now in my grasp. And you, reduced to a mere spirit, are nothing but a foolish god unable to wield divine power.
m920094.組んず解れつの妖怪千鬼夜行。\n変装が解けちゃうんじゃないかって\nちょっとヒヤ: The thousand-demon night march of yokai, all tangled together. I was a bit nervous they'd see through my disguise.
m920094.結局天使達の目的は、王子ではなく、\n人を滅ぼす事に向かっていた。: In the end, the angels weren't after you, Prince—they were after humanity's destruction.
m920094.絶好のタイミングだぜ、まったく。\nっしゃあ！ こっからが本番だぜ。\n王子、レ:
Perfect timing, really.
Alright! This is where the real fight begins.
Prince, Rösel! Let's crush those orcs!
m920094.絶対に裏の顔を見つけてやる！\nなんて躍起になって、ちょっかいかけようとした事も: I was determined to uncover your hidden side! I even tried to poke at you… I'm sorry for doubting you.
m920094.耳障りな台詞を並べ立てないでもらえるかしら？\nお喋りなリッチってキライなの……: Could you stop spouting those obnoxious lines? I can't stand chatty liches… If you want my soul, go ahead and take it.
m920094.聖霊だけど人に絶望した結果、\n人を滅ぼそうと魔物に力を与えていた闇の聖霊。\n:
She's a holy spirit, but after losing hope in humanity she gave monsters power to wipe us out— that's the Dark Holy Spirit.
She poured overwhelming power into a vicious demon.
m920094.聖霊に人間に。魔物以外には妖怪とも戦ったよね。\n中でも100体以上の妖怪に加え: Besides humans and monsters, we even fought yōkai. The fiercest battle was against over a hundred yōkai and the demon general, Shuten-Dōji—truly incredible.

At least keep your rampage within our line of sight!!

Indeed, many of our soldiers still bear the wounds

A letter for me?
I wonder who it's from……?

When it comes to Your Highness,

m920139.美味しく食べ終わったら、\nぽかぽか温泉に入りに行きましょうね♪:
Once we're done eating,

You're so dependable~♪

For the village's sake, we should investigate to make sure no other Doppelgangers are lurking around.

So the monsters haven't given up on this village yet.

With fewer monsters around, business is getting easier, big brother!
Oh, wait…… heh heh heh,
I see some figures over there!

You spotted the monsters, so that was your doing!
I knew the Kingdom's soldiers were a cut above the rest!

The monsters weren't much of a threat, but
I'm glad to hear they've safely recovered♪

m920139.（どうでしたかねぇ……隣村の奴かもしれませんぜ？）: (I don't know…… maybe they're from the neighboring village?)

(W-What? How did they notice

m920139.（はぁ～、鬼刃姫様は優しいなぁ……。\nでも、ちょっと名残惜しそうなのも可愛らし:

m920139.（事業とはあくせく働くものではない。\n既に動いている事業を乗っ取ることこそ、\:

m920139.（怒ってる姿も可愛いなぁ……。\nやっぱりあたし達の鬼刃姫様は最高だなぁ）:

Our Kibahime-sama really is the best)

The water is churning……
I sense a massive swarm heading this way!

――Oh, the current's changing.
Looks like those guys were manipulating it after all♪

――That said, through the envoy I dispatched as your ambassador,

???: —Y-Yes, that's right, it's a major incident!!
A huge event is unfolding on the seabed—!!

—T-There's an enemy attack! An enemy attack!!
Swordfishmen have appeared!!

???: ――So, is this Prince you got strong or what?
I'm so sick of Kraluf's pathetic bunch.

m920147.――むぅぅぅぅ。\n花火大会でもしようかと思ったんですけど、\n何やら難しい話を:
――Mmmmm.
I was thinking we could have a fireworks festival,
but it seems you're all having a rather serious conversation.

――Tch, tch. I wondered what all the fuss was about.
So, mere fish-men. Not even enough to slow us down.

Hm… what is that sound?
It feels like something is coming our way…
m920147.――シャァァァァァァック！！\n大・正・解・だァ！！\n人間の王子ィ、今度は水中:
――SHAAAAACK!!
You got it ri-gh-t!!
Human Prince! This time, let's settle it underwater!!

――Shaaaaaaack!!

Sharkgillman is the absolute strongest!!

――Withdraw your forces.

――It means there is still an entity in the Celestial Realm
capable of commanding angels, plotting something.

As for the route to the ocean floor,

and we'd have to pass through several dangerous areas.

…………
…Thank you, Prince of the Dry Land.

I can feel a presence buzzing through my tail.

……Former master?

m920147.……くっ、まさか音楽に惑わされるとはな。: ……Tch. To be so easily swayed by music.

m920147.……潮騒が呼び声に似ているからでしょうか。\n静かに、囁くように、想い人を呼ぶよ:

m920147.……王子、陛下？\nどうしてそんな上の空な表情を……。:
……Prince, Your Majesty?

m920147.……私の祝福を受けた魚人を、倒した、だと？: ……You defeated the merfolk who received my blessing?
m920147.……話、通じてないみたいですね。\nでも道を開けてくれました！\nこれで神殿の奥:
……It seems he didn't understand a word.

Now we can proceed deeper into the sanctuary!

m920147.あっ、それについてはお任せください！\n水中でも呼吸ができるようになる、\n人魚: Oh, please leave that to us! We will use a secret mermaid magic that allows you to breathe underwater!

Ah, I'll come with you.

Elias, please lend a hand as well.
m920147.あの辺りに陣取られている以上、\n倒して進む以外の選択肢はなさそうです。:

m920147.あまねく海に生きる民は、\nあやつが神の一柱だった頃の被造物なのだよ。\nそして:

m920147.ありえるかもしれません……。\nあちらには天使がついているわけですから。:

I-I mean the great Gilman!

m920147.いったい、天界で何が起きているというのでしょうか。\nまさか深海にまで、天使の手:

m920147.いつも眺めてた海の下が、\nこんなふうになっていたなんて驚きね！:

m920147.うぅぅ、地上って歩いてみたかったんですよね……。\nせっかく人に変身する魔法も覚:

I even learned the magic to transform into a human,

m920147.うぅぅぅ、政治は苦手なんですよぉ……。: Uuuu, I'm just bad at politics...

I'll explain everything in great detail!

m920147.おそらく、仲間を助けるためにここに来た、\nと言っているのではないかと……。: I think he's saying he came here to save his comrades……

m920147.この音色を奏でる魔物がいなくなれば、\n男性も前線で戦えるようになるはずです。\:
Once the monster producing this sound is gone,
the men should be able to fight on the front lines again.
Everyone, please prepare for battle!
m920147.これも敵対する魚人たちの仕業、ということかな。\nさて王子、どう対処――って、ど:
This must be the work of the hostile fishfolk, then.
Now then, Prince, how do we handle this―― wait, what's wrong, Prince?
m920147.こんな所で、いつまでも足止め\nされているわけにもいきませんからね。: We cannot afford to be stalled here any longer.
m920147.さぁさぁ、王子殿下もぉ♪: Come along, come along, Your Highness too♪
m920147.さぁテメェの覚悟はどうだ、テメェの決意はどうだ！\n海じゃサメが最強だってこと、: So, what's your resolve? What's your determination? I'll teach you that the shark is the apex predator of the sea!!
m920147.さぁ喧嘩だ喧嘩！！\n王子ィ、ぶん殴りあおうぜェ！！:
Come on, let's fight, let's fight!!
Prince, let's trade blows!!
m920147.さぁ行きな！\nギガエルの野郎にはオレサマもウンザリしてたんだ。\n一発キツイの: Go on! I was sick of that Gigaer bastard too. Give him a good beating for me!!
m920147.さすがに、海に慣れている子たちは違いますね。\nもうこの風景を楽しんでいるなんて:
It's no surprise the ones used to the sea are handling it so well.
They're already enjoying the scenery.
For me, the fact that I can even breathe is the real miracle.
m920147.さて、そろそろ物資の補給も終わる頃合いだ。\n島に出ている者を船に呼び戻して――:
Right about now, the resupply should be finished.
Recall the men on the island to the ship, and—
m920147.しかも舵を切っても、\nそれに応じて海流が変わるときた。\n船乗りには悪夢のよう:
And no matter how we steer,
the current shifts to match.
It's a nightmare for any sailor.
m920147.すると連中は混乱状態となり、\n勝利は確実なものとなるのだ……。:
That will plunge them into chaos,
and our victory will be assured……
m920147.せっかくの夜を台無しにするとは、\n風情の分からない魔物ですね。:
Ruining such a lovely night,
you truly have no appreciation for atmosphere, you monsters.
m920147.そこで、ここからさらに沖合の島の近くを流れる、\n海底まで一気に流れ込む海流を利:
So, I'll use the current that flows near the island
farther out at sea, plunging straight down to the depths,
to guide you all to the bottom of the sea♪
m920147.そして今、物質界で唯一『神の楔』を\n所持している可能性があるのが、\n深海の王: And now, the only one in the Material World who may possess the "Divine Wedge" is Kraluf, the King of the Deep Sea.
m920147.そのとおり。\n夜とは詩に想いを綴る時なれば。\nさて、皆さんを起こしてきますね:
She's right.
The night is for weaving thoughts into poetry.
Now, I'll go wake everyone else up.
m920147.そのとおりです。今、私たちの国は、\nもうひとつの魚人の国に侵略されていまして。: That is correct. Our nation is currently under invasion by another merfolk country.
m920147.それが普段の小競り合いだったなら、\n私たちの間だけで片付けるべき問題なのですけ: If this were just one of our usual skirmishes, it would be a matter we should settle among ourselves...
m920147.それでは、このお手紙の内容も踏まえて、\nもう少し詳しい事情をうかがっても良いで:
In that case, might we ask for a bit more detail?
Taking the contents of this letter into account,
I'd like to understand the full situation.
m920147.それでは、私は前に出て先導しますね。\n目的地はもうすぐです。警戒しながら進みま:
Then I will take the lead from the front.
We are close to our destination. Let's proceed with caution!
m920147.それではさっそく、部隊をまとめて\n海底へ向かいましょうか。: Then let us gather our troops and head to the ocean floor at once.
m920147.それでは大使さん、\n神殿への案内をお願いできますか？: Then, Ambassador, could you please guide us to the temple?
m920147.それでは皆さんに水中呼吸の魔法をかけますね。: Then I'll cast a water-breathing spell on everyone.
m920147.それなら、敵の妨害部隊が\n揃うより早く動く必要があります。\n陛下、王子、迅速:
If that is the case, we must move
before the enemy's blocking force can assemble.
Your Majesty, Prince, let us head to the target island swiftly.
m920147.それに関しては手がかりがありますので。\n先日漁村の方が届けてくれた、この手紙に:
We do have a lead on that, actually.
A fishing village sent this letter over the other day—
m920147.そんな便利な魔法が！\nそれなら、深海の救援に向かえそうですね。: Such a convenient spell! Then we can head to the deep sea to provide relief.
m920147.だ、だめですローザさん！\nこの先には居住地があるんです。\nここの敵を置いては:
N-No, Roza-san!
There are settlements ahead.
We can't just leave these enemies behind!
m920147.だが……テメェのエラを引っ剥がすのは、\nこの、オレサマだァ……クククッ、ゲハハ:
But…… the one who'll flay your gills off
is me…… Heh heh, hehaha!!
m920147.だが、今は花火大会よりも、\n向こうに見えるもうひとりの私たちの方が\nちょっと:
But right now, the other versions of us over there
might be a bit of an emergency,
more pressing than any fireworks.
m920147.だがそれも、『神の楔』を生み出す権能を奪われ、\nクラールフめが天界を追放される:
But that was until the power to create "Divine Wedges" was stripped from him,
and Kralhu was banished from the Celestial Realm.
Now, I am embraced by a far greater power.
m920147.でっすよね！\nよぉし、クラールフ様の海底神殿はこちらです！\nさぁさぁお早くー:
That's right!
Alright, Lord Kralph's underwater temple is this way!
Come along, come along, hurry up— Wait, what's that?
m920147.でも！ おかげで皆起きてきましたよ？\nさぁ花火です！ 花火大会しましょー！:
But! At least everyone's awake now, right?
Come on, let's have the fireworks! A fireworks festival!
m920147.とはいえ、普段は深海に生きる魚人だ。\nぶん殴ってやれば防御なんて脆いものだろう:
Still, they're fish-folk who live in the deep sea.
A good punch should shatter their defense.
m920147.どうかしましたか？\n……おや？ 向こうに何か見えたような。:
Is something the matter?
……Hm? I think I see something over there.
m920147.どうして……勝てない……のだ……。\nくそっ、撤退だ、撤退するぞ！:
Why…… can't we…… win…….
Damn it, we're retreating! Fall back!
m920147.どこかに強いヤツはいねェのか！\nここはクラールフの神殿なんだろう！？\nもっと: Where are all the strong ones?! This is Clarhf's temple, right?! Get out some better opponents!!
m920147.なるほど……ガリウスを討ち果たしたのは、\n三女神の力によるものだと思っていたが:
I see…… I assumed the slaying of Gallius
was the work of the Three Goddesses…….
It seems I shall have to reconsider my assumptions.
m920147.なるほど……海底への道のようなものですね。: I see... A path to the ocean floor, then.
m920147.なるほど、あなたが大使さんと……。\nでは、このお手紙を漁村の方に託したのは、\:
I see, so you're the ambassador…
Then it was you who entrusted this letter to the fishing village,
correct?
m920147.なれば、神の力無き「亜神」どもが、\n残された『神の楔』を巡って争うのは、\nい:
Therefore, it is inevitable that "demigods" without divine power
would fight over the remaining "Divine Wedges."
m920147.はぁ……はぁ……やっと見つけましたよぉ。\nあなたが英雄王の後継者、王子様ですね:
???: Phew… phew… I finally found you.
You must be the Prince, the successor to the Hero King, right?
m920147.はい。というのも、あちらの部隊の魚人が、\n先日の戦いでこう言っていたんです。: Yes. That is because the merfolk in their forces stated this during the recent battle:
m920147.はいっ！ それから衛兵の方々もこちらへ！\n応急処置程度ですが、手当しますから。:
Yes, sir! And the guards, please come over here!
It's only first aid, but I'll tend to them.
m920147.はっ、私はクラールフ様より、\n王子様の案内をするよう命を受けた使いの者です！:
???: Ah, I am the envoy sent by Lord Kraluf
to guide the Prince!
m920147.ふふっ、誰かの詩ですか？\n貴女が恋のうたとは珍しい。:
Heh, is that a line from a poem?
How unusual for you to sing a song of love.
m920147.ふふふ、私も地上の風景には\nびっくりしましたけどね？\nうぅ、早く陸地をお散歩:
Hehe, I was quite surprised by the scenery on land, too.
Ugh, I can't wait to take a stroll on dry land…
m920147.ふふふふふ、夏の夜、\n皆が寝静まった後に花火大会だと？\nそれはイケナイ刺激に:
Hehehehe. A fireworks festival on a summer night,
after everyone has fallen asleep?
That sounds like a delightfully illicit thrill.
m920147.ほう、人の子にしては頭が回るものよ。\nだが知恵のある有象無象は、極めて目障りだ:
Hm, quite the quick wits for a human.
But clever little insects are a great nuisance.
m920147.まずは深海で起きている事件を\n解決する方が先ですけどね。:
But first, we need to resolve the incident
happening in the deep sea.
m920147.まったく、王子まで……。\nあまり夜ふかししないように\n気をつけてくださいね？:
Honestly, even the Prince…….
Please try not to stay up too late, okay?
m920147.まったくです。\nきっと恋をしたことがないのでしょうね。:
Indeed.
They've probably never been in love.
m920147.もしや、クラールフ殿が我々に救援を求めることに、\n彼らも気付いているのでは？:
Perhaps they are aware that Lord Kraluf
is seeking our aid?
m920147.もちろんです！\nこっちです、ついてきてください！！: Of course! This way, please follow me!!
m920147.やれやれ、メーアはいつも遊んでいるでしょう。\nもしかして今日の目的を、もう忘れ: Oh dear, Meer is always playing around. Have you already forgotten the purpose of today?
m920147.よぉし、これで目的地に進めるね。\nさぁ王子、ガンガン進んじゃおう！:
Alright, we can head to our destination now.
Come on, Prince, let's make some headway!
m920147.よし、この地点は任せたぞ、ローザ。\n王子、ローザは一時的に貴様の指揮下に入る。:
Understood, I'll leave this spot to you, Roza.
Prince, Roza will be under your temporary command.
I leave the orders to you.
m920147.よし、そうと決まれば急ぎ上陸し、\n部隊を展開するぞ。:
Very well. If that's the plan, let's make landfall immediately
and deploy our troops.
m920147.わ、私！ 皆の無事を確認してきます！！: I-I'll go! I'll make sure everyone is safe!!
m920147.わぁっ、人魚さんです！\n本物の人魚さんが現れましたー！！:
Waaah, it's a mermaid!
A real mermaid has appeared—!!
m920147.わざわざ連中の得意な海戦をする必要もあるまい。\nこちらは別の岸から上陸し、\n:
There's no need to fight them on their home turf, in the water.
Let's make landfall from a different shore
and ambush them from the land.
m920147.わわわ……どうしましょうどうしましょう！\n王子様、水中での戦いは初めてですよね:
W-W-Wait… What do we do, what do we do!
Prince, this is your first time fighting underwater, right!?
m920147.ん……あれは……。\nまさかソードギルマン！？:
Hm… is that…
No way, a Sword Gillman!
m920147.んー……困っちゃったねぇ。\n進みたい方向と逆向に海流が動いてるみたいだ。:
Hm…… looks like we're in trouble.
The current is flowing against the direction we want to go.
m920147.アァン！？ 何か言ったかテメェ。\nもう一度オレの種族を言ってみろオラァッ！！:
What?! Did you just say something, you insolent fool?
Say my race again. I dare you!!
m920147.アァン？ オレサマの方が\n速く泳げるに決まってんだろうがッ！！:
Hah? It goes without saying that I, Your Majesty,
swim faster than you, doesn't it!?
m920147.クゥゥ……っ！！\nだが、今回は切り札があるのだ。\n大いなるフェネクスの似姿に:
Kuuu……!!
But this time, we have a trump card.
Tremble before the likeness of the Great Phoenix……!!
m920147.ククッ……王子たちが寝静まった頃を見計らい、\nこうして変身して襲撃する……。:
Kukku…… Once the Princes are fast asleep,
we'll transform and launch our assault……
m920147.クラールフから聞いていないのかね。\nかつての主、クラールフは、\n深海の民を生:
Have you not heard from Kralhu?
My former master, Kralhu,
created me when he brought the people of the Deep Sea into being.
m920147.クラールフはギガエル様が追っています。\n我々の役割はあくまで露払いで――: Clarhf is being pursued by Gigaer. Our role is strictly to clear the path, and――
m920147.クラールフも、神殿に民をかくまい、\n結界を展開して隠れる始末……。:
Kralhu, too, hiding his people in the temple,
setting up barriers to conceal them…
m920147.クラールフ殿も、襲撃を察知して\n即座に神殿へ民を避難させたのだとか。\n被害の:
Lord Kralhu, I hear you sensed the ambush and
immediately ordered the evacuation of the people to the sanctuary.
I believe that quick thinking is why the damage was so minimal.
