m920147.ケッ、溺れる民どもは\nハンマーヘッドシャークも知らねェのか！？\nいいぜ、まず: Tch, do you drowning fools not even know what a hammerhead shark is?! Fine, let me introduce you to this one first!!
m920147.シャァァァァァァァック！！\n気に入ったぜ溺れる民の王子ィ！！:
SHAAAAAAARK!!
I like you, Prince of the Drowning Folk!!
m920147.シャァァァァァァック！！\nそれじゃあオレサマはタダの雑用じゃねェか！！\n馬鹿: Shaaack!! So I'm just some errand runner, huh?! Is that how that damn angel sees me?!
m920147.シャァァァァァァック！！\nテメェは何者だ、王子ィ！！\n深海でサメに勝つなんて: Shaaaaack!! Who are you, Prince?! Beating a shark in the deep sea...!!
m920147.シャァァァァァックッ！！\nいいねェ、いいねェ溺れる民どもォ！！:
SHAAAAAAARK!!
You're good, you're good, you Drowning Folk!!
m920147.シャァァァァック！！\n王子ィ！ ようやく追いついてきやがったなァ！: Shaaack!! Prince! You finally caught up, huh!
m920147.スカー……！\nもう追いついてきたんですか！？:
Scar……!
He's already caught up to us!?
m920147.スカーの部隊が来ます！\nあちらには、見慣れない奇妙な……えぇと、\n頭がハンマ: Scar's unit is approaching! There are some unfamiliar, strange... um, fish with hammer-shaped heads among them!
m920147.世辞はいらぬ。既に知っていようが、\n我は追放された亜神であるがゆえにな。:
No flattery is needed. I am sure you already know,
but I am nothing more than an exiled demigod.
m920147.乾いた地の者たちよ、此度の増援、感謝痛みいる。\n民をひとりも失わずに済んだのは:
People of the dry lands, I am grateful for this reinforcement.
That not a single one of my people was lost is
entirely due to the efforts of the Prince and his companions.
m920147.今はギガエル様率いる魚人軍の兵士です。\nスカー様、それをわきまえてください。:
We are soldiers of the Fish-man army led by Lord Gigaer.
Lord Scar, please keep your position in mind.
m920147.今回の事件を見事解決すれば、\nきっとクラールフ殿も\n地上へ行くのを許してくれ:
If we resolve this incident successfully,
I'm sure Lord Kralph will allow you to visit the surface.
m920147.今回はテメェが勝った！\nだから道を譲ってやるぜッ！！:
You won this time!
So I'll let you pass!!
m920147.何……？ 見間違いではないか？\nソードギルマンは\n深海でしか活動しない魚人だ:
What…? I can't be seeing things.
Sword Gillmans are fish-folk
that only operate in the deep sea.
m920147.何、たとえ海中だろうと、\n私たちのすることは変わらないさ。:
What's the matter? Even if we are underwater,
our duty remains the same.
m920147.何しろ、世界樹の魔物化だけで、\nお前たちの歩みを止められるとは思っていないから:
After all, I do not think the demonification of the World Tree
alone can stop your advance.
m920147.何とか討伐はできましたが……。\n深海にしかいない魚人が現れるなんて、\nいった:
We managed to defeat it, but…
For a fish-folk that only exists in the deep sea to appear here…
what on earth is going on?
m920147.何故もなにも！ こんなロマンティックな夜に\n早く寝ちゃうほうがもったいないじゃ:
Why or what?! It would be a waste
not to stay up on such a romantic night!
m920147.何！？ 連中、船を狙う気か？: What!? Are they aiming for the ship?
m920147.元、魔王軍幹部ですよ。\n先日和解したことも忘れてしまいましたか？: Former executive. Have you forgotten that we reached a reconciliation the other day?
m920147.元より芸術とは心より生まれるもの。\nそこに魔力まで加わっては、\nより一層影響:
Art is born from the heart, after all.
When magic is added to it,
one becomes even more susceptible to its influence.
m920147.先日、クラールフ殿が\n海の下にも国があると話していたな……。\nもしや海底で何:
The other day, Lord Kraluf mentioned
that there is a nation beneath the sea…
Could something be happening down there?
m920147.分かりません……。\nですが、アイギス様たちが力を失っている今でも、\n天使たち:
I don't know…….
But even now that the Aigis have lost their power,
the fact that the angels are scheming in the shadows means…….
m920147.嗚呼……何と完璧な作戦――って、\n貴様ら！ 何故起きているんだ！！:
Ah…… what a flawless plan――wait,
what are you all doing here?! Why are you awake?!
m920147.地上では、いま様々な異変が起きています。\nそしてそれらは、天界による介入による:
On the surface, various anomalies are currently occurring.
And these are the result of interference from the Celestial Realm.
m920147.堕ちた天使には、この愛が分からぬか……。\nまぁよい、いずれお前たちにも、\n深:
A fallen angel cannot understand this love…
Very well. I had intended to attack you as well,
just as I did the Deep Sea.
m920147.堕ちる前の天使とは、神の兵器のようなもの。\nただクラールフから、別の存在へ\n:
An angel before his fall is little more than a weapon of the gods.
It's just that ownership has shifted from Kralhu to another entity, isn't it?
m920147.大群……？ まさかシャークギルマンの部隊が！？: A swarm? Could it be Shark Gillman's troops!?
m920147.天使……ですか……。\nまさか深海にまで、天使が関与しているとは……。: An Angel...? I never imagined the Angel would be involved in the deep sea.
m920147.天使だ亜神だってウンザリしてたんだよ。\nオレサマはテメェみたいな、\n気合の入: I was sick of fighting angels and demigods. I wanted to fight a warrior with real spirit, like you!!
m920147.天界に行く手段を探していると、\n我はそう聞いたが、相違ないか？\n何故人の領域:
I was told you are seeking a means to reach the Celestial Realm.
Is that correct?
Why do you seek to venture beyond the domain of man?
m920147.天界の……争い、ですか……？: A strife… in the Celestial Realm?
m920147.存外歯ごたえのない連中だったが、\nやはり本隊はあちらということか。: They were less of a challenge than expected, but it seems the main force is over there.
m920147.幸いにして、我はかつて生み出した、\n最後の『神の楔』をこの神殿に残している。\:
Fortunately, I have left the last "Divine Wedge" I ever created
here in this sanctuary.
This wedge must be used to protect the people, but――
m920147.怯える必要はない、人の子よ。\n天界で何が起きているのか、\nそれすら知らぬまま:
There is no need to fear, children of men.
You may vanish into the Deep Sea without even knowing
what is transpiring in the Celestial Realm.
m920147.意外と話の通じる魚人でしたね。\nさぁ王子、クラールフ殿のところへ急いで――: That fish-man was surprisingly reasonable. Now then, Prince, let's hurry to Lord Clarhf's side――
m920147.我々物質界の者が天界の障壁を超えるには、\n『神の楔』の力が不可欠だと判明しまし: It has been determined that for us of the Material World to surpass the barrier of the Celestial Realm, the power of the "Divine Wedge" is indispensable.
m920147.我らだけでは、あの傷ありのシャークギルマンに\n勝てないと判断されたと、そういう:
He judged that we could not defeat that wounded Shark Gilman
on our own, is that it…
Then… Prince! Show us your true strength!
m920147.方角はあちらの方ですね……。\nあの土煙……た、大変です！\n魔物がこちらへ進軍:
The direction is over there…
That dust cloud… oh no, this is bad!
A horde of monsters is marching toward us!
m920147.本当ですか！？\nふふふっ、やりました！ 地上デビューです！:
Really!?
Hehehe, I did it! It's my debut on land!
m920147.次はもっと痛いぜェ！？\nテメェのパワーはどうだ、テメェの魂はどうだ！\n付いて:
Next time it'll hurt even more!
How's your power? How's your soul?
Keep up with this, my destructive power!!
m920147.水中を自在に泳ぐ我ら魚人が勝つか、\n乾いた地の人間たちが勝つか、それをもって\:
Whether we fish-folk, who swim freely in the water, prevail,
or the humans of the dry land do,
let that decide whether we trust in you, Prince.
m920147.海底のことも地上のことも、\nあちらには筒抜けというわけですね。:
So they have eyes and ears everywhere,
whether on the seafloor or on the surface.
m920147.海流が変わった……わけでもないし、\n海の温度に変化があるわけでもない、か……。:
The currents haven't changed…
and there's no shift in the water temperature, either…
m920147.然り。我は、もはや天界に興味などない。\nただ、愛しき深海の民を守ることだけが、:
Indeed. I have no interest in the Celestial Realm anymore.
All I desire, as a demigod, is to protect the people of the Deep Sea I love.
m920147.王子、あっちにはソードギルマンがいるよ。\n地上とは違って本来の力を発揮してくる:
Prince, there are Sword Gillmans over there.
Unlike on land, they should be able to use their full power,
so please be careful not to let your guard down!
m920147.王子、この『神の楔』があれば、\n天界に張り巡らされた障壁を突破できるはずです。:
Prince, with this "Divine Wedge,"
we should be able to break through the barriers surrounding the Celestial Realm.
m920147.王子、ひとまず神殿の奥へ向かいましょう。\nクラールフ殿なら、何か知っているかも:
Prince, let us head to the inner sanctum of the temple for now.
Lord Kralhu might know something.
m920147.王子、先程のソードギルマンも\n敵の中に混じっているようです。\n慎重な指揮をお:
Prince, it seems the Swordfishman from earlier
is mixed in with the enemies.
Please exercise caution in your command!!
--- scene: Swordfishmen Blocking Departure (battle, end) ---
m920147.王子、魚人たちの様子がおかしいです。\nギガエルが姿を見せてから、\n動きがさら:
Prince, the merfolk are acting strangely.
Ever since Gigael showed himself,
they've become even more active!
m920147.王子、魚人部隊の鎮圧完了だ。\nスカーは神殿の方に向かったみたいだな。:
Prince, the Fish-man unit has been suppressed.
It looks like Scar has headed toward the temple.
m920147.王子よ、交換条件とはなってしまうが、\n汝の力を、今こそ貸してくれぬだろうか。:
Prince, it is a matter of terms, but
would you lend me your strength now?
m920147.男を腑抜けにする音色か、バカにしやがって。\nこっちにはめちゃくちゃ強ェオンナが:
A tune that turns men into wimps, huh? Don't get cocky.
Let's show them just how fierce a woman can be.
m920147.畜生……全部出しきっちまった……。\n今のオレサマじゃ、テメェに勝てねェってこと: Dammit... I've used everything I've got... It seems I can't beat you in my current state.
m920147.確か、いただいたお手紙は、\n王国と帝国への救援要請でしたね。: If I recall correctly, the letter we received was a request for aid from the Kingdom and the Empire.
m920147.確か、海の命を司る、と言っていましたね。\nあの天使が魚人に祝福を与えているのか:
I believe he said he governs the life of the sea.
Perhaps that angel is bestowing his blessing upon the merfolk.
m920147.確かに……。多少は潜水もできますが、\n水の中でそんなに長く息を止めていられませ: Indeed... We can hold our breath for a short while, but we cannot stay underwater for long.
m920147.練度が低いとは言っても、\nまだ新手がこちらへ向かってきています。\n数で押され: Even if their training is lacking, fresh troops are still heading this way. We can't afford to be overwhelmed by numbers.
m920147.自然現象が原因でないというなら、\nソードギルマンの出現には、\n何者かの思惑が:
If it's not a natural phenomenon,
then someone must be behind
the Sword Gillman's appearance.
m920147.船が無くては沖に出られません。\nここは私が支えますので、\n急いで防備を固めて:
Without the ship, we can't head out to sea.
I'll hold this position, so
hurry and strengthen your defenses!
m920147.良かろう。\nクラールフ様は神殿の奥だ。我らが案内し――:
Very well.
Lord Claraf is deep within the temple. We shall guide you—
m920147.迅速に敵を鎮圧し、その後全速力で進軍ですね。\n王国も帝国も、地上で転戦には慣れ:
Quickly suppress the enemy, then advance at full speed.
Both the Kingdom and the Empire are used to fighting on land.
m920147.道！ 地上にあるという、\n平らな地面のことですね！:
A path! You mean that flat ground
that exists on the surface!
m920147.魔法が効果を発揮したら、\nまずはクラールフ様の神殿へ向かいます。\n良いですか:
Once the spell takes effect,
we'll head to Kraluf's temple first.
Understood? Please focus your minds……!
m920147.魚人の戦士のくせに、飼いならされやがって……。\nおい王子！ 神殿を潰したら戻っ:
Fish-man warriors, yet you let yourselves be tamed……
Hey, Prince! I'll be back after I wreck the temple!
m920147.魚人の部隊、撤退していきます。\nお疲れさまです、王子。:
The Swordfishmen's forces are retreating.
Good work, Prince.
m920147.（……ちっ、これだからギルマンは）\n――スカー様、あなたの役割は\nクラールフ:
(……Tch, this is why Gillmans are……)
—Lord Scar, wasn't your role supposed to be
the assault on Claraf's temple?
m920147.（くっ……噂に聞いてはいたが、\nこれがギルマンの凶暴な希少種、\nシャークギル:
(Tch…… I'd heard the rumors, but
so this is the fierce, rare variant of the Gilman,
a Shark Gilman warrior……)
m920147.（ちっ……面倒だなこいつ）: (Tch... What a pain this guy is)
m920147.（本来なら我らの方が、\nギルマンを従える種族だというのに……！！）:
(We're the ones who should be the ones
commanding the Gilman, not the other way around……!!)

m920170.――あっ、ふたりとも、\nここにいると危ないよ……？:
—Ah, you two,
it's dangerous to be here…
m920170.――いやぁ、本当にありがとうございます。\n魔物が出てきた時には、\nもう一巻の:
Merchant?: ――Oh, thank you so much.
When those monsters showed up,
I thought it was all over for us――Hiiyaa!?
m920170.――おっとぉ、お前の顔は知ってるぜ。\n天才軍師ヘレナちゃんじゃァないか。:
――Oh, I recognize you.
You're the genius strategist, Helena, aren't you?
m920170.――おーい、ヘレナー？\nあっ、いたいた！ 街のガキたちが呼んでたぞ？:
―Hey, Helena? 
Ah, there you are! The kids in the town were calling for you!
m920170.――そう、のんきに遠征なんかに出てるから、\n王都にはもうすぐ、虐殺と破壊が蔓延:
And because you're out here on some leisurely expedition,
the capital will soon be overrun by slaughter and destruction.
m920170.――それはもう済ませてあるぞ。\n工場所属の社員総出で\n梱包済みの箱をひっくり:
――We've already taken care of that.
We had the entire factory staff
turn over all the packed boxes.
m920170.――だがなァ、クリスマスパーティは、\nここ――からが――本番――:
―But the real Christmas party 
starts… now…
m920170.――どこまでも、混乱ばかりを好む男だな。\n困ったものだ、本当に。:
――A man who loves nothing but chaos, no matter where he goes.
He's truly a headache.
m920170.――なに？\n我が新おもちゃ工場から発送した箱に、\n機械の部品が混入されていた:
――What?
You're saying machine parts were mixed in with the boxes
we shipped from our new toy factory?
m920170.――はぁ、どうにかクリスマス前に\n王国に戻ってこられたなぁ。: ――Phew, I managed to make it back to the kingdom before Christmas.
m920170.――むっ、そこの作業員どこへいく。\n倉庫はそちらではないぞ？\n……いや待て、:
――Hah? Where do you think you're going, worker?
The warehouse isn't that way, is it?
……No, wait. I don't recognize your face.
m920170.――よぉ、その続きを聞かせてくれよ。: ――Yo. Go on, tell me the rest.
m920170.――よし、まだメカドラゴンは完成していないようだ。\n市街のどこかに、\n連中が:
――Alright, it seems the Mech Dragon isn't finished yet.
They must be moving parts in somewhere in the city…
m920170.――よし、頭部装甲も梱包完了っと。\nこれでフォー様に殺されることはないだろう…:
――Alright, head armor packaging complete.
With this, Four won't be able to kill me……
m920170.――以上が、闇の組織の調査結果だ。\nアイリーンの情報網でも、\n幹部連中の行方:
―That's the result of our investigation into the Dark Organization. 
Even with Irene's information network, 
we can't seem to track down the whereabouts of the executives.
m920170.――否、頼れるものは金と技術のみに候。: —No, I am reliable only in gold and technology.
m920170.――断固拒否、だ。\n我が知略は王子の目指す未来のためにある。:
――I refuse, flatly.
My intellect exists for the future the Prince seeks.
m920170.――然り。\n先刻ぶりの再会にござるな。:
―Indeed. 
What a reunion, so soon after we last met.
m920170.――現地で組み立てるつもり、ってことか。\nまずい……まずいぞ王子。:
—so he plans to assemble it on-site.
This is bad…… really bad, Prince.
m920170.――見事なり。\nされど気をつけられよ、爆死の危機は常に足元にあるのだ。:
—Well done.
But be careful. The danger of an explosion is always lurking at your feet.
m920170.……あ、あれ？\nどうして私の名前を……。:
……Ah, what?
Why did you call me…
m920170.……あっ、それなら、\n休憩ついでにホットチョコレートでもどうでしょう？:
……Ah, in that case,
how about some hot chocolate for a break?
m920170.……あっ、本当だ。\nしかもこの塗装、暗黒メカドラゴンの後継機かも。:
……Ah, that's right.
And judging by the paint job, this might be the successor to the Dark Mech Dragon.
m920170.……あっ。います、よね。\n闇の組織に協力している、機械に精通した人……。:
…Ah. There is. 
Someone well-versed in machinery who's cooperating with the Dark Organization…
m920170.……いいのか？\nデーモンシェフ、ここで工場を止めたら、\nお前たちの損害も大き:
……Are you sure about that?
Demon Chef, if you shut down the factory now,
the damage to your business would be considerable.
m920170.……いや、ヘレナ。\nどうやら探している暇はなさそうだぞ。アレを見ろ！:
……No, Helena.
It looks like we don't have time to search. Look at that!
m920170.……このフォーも人形か。\nしかし、一号機だと……？:
…So Fo is a puppet too. 
But Unit One…?
m920170.……これも人形、か。\nフォーの本体はどこにいるんだかな……。:
……So, this one was a puppet, too.
I wonder where Fo's main body is hiding……
m920170.……すみません、セブン様、アイリーンの姐さん。\nでも俺、死にたくなくて、怖くて:
……I'm sorry, Seven-sama, and Aileen's sister.
But I was scared. I really didn't want to die……
m920170.……そっか。\nうん、戦いは終わらなくても、\n一時の安寧を勝ち取ったのは、立派:
……I see.
Yeah, even if the war isn't over,
securing a moment of peace is a worthy victory.
m920170.……でも、クリスマスはちゃんと守ったよ？\nほら、あっちの家の窓見てみて♪:
……But we did manage to protect Christmas, right?
Look, check out that house over there♪
m920170.……はぁ、潰しても潰してもきりがないな。\n先日も闇の組織の拠点を制圧したってい:
……Hah, you can crush them all you want, there's no end to it.
We just took down one of the Dark Organization's bases the other day, too.
m920170.……ふぅ、あいつはセブンに任せておいて大丈夫そうだな。\nあとは工場内で、もう梱:
……Phew. I think he's in good hands with Seven.
Now, all we need to do is find the mechanical parts
that are already packed inside the factory――
m920170.……ふふっ、あははっ！\nそうだな、さすがデーモンシェフ、\nこちらが学ばされた:
……Heh, haha!
I see. As expected of the Demon Chef,
you've taught me a lesson.
m920170.……まさか、この街に吹雪が来るのか！？: ……No way. A blizzard is hitting the city?!
m920170.……ガキたちに、悲しい顔させるわけにゃいかねぇよな。\nツリーを守れるのは、アタ:
……We can't let the kids down.
We're the only ones who can protect those trees!
m920170.……セブンとアイリーンの名前を出した上でも、\nまだ離反できない程の恐怖を植え付:
……Even after I brought up Seven and Aileen's names,
he's still too terrified to defect.
m920170.……ハハッ、ますます気に入った。\n絡繰り忍者ァ！ ブラックメカドラゴンを出せ！:
……Hah, I like you more and more.
Karakuri Ninja!
Bring out the Black Mech Dragon!!
m920170.……フォー様、王都から連絡です。\n例のメカドラゴンの組み立て、\nパーツが足り:
……Master Fo, we have a report from the capital.
Assembly of that Mech Dragon
is running into trouble because parts are missing.
m920170.……大丈夫だ、王子。\n王都の方角からは、火の手も\nあがっていないし、伝令だっ:
……It's fine, Prince.
There's no sign of fire from the direction of the capital,
and no messengers have arrived.
m920170.……心当たりがあるぞ。\nしばらく前に、工場に盗人が入ったのだ。:
……I have a feeling I know what this is.
A while back, someone broke into the factory.
m920170.……悪趣味だな。\nだが、その凶行は止めさせてもらおう。:
……What a sick taste.
But I intend to stop this atrocity.
m920170.……時間稼ぎをするつもりか。\n王子、ミニメカドラゴンを強行突破するぞ！:
……Are they trying to buy time?
Prince, let's force our way through the Mini Mech Dragons!
m920170.……王子、ブラックメカドラゴンだけでなく、\n市街にはフォーの人形が放たれている:
……Prince, reports indicate that in addition to the Black Mech Dragon,
Fo's puppets have been deployed in the city.
m920170.……王子、周囲に変異した魔物が展開している。\n連中はすぐに傷を再生してしまう。:
……Prince, mutated monsters are deploying around us.
They regenerate their wounds instantly.
If we don't use enough firepower, we'll be worn down.
m920170.……闇ギルド時代が懐かしいな。\nナイン様の下で働いてた時は、\n危なっかしいけ:
……I miss the days with the Dark Guild.
When I worked under Nine,
it was risky, but every day was fun……
m920170.あぁ？ どうかしたのか？\n人の顔見て変な声だしやがって。:
Huh? What's wrong?
Don't make weird noises just because someone's looking at you.
m920170.ああ、それもパーツが外れたって感じじゃない。\n何かの巨大な機械の一部だけが\n:
Yes, and it's not like the parts were just loose.
A piece of some massive machine was packed
inside a box of Christmas presents.
m920170.ああ、クリスマスプレゼントの箱の中には\n雪の国製のおもちゃが入っていたんだけど: Ah, yes. Inside the Christmas gift boxes were toys made in Snowland, but some unknown mechanical components had been mixed in with them.
m920170.あっ、こら待ちやがれ！\nてめぇ何か隠してるだろ！:
Ah, hold on, you there!
You've got something hidden on you, don't you!
m920170.あの時は何も盗まれなくて良かったと思ったのだが……。\nもしや設計図を写していっ:
I was relieved nothing was stolen back then, but……
Could it be that they copied the blueprints?!
m920170.あれって、ミニメカドラゴンのおもちゃ！？\nうぅぅ、おもちゃを悪事に使うなんてー:
Is that a Mini Mech Dragon toy?!
Ugh, using toys for evil deeds…!
m920170.あれは……商人の荷馬車か？\nまずいな、魔物に襲われているようだ！: Is that…… a merchant's wagon? This is bad, it looks like they're being attacked by monsters!
m920170.あー、そうだっけ？\nいいんだよ、細かいことはサァ。:
Oh, right?
Whatever, let's not get into the details.
m920170.あーあ、この人形も――そろそろ終わりか――。\nあばよ王子ィ、次はもっと――楽し:
Aaah, this puppet is――time to say goodbye, I guess.
Bye-bye, Prince. Next time, I'll make this even more――fun.
m920170.あーあーあー、聞こえるかなァ？\nどうだい、驚いたかァ！？:
Can you hear me, you lot? 
How about that, surprised?
m920170.い、いえっ、ですが足りない部品は――: N-no, sir, but the missing parts are—
m920170.い、言えない……言えば俺たちも殺されちまう……。: I, I can't say…… If I tell you, they'll kill us……
m920170.いいねぇ、クリスマスの前祝いってやつだな！: Sounds good. A Christmas pre-party, huh!
m920170.いいんだ。\n今の組織が、闇ギルドの頃とは\n別物だってことは知ってるからな。:
It's fine.
I know the current organization is nothing like the Dark Guild.
m920170.いえ、捕らえた構成員も口を割りません。\nどうやら私よりも怖い上司がいるようで。: No, the captured members won't say a word. It seems they have a boss who's even more frightening than I am.
m920170.いや、ヘレナ殿、それでは駄目なのだ。\nデモシェフ商会は安心と信頼でなりたってい:
No, Helena, that won't do.
The Demon Chef Trading Company is built on peace of mind and trust.
m920170.うん、そういうことにしておこう。\nしかし困ったものだね、闇の組織には。: Right, let's go with that. But this is quite a predicament. The dark organization is really causing us trouble.
m920170.うん、王子たち、呼んでくるね。: Okay, I'll call the Prince and the others.
m920170.うん。\nそれで、街の皆に避難してって伝えてたんだ。:
Yes.
So, I've been telling everyone to evacuate.
m920170.うーん、もしかして、なんだけど……。\nこれってメカドラゴンシリーズじゃないかな:
Hmm, I think……
Aren't these from the Mech Dragon series?
m920170.えぇ、直接の面識はありませんが、\nおそらく闇の組織の構成員でしょう。:
Yes, I have no personal acquaintance with them,
but they are likely members of a criminal organization.
m920170.おいおい、口だけか絡繰り忍者ァ。\nお前の本当の力は、そんなもんじゃないだろォ！:
Huh? That's all you've got, Karakuri Ninja?
I thought you had more tricks up your sleeve!
m920170.おいおい、自分の人気くらい把握しておけよ。\n街をぶっ壊そうとした巨大兵器を、\:
Hey, hey, you should know your own popularity. 
You're the genius tactician who crushed the giant weapon 
that tried to wreck the town with your wits!
m920170.おいおいおい、何だよあれ！\nおもちゃってサイズじゃねぇぞ！:
Hey, hey, hey, what is that thing!
That's no toy-sized thing!
m920170.おっ……えーっと、テュトおばあちゃん、だっけか？\nアタシの飾り付けもなかなかの:
Oh… um, Grandma Tytto, right?
My decorations are pretty nice too, huh♪
m920170.おっ、いいねぇ。\nおーいユキヒメー！\n一緒におやつの時間にしようぜー！:
Oh, that sounds good.
Hey, Yukihime!
Let's make it a snack break!
m920170.おっと！ そんなことより！\nクリスマスツリーに興味があるなら、\n一緒に飾り付:
Oh, well! That aside!
If you're interested in the Christmas trees,
how about we decorate one together?
m920170.おもちゃが壊れて、\n部品が飛び出していたんじゃなくて？: Aren't they just parts that flew out because the toys broke?
m920170.おや、シプリアさん、\nクリスマスのご予定があるんですか？: Oh, Cypria, do you have any plans for Christmas?
m920170.おやつ……？\nうんっ、それじゃあ王子たちも誘おう？:
A snack…?
Yes! Then let's invite the Prince and the others, too?
m920170.お任せを。\nすでに配下の者たちが追跡を開始しています。:
Consider it done.
My subordinates have already begun tracking them.
m920170.かつての闇ギルド――行き場のない者たちの\n相互互助を担っていた組織の面影はどこ:
They bear no resemblance to the old Dark Guild――an organization that once provided mutual aid to those with nowhere else to go.
They are a gathering of vicious criminals.
m920170.ぎくっ……い、いえ、\n実は今日から配属になったばかりで……。:
G-Guh…… I, I'm sorry,
but I was just assigned here today……
m920170.くっ……このままでは、\nクリスマス・デストロイ作戦が……ぐふっ……。:
Grr…… If this goes on,
the Christmas Destroyer Operation is…… *gasp*……
m920170.くっ……しかし……。\nだめだっ、俺は死にたくない！\nあいつは――フォーはどこ:
Grrr…… But……
No! I don't want to die!
He'll―― Four will chase me to the ends of the earth!!
m920170.くりすます・ですとろい作戦……？\n例の機械部品で、いったい何をするつもりなんだ:
The Christmas Destroyer Operation……?
What on earth are you planning to do with those machine parts!
m920170.こう見えて、社員の顔と名前は全員覚えているのだ。\nたとえ今日から配属になった社:
Despite how I look, I know the face and name of every single employee.
Even if they started today.
m920170.これは、王国の民を守るための戦いだ。\n王子、悪の芽をここで摘み取るぞ！:
This is a battle to protect the people of the kingdom.
Prince, we'll crush this evil at its roots!
m920170.これは子どもたちを守ると同時に、\n社員の生活を守るために、絶対に必要な調査なの:
This investigation is absolutely essential.
It protects the children, and it protects our employees' livelihoods.
m920170.さすがだデーモンシェフ！\nふむ……これが見つかった部品か……。:
As expected, Demon Chef!
Hmm…… so these are the parts we found……
m920170.しかし、そのうぶさに免じて答えてやろう。\n我が主は元よりフォー殿にござる。\n:
However, I shall answer you, out of pity for your innocence.
My master has always been Lord Fo.
—and now, I intend to carry out that contract.
m920170.しかし、興味深い。\n王子の可能性をどこまで引き出すか、\n――フォーにはまだ、:
And yet, he is interesting.
How far can I push the Prince's potential?
――It seems Fo still has some use left in him.
m920170.そ、それも大変だけどさ、\nあいつの出力、普通よりも高くなってるみたいだよ！\n:
T-That's bad enough, but 
it looks like its output is higher than usual! 
It might attack with more than double the power…!
m920170.そうそう、いつも気を抜いたところに\nとんでもない大事件が――ですわ？: That's right, the biggest disasters always happen when we're letting our guard down――isn't it?
m920170.そうだなァ……。\nお前をバラして部品にしてやろうかァ。:
How about this…….
I'll take you apart and use you as a spare part.
m920170.そのとおりです。\n遠征帰りとはいえ、気を抜いていると\nたいてい困った事態に繋: He's right. Even if we're just back from an expedition, letting our guard down usually leads to trouble.
m920170.そもそも幹部の情報を与えていないなら、\nどれだけ絞っても上にはたどり着けないで:
Besides, if they're not giving up any information about the executives,
no matter how hard we squeeze, we'll never reach the top.
m920170.それからテュトばあちゃん、\n吹雪の中じゃ遠くを狙いにくくなっちまう。\n射程に:
And Grandpa Tytto,
long-range shots are tough in a blizzard.
Watch your range out there!
m920170.それにフォー、お前ごときの才覚じゃ、\nこの頭脳を使いこなせるとは思えないなッ！:
Besides, Fo, I can't imagine someone with your limited abilities
could possibly make use of a mind like mine!!
m920170.それより準備は終わったんだろうな。\nブラックメカドラゴンの量産計画はァ。:
More importantly, the preparations are done, right?
The mass production plan for the Black Mech Dragons.
m920170.そんな……それじゃあ、\nせっかく飾り付けたツリーが……。: What…? Then the trees we just decorated…
m920170.そんな馬鹿な……。\n弊社でもまだ、試作の段階なのだぞ……？\n闇の組織に、そん:
That can't be… 
Even our company is still in the prototype stage…? 
Someone in the Dark Organization with that kind of processing technology…
m920170.ちっ！ てめぇら、脱出するぞ！: Tch! You guys, we're making a break for it!
m920170.つまらぬ情報共有は終わったか？\nなれば、戦と参ろうか。:
Is that all the useless information you have to share?
If so, let us begin the battle.
m920170.では、まずは雪の国の調査ですね。\n準備ができ次第出発しましょう。: Then, let's start with the investigation in Snowland. We'll depart as soon as we're ready.
m920170.でも、こちらも後手に回るばかりじゃない。\n真偽はこれから確認するところだが、\:
But we're not just reacting to their moves. 
We still need to verify the details, 
but we've heard of an executive above Fo.
m920170.ともかく、工場内の調査を続けようか。\nまだ闇の組織の構成員が潜んでいるかもしれ:
In any case, let's continue the factory inspection.
There may still be Dark Organization members hiding here.
m920170.どうだ、俺の部下にならないか。\n俺はなァ、頭のいいヤツが好きなんだ。\nゴブリ:
How about it? Want to work for me?
I love smart people.
That brain of yours, which can turn even goblins into a disciplined army――
m920170.どこまでも冷静だねぇ……。\n――まぁそれなら、契約を果たしてもらおうか。\n絡:
You're always so calm…….
—Well then, let's fulfill our contract.
Karakuri Ninja, intercept them.
m920170.どこまで俺をイラつかせるんだ！\n王子っ、ハハハッ、憎みすぎて愛しちまいそうだ！:
How much longer do you intend to get on my nerves?!
Prince, hahaha, I hate you so much I might just start loving you!!
m920170.なぁ王子ィ……去年の屈辱、忘れるものかよォ……。\n俺のクリスマス爆破作戦を邪魔:
Hey, Prince…… I'm not about to forget last year's humiliation.
The price for interfering with my Christmas bombing plan
will be paid by your cute little citizens.
m920170.なっ……それをどうして――\nいや、なんでもない、なんでもないぞ、うん。: W-What do you mean―― No, it's nothing, it's nothing, okay.
m920170.なっ……セブン様……！？\n……いけません、ナイン様のご友人と言えど、\nこれを:
W-What…… Seven……!?
……I can't. Even if you're Nine's friend,
if I tell you this, my life is in danger……
m920170.なっ……抜け駆けする気か！？: Wha… You're trying to cut in line?!
m920170.なっ……絡繰り忍者さんがどうして……。\nまさか闇の組織に雇われたんですか！？:
Wh-what…… why is the Karakuri Ninja…….
Could it be that they were hired by the Dark Organization?!
m920170.なるほど、武器に毒を塗っているんだろうな。\n火薬は――つまり撃破されたら、\n:
I see. They've likely coated the weapons in poison. 
And the gunpowder… meaning if it's destroyed, 
it's meant to self-destruct and take the surroundings down with it.
m920170.なるほどな……。\n積荷をあらためる必要がありそうだ。\n逃げた連中の捕縛は任せ:
I see……
It seems we'll need to inspect the cargo.
Can I leave the capture of the fleeing men to you?
m920170.なるほどね……分かってきたぞ……。\nフォーは王国の警備を抜けるために、\nわざ:
I see…… I'm starting to get it…….
Fo dismantled the parts to slip past the kingdom's security,
and hid them among the presents—
m920170.なんだ、この音は……。\n何か巨大なものの羽ばたきのような……。:
What is that sound…?
It sounds like the wings of something huge…
m920170.なんだい、絡繰り忍者、\nこいつらと知り合いだったのか？:
Well, well, Karakuri Ninja.
So you know these people?
m920170.はぁ……悪い、ヘレナ。\n交渉決裂みたいだ。:
Haa…… Sorry, Helena.
Looks like negotiations are over.
m920170.はっ！ デモシェフ商会全社に通達いたします！: Yes sir! I'll issue a company-wide notice to the Demon Chef Trading Company!
m920170.ははぁーん、その顔は\nクリスマスの限定ケーキを楽しみにしている顔ですねぇ？: Hah-hoo, that face of yours is the face of someone looking forward to the limited-edition Christmas cake, isn't it?
m920170.ひぃぃっ！？\nせ、セブンに、アイリーンまで……！？:
Merchant?: Hiiiii!?!
S-Seven, and now Irene too……!?
m920170.ひぇぇ、吹雪のせいで\n身体が冷えちまったぜ。:
Brrr… my body's freezing
from all this wind.
m920170.ひっ……ぶ、部品は他の箇所から代用します！\nそれではっ、お、俺は警備に戻ります:
E-eh…… I'll substitute the parts from elsewhere!
I-I'm heading back to my post now!!
m920170.ふふ、それもそうね。\n――でも、それならいったい何の部品なのかしら？: Heh, fair point. ――But then, what kind of parts are they?
m920170.へっへ、休憩したら\n飾り付けもラストスパートだ。\nガキたちのキラキラした顔が:
Heh heh, once we're done resting,
it's the final push on the decorations.
I can already picture those kids' shining faces♪
m920170.まったく、王国の警備もハリボテだなァ。\n子どもたちへのプレゼントですって\n顔:
Honestly, the kingdom's security is a joke.
All it takes is a smile and a line about “presents for the children”
to smuggle in a giant weapon.
m920170.みんな、急いで撤退しろ！\n爆発に巻き込まれるぞ！:
Everyone, retreat immediately!
We'll get caught in the blast!
m920170.みんなヘレナの演説を聞きたいって言ってたぜ？\n王子を支える腕利き軍師の言葉、\:
Everyone says they want to hear Helena give a speech!
Come on, don't keep them waiting.
As the Prince's brilliant strategist, you've got to tell them what's on your mind♪
m920170.む、むむ……よし、そういうことなら仕方ない！\nでも、それなら王子の演説も必要だ:
M-Mm… Fine, if that's what you want, I suppose I have no choice!
But wait, doesn't that mean the Prince needs to give a speech too?
m920170.むっ……むむむっ、それは由々しき事態だ！\n良い子が怪我でもしたら大変だぞ！:
Hmph…… Hmph, this is a serious situation!
If a good child gets hurt, it'll be a disaster!
m920170.やめっ……くそっ、てめぇら逃げろ！\nこの事を上に伝えるんだ！:
Merchant?: Stop it…… Dammit, run, you two!
Report this to your superiors!
m920170.やれやれ……どこまでも念入りな嫌がらせだな！\n王子、迅速にこいつらを撃破して、:
Good grief… What a thorough piece of harassment! 
Prince, let's destroy these quickly 
and arrest Fo on the spot!
m920170.やれやれ、クリスマス直前だからと\nみんな浮かれすぎだぞ。: Oh, come now. Everyone's getting too excited because Christmas is just around the corner.
m920170.よぉし、そうと決まれば、\n次はそっちの角に立ってるツリーを――:
Alright, since that's settled,
next up is the tree standing on that corner over there—
m920170.よく見分けがつきますね……。\n――って、そういえばメカドラゴンのおもちゃは、\:
You have a good eye for that……
――Wait, I remember now.
Weren't the Mech Dragon toys made at Demon Chef's factory?
m920170.よし、それじゃあ私は荷馬車の中身をっと……。\nクリスマスプレゼントの箱に、お菓:
Good. Then I'll check the contents of the wagon……
Boxes of Christmas presents, sweets,
and this is――Hm? What is this!?
m920170.よし、王子、デーモンシェフ、\n急いで工場内の調査を進めよう。:
Very well, Prince, Demon Chef,
let's hurry and begin the factory inspection.
m920170.よし王子、胸を張って凱旋するぞ！\n街の人々を安心させるのも、軍の役目だからな！:
Alright, Prince, let's return in triumph!
Reassuring the people is part of a military's duty, after all!
m920170.わぁっ、素敵なクリスマスツリーがいっぱい♪\nあちらにも、こちらにも♪:
Whoa, so many lovely Christmas trees♪
Over there, and over here too♪
m920170.ん、あると言えばあるし、\nないと言えばないというか……。: Well, you could say I do, and you could say I don't……
m920170.んっ？ ユキヒメじゃねぇか。\nいったいどうしたって言うんだ？:
Hm? It's Yukihime.
What's the matter?
m920170.んー……王国の技師でも判断できないらしい。\nおそらく巨大な何かのいち部分なんだ: Hmm…… Apparently, even the kingdom's engineers can't identify them. They're probably a piece of some massive something, but…… ――Irene, did you find out anything on your end?
m920170.アイリーンより怖い上司か……。\nちょっと想像したくな――いや、うん、何でもない: A boss scarier than Irene…… I'd rather not imagine――No, forget it, it's nothing.
m920170.アーッハッハッハッハッ！！\nやるじゃないか！\n一号機を破壊するなんてなぁ！！:
AHAHAHAHAHA! 
Well done! 
To destroy Unit One!
m920170.ギャハハハハハハッ！！\nあーあ、負けたッ！ また負けたァ！！:
GYAHHAHAHAHA!!
Aaah, I lost! I lost again!!
m920170.ゴーレム……にも似てるけど、\nもっと魔術より機械寄りのパーツに見えるね。:
They look a bit like golems,
but they seem more mechanical than magical.
m920170.ゴーレムには魔導技術が必須ですからね。\nとなると、これは何の部品なのでしょうか:
Golems require magitech, after all.
So what kind of parts are these, I wonder?
m920170.セブン、あなたが凄んでどうするのですか。\nすみません、旅のお方。\nどうやら怖:
Seven, what's the point of glaring at him?
I'm sorry, traveler.
It seems we've frightened you.
m920170.セブンとアイリーンを知っている、か。\n……アイリーン、こいつらはまさか。:
So he knows Seven and Irene.
……Irene, could it be that they're…
m920170.デーモンシェフが極秘プロジェクトだって言ってた、\n最凶の漆黒竜、ブラックメカド:
The Demon Chef said it was a top-secret project…
The most fearsome jet-black dragon, the Black Mech Dragon――toy?!
m920170.デーモンシェフは作業員の避難を！\n王子、構成員どもを一網打尽にするぞ！:
Demon Chef, evacuate the workers!
Prince, let's round up the members!
m920170.ドラゴン……いや違う、\nこの機械音は……まさか、間に合わなかったのか！？:
A dragon… no, that's not it.
That mechanical sound… could it be… we're too late?!
m920170.ハァ……これだからクズってのは使いにくい……。\n頼れるのはお前だけだよ、絡繰り:
Haa…… that's why scum like you are useless.
You're the only one I can rely on, Karakuri Ninja.
m920170.フォーの人形は、操作している本体を叩けば沈黙する。\n王子、雑魚ばかりに気を取ら:
Fo's puppets will fall silent if you strike the main body controlling them.
Prince, be careful not to get distracted by the minor threats.
m920170.ブラックメカドラゴンのおもちゃを\nまだどこかに隠している、のか……？:
He's still hiding the Black Mech Dragon toy 
somewhere…?
m920170.ユキヒメ、軍の連中に伝えてくれ！\n一緒にガキの笑顔を守ろうってな！:
Yukihime, give the army a heads-up!
Tell them we're gonna protect those kids' smiles!
m920170.人間がそう簡単に成長するかよ。\nクズは永遠にクズなのさ。:
Humans don't grow that easily.
Scum stays scum, no matter what.
m920170.今の王国は、外からの攻撃には強いけど、\n市街地で暴れられると、対応できる兵力が:
The kingdom is strong against external attacks, but
if something starts rampaging in the city, we don't have enough troops to handle it.
m920170.仕方ない。\nここは実力で倒して捕縛――いや、\n更生の余地があるなら保護してや:
I suppose we have no choice.
We'll take him down and detain him―― no,
if there's any chance of reforming him, we should protect him.
m920170.以前、そう報告したでござろう。\n興味のない事であっても、\n情報は選り好みせず:
I reported this before, did I not?
Even if something seems unimportant,
one should gather all information without being picky.
m920170.何しろ私は、天才戦術家のヘレナだぞ？\n――さぁ、王国のクリスマスを守るために、:
After all, I am Helena, the genius tactician.
—So let's shatter the enemy's scheme to pieces
to protect the kingdom's Christmas!
m920170.先日のおなごか……。\n敵にさえ問いを投げかける癖は変わっておらぬようだ。:
That woman from the other day…….
You still have that habit of asking questions of your enemies.
m920170.全部お前のせいだ、クズ王子ィ。\n悔しかったら追ってくるがいいさ！\nまっ、もう:
It's all your fault, you useless Prince.
If you're angry, come catch up!
Though it's probably too late, isn't it?!
m920170.分かってないなァ、絡繰り忍者。\n憎い相手を殴ってスッキリすんのは馬鹿とクズまで:
You don't get it, Karakuri Ninja.
Punching the enemy you hate to feel better?
Only fools and scum do that.
m920170.副デーモンシェフよ、\n発送済みのプレゼントを急ぎ調査するのだ！:
Deputy Demon Chef,
investigate the already-shipped presents immediately!
m920170.嫌な連中だよ、まったく。\n人の命を何だと思っているんだ。:
What a despicable bunch.
What do they think human lives are worth?
m920170.工場のラインだけじゃなく、\n怪しい人物にも注意を――:
We need to check not just the assembly lines,
but keep an eye out for any suspicious individuals――
m920170.市街に散らばっていたミニメカドラゴンも、\nすべて沈黙したようです。\nどうやら:
The mini mech dragons scattered around the city
have all gone silent as well.
It seems Fo was controlling them.
m920170.市販されるのはミニメカドラゴンのサイズだからな……。\nくぅっ、やはりフルサイズ:
The retail version is supposed to be Mini Mech Dragon size…
Ugh, so they really did steal the full-size blueprints!
m920170.恐怖政治なんてものじゃないな。\nフォーとやら、王国の未来にも悪影響を及ぼすぞ。:
That's not just fear. It's terror.
This "Four" is a threat to the Kingdom's future, too.
m920170.我々は新たな異物混入がないか、工場内を調査するぞ。\n悪意ある何者かの営業妨害の:
We will search the factory for any other foreign objects.
There is a possibility that someone with ill intent is trying to sabotage our business.
For the safety of the children, we will search with all our might!
m920170.我が主への報告は、しばし後にしよう。\n我らが求める世界のあり方に、\n果たして:
I'll delay reporting to our master for now.
Which of us is truly useful
for the world we seek to create……
m920170.我が技術に果てはない。\nしかし、復讐相手ではなく、\nその民に手をあげるやり口:
My technology knows no limits.
However, I dislike this method of laying a hand on the people
rather than seeking revenge on the true enemy.
m920170.暗黒メカドラゴン……うぅん、あれはその後継機……。\nまさか、もう完成したってい:
The Dark Mech Dragon… ugh, that's its successor…
Could it be that it's already finished?
m920170.最初から大当たりみたいだ。\n王子、作業員の中に闇組織の構成員が紛れ込んでいるぞ:
Looks like we hit the jackpot right off the bat.
Prince, there's a Dark Organization member mixed in with the workers!
m920170.最近、すごく寒くなったでしょ……？\nそれでね、氷霊たちが楽しくなっちゃったみた:
It's gotten really cold lately, right…?
Well, it seems the ice spirits are getting a little too excited…
m920170.本当に楽しいのはァ！\n憎い相手の大切な人間を、なぶって、苦しめて、\nボロボロ:
What's really fun is!
Beating up the enemy's loved ones, tormenting them,
and showing them just how broken they've become!
m920170.楽しい気分に水を差すやつがどうなるか、\nしっかり教えてやらないとね。\nそうだ: I really need to teach whoever's ruining the mood a lesson. Wouldn't you agree, Prince?
m920170.民を守るためにも、\n犯罪の芽はどんどん摘み取っていかないといけないな。:
To protect the people, 
we have to nip these criminal threats in the bud.
m920170.爆死――って、まずいぞ王子！\n絡繰り忍者の足元に爆弾がっ！！:
An explosion—? This is bad, Prince!
There's a bomb at the Karakuri Ninja's feet!!
m920170.王国にすでに運び込まれた部品も気になる。\n王子、迅速に片付けてしまおう！:
I'm also worried about the parts already brought into the Kingdom.
Prince, let's wrap this up quickly!
m920170.王国の民よ！ 悪の野望は砕いたぞ！\nせーのっ、メリークリスマース♪:
People of the kingdom! We have crushed the ambitions of evil!
On the count of three, Merry Christmaas♪
m920170.王子、お気をつけを。\nブラックメカドラゴンのおもちゃから、\n大量の火薬と、闇:
Prince, be careful. 
I can smell a massive amount of gunpowder on the Black Mech Dragon toy, 
along with the scent of the poison used by the Dark Organization.
m920170.王子、一緒に民へ声を届けようじゃないか！\n――それから、視察のフリをして\nこ:
Prince, let's address the people together!
And while we're at it, we can pretend to be on an inspection tour
and sneak in a little date♪
m920170.王子、急いで王国へ帰還しましょう。\nフォーの企みを阻止するために！:
Prince, let's return to the kingdom immediately.
We have to stop Fo's scheme!
m920170.王子、指揮を頼む！\n商人たちを救出するぞ！: Prince, I leave the command to you! Let's save the merchants!
m920170.王子を怒らせるのがあいつの策だ。\n敵の策に乗る暇があったら、\n何の不安もなく:
Making you angry is his strategy.
Rather than falling for the enemy's trap,
please trust in my plan without a shred of doubt.
m920170.王子ィ、俺の犯罪計画に泥を塗った罪、\n王国の民に清算させてやろうじゃないかァ！:
Prince, I'm going to make the kingdom's people pay for the trouble you caused me. 
For the crime of ruining my master plan!
m920170.私たちは工場内の調査さえさせてくれれば――: All we ask is that you allow us to inspect the factory premises――
m920170.私はただのメイドですよ？: I'm just a maid, after all?
m920170.私らしくもない、こんな衣装まで着て、\nクリスマス気分でいたっていうのに……。: I've even put on this ridiculous outfit, trying to get into the Christmas spirit……
m920170.窓って、いったいどういう――\nははっ、どうしたんだあの子たちは。\n嬉しそうに:
A window? What do you mean――
Hah, what are those kids doing?
They're waving at us so happily.
m920170.自分の部下を殺すような指揮官がいるものか。\n――いや、闇の組織なら、それが普通:
There's no commander who would kill their own subordinates.
――Or is that just how Dark Organizations operate?
m920170.街の子どもたち、ですね。\nきっと、ヘレナさんが、\nクリスマスを守ってくれたん:
They're the children of the city.
They probably think that you, Helena,
protected their Christmas.
m920170.街の子どもたちから聞いたんだよ。\nいろいろ昔話をしてくれる、\nカワイイおばあ:
I heard it from the kids in town.
They said there's a cute old lady
who tells them all kinds of stories.
m920170.足を洗うなら、王子が面倒見てくれる。\nアイリーン姐さんだって味方してくれるぞ。:
If you're looking to wash your hands of this, the Prince will take care of you.
Even Aileen's sister will have your back.
m920170.闇の組織の幹部は、いずれも凶悪な犯罪者。\n部下のことも、使い捨てだと思っている:
The leaders of Dark Organizations are all vicious criminals.
They probably view their subordinates as disposable.
m920170.闇ギルドの頃ならともかく、\n闇の組織の幹部連中は、\n下部組織を平気で切り捨て:
Back in the days of the Dark Guild, maybe,
but the Dark Organization's executives
seem to discard their subordinates without a second thought.
m920170.雪の国製のおもちゃが、\nそう簡単に壊れるはずないだろう？: Toys from Snowland wouldn't break that easily, would they?
m920170.面目次第もござらん。\nされど気をつけられよ、\nこの者ら、以前よりも強くなって:
I apologize for the anticlimax.
But be wary.
These creatures have grown stronger than before.

m920185.――あぁっ、大変ですっ！\nピラミッドから出てきた天使たちが人を襲おうとしてます: —Ah, this is terrible! Angels emerging from the pyramid are attacking people!
m920185.――お待ちください！\n聖槍グングニルの在り処を知っているのですか？\n闇雲に進: ――Wait! Do you actually know where Gungnir is? If we charge blindly, the mummy-hunter will become the mummy!
m920185.――ぐ……うぉおぉおおッ！！！\n来た！ ついに来た！ 反撃の機は満ちた！！\n: ——Gah… Wooooooo!!! It's here! At last! The chance to strike back has arrived!! Take this!!! Keraunos!!!
m920185.――こうしてはいられません！\n聖槍を守らなくては！:
――We can't let it happen like this!
We must protect the Holy Spear!
m920185.――でしたら、二人ではどうですか？: —Then how about the two of us?
m920185.――ケラウノスは倒せない……というのか？\nち……ちっくしょおぉおおおッッ！！！: —So we can't defeat Keraunos…? D-damn it!!! What… what am I even fighting for…!!
m920185.――ケラウノスを討て、王子！\nいまの貴様ならできるはずだ！: —Defeat Keraunos, Prince! You can do it now!
m920185.――ッ！ \n貴方がたは、以前バステト様の復活を邪魔した――: ――! You all once thwarted Lady Bastet's resurrection—
m920185.――ッ！？\n貴様……眠っていたはずでは！？: ――! You... weren't you supposed to be asleep!?
m920185.――否！\n我輩たちには神殺しの聖槍、\nグングニルがあることを忘れたか！: —No! Have you forgotten that we possess the God-slayer's holy spear, Gungnir?!
m920185.――王子、あれを！\n向こうにいるのはデシウスと……、\n魔王親衛隊のシャディア: —Prince, that! Over there is Decius... and—Shadia of the Demon King's Royal Guard, perhaps?
m920185.――諦めてはなりません、人の子よ。: —We must not give up, child of man.
m920185.………………やったのか？\nついに……ついにやったのか？\n我輩は、ついに祖国の: ………Did we… finally…? At last… we finally avenged our homeland…!
m920185.…………そうですね。\nそれしか手段がないのなら、乗るしかありません。\nわかり: …I see. If it's our only option, we have no choice but to go along. Very well—let's cooperate with him this time.
m920185.…………ぬうっ……な、なぜだ……？\nなぜ……神殺しの力が発動しないッ！？: ……Ugh… wh-why? Why… the God-slayer's power won't activate!?
m920185.……ありがとうございます。\nそれではこれより、私ネフティは\n救世の英雄の守護: …Thank you. From now on, I, Nephty, will wield my blade as the guardian of the savior-hero.
m920185.……あれだけ大勢の天使たちが\nピラミッドから出てきたということは……。\nまさ: …Seeing that many angels pour out of the pyramid… it means… could it be that some of them are already…
m920185.……いえ、いまはそれどころではありません。\n聖地であるピラミッドが破壊されてし: …no, that's not the point now. Before the holy pyramid is destroyed, we must drive back the invading angels…
m920185.……いえ、謝らないでください。\n確かにピラミッドは崩壊し、聖槍グングニルは\n: …No, please don't apologize. Indeed, the pyramid has collapsed and the holy spear Gungnir lies buried beneath the rubble…
m920185.……いえ。遠征帰りで兵も疲弊していますし、\n追撃した私たちを誘い込む敵の罠かも: ...No. Our troops are exhausted after the expedition, and it could be a trap to lure us in. Let's not overextend and return as is.
m920185.……おい、デシウス。\nここはわたしが引き受けてやるから、\n先ほど話した情報の: ...Hey, Decius. I'll handle this, so don't tell anyone where that intel came from, alright?
m920185.……おい、聞いているのか？\n聖槍は砂漠の地に存在する\nピラミッドのひとつに眠: ...Hey, are you listening? The holy spear lies in one of the pyramids out in the desert. Here's the map—
m920185.……お目通り感謝いたします、王子。\n貴方にお話しすることで、自分の気持ちや\n: …Thank you for granting me an audience, Prince. By speaking with you, I wish to sort out my feelings and our future course.
m920185.……かわりに、と言っていいかはわかりませんが、\nケラウノスに勝利した英雄である: …I'm not sure if this counts as a replacement, but as the hero who defeated Keraunos, please allow me to grant you the divine relic the goddess once possessed.
m920185.……この状況では部屋を破壊して\n聖槍を埋めるのは難しそうですね。: …Given the situation, destroying the room to bury the spear looks difficult.
m920185.……これが神殺しの聖槍、グングニルですか。\n忌々しい……可能ならば破壊したいと:
…So this is the God-slayer's Holy Spear, Gungnir.
Cursed… If possible, I'd love to destroy it, but its size and material make that unlikely.
m920185.……これ以上は消耗戦だ。\nここは退くぞ、デシウス。: …This is turning into a war of attrition. We'll retreat, Decius.
m920185.……さらばだ、王子！\n我輩は我輩の道を往く！\n貴様は貴様の道を往くがいい！: …Farewell, Prince! I walk my own path… you walk yours!
m920185.……しばらく安静にしていた方がいい？\nふふっ、ありがとうございます。\nアンナ: …Should I just rest for a while? Hehe, thank you. Anna and the others said the same.
m920185.……ずいぶん足止めを喰らっちまったな。\nだが、これで天使どもがピラミッドを破壊:
…We've been held up quite a bit.
But thanks to this, we've delayed the angels from destroying the Pyramid, haven't we?
m920185.……そ、そんな……。\n天使たちがもう聖槍の座に……。: …N-no… The angels are already at the Spear's throne…
m920185.……だからピラミッド全体を破壊することによって、\n聖槍もろとも砂の中に埋めよう: …So by destroying the entire Pyramid they intended to bury the Spear with the sand, right?
m920185.……だが、さすがに疲れた……。\n王子……俺は後方で休ませてもらう、ぞ……。: …But I'm exhausted, after all. Prince… I'll rest back behind the lines.
m920185.……だが、悲観スルことハナイ。\n我々ゴブリン族はこの１年で\n着実に力を付けて: …but there's no need for despair. In this past year, we goblins have steadily grown stronger.
m920185.……つまらぬ。\n予を苦しめた男の末裔ですら、所詮はこの程度か。: …How dull. Even the descendant of the man who tormented me is nothing more than this.
m920185.……ですが、デシウスは今まで\n強大な力を得るために様々な悪逆を働いてきました。: …But Decius has committed countless atrocities to gain power. Can we really trust anything he says?
m920185.……ですが、私に残された僅かな力で\nそれを実行するには、相応の時間が必要です。: …However, with the meager power I have left, it'll take a proper amount of time. Child of man, could you grant us that time?
m920185.……とはいえ、今回の事件を通じて\n私個人の価値観は大きく変わってしまいました。: …That said, this incident has profoundly changed my personal outlook.
m920185.……どうかされましたか？\n急に立ち止まったりして。\n王国はまだ先ですよ？: …Is something wrong? You've just stopped dead in your tracks. The kingdom's still ahead of us, you know.
m920185.……なに、我輩が使うべきだと？: …What, you think I should be the one to use it?
m920185.……なに？\n詳細を聞いてからでないと決められんだと？\n貴様……この我輩が頼ん: …What? You can't decide until you hear the details? You… you're the one I'm asking!
m920185.……なるほど。\nつまりその聖槍グングニルとやらがあれば、\nケラウノスを完全に: …I see. So if we get our hands on that holy spear, Gungnir, we could wipe out Keranos completely?
m920185.……に、ニニニ人間ドモ！\nクイーン三姉妹様に近寄るナ！\n近寄レバこの……じ、: …H-humans! Don't you dare approach the Queen's three sisters! If you get close, I'll… press this… self-destruct switch!
m920185.……ふぅ。\nひとまず私にできるのはこんなところでしょうか。: …Phew. I think that's about all I can do for now.
m920185.……ふぅ。危ないところでした。\nしかし、なぜ神殿を守ってくださっていたのですか: …Phew. That was close. But why were you protecting the temple?
m920185.……また逃げられてしまいましたね。\nさて、残る一人は…………。: …They've slipped away again. Now, the only one left is…
m920185.……もっとも、聖槍の力を発動させるには\n神そのものを対象と定めたうえで、\n使: …Of course, to activate the spear's power, you have to target the god itself and pour enough of your own strength into the spear.
m920185.……わかりました。\n王子、ここは彼女に案内を頼みましょう。\nネフティさん、よ: …Understood. Prince, let's have her lead us. Lady Nephty, thank you.
m920185.……ケラウノス様、\n神獣スフィンクスの起動に成功いたしました。: …Lord Keraunos, we have successfully activated the divine beast Sphinx.
m920185.……デシウスさん。\n案内役の座を奪われたからといって\nネフティさんに対抗意識:
…Decius, please.
Just because you lost the guide role, don't take it out on Nephty.
m920185.……フッ、そうかもしれんな。\n神殺しの汚名を受けるのは、\n暗黒騎士となった我: …Heh, maybe you're right. The one bearing the God-slayer's stain should be… me, the Dark Knight.
m920185.……フン、わかっているとも。\nケラウノス亡き今、この小娘はただの抜け殻に過ぎん: …Hmph, I understand. With Keraunos gone, this girl is nothing but an empty shell. …A pitiful victim. Just like me.
m920185.……人間を発見。浄化します。\n全て、主の仰せのままに……。: …Human detected. Initiating purification. All according to the Master's will…
m920185.……力を得る為に重ねた罪を償うことはできん。: …I cannot atone for the sins I've piled up to gain this power.
m920185.……報告を聞いて来てみれば。\n一体これは何事でしょうか？: …After hearing the report, I came to see… What on earth is going on here?
m920185.……天使たちにピラミッドを破壊される前に\n聖槍グングニルの眠る場所までたどり着: …If we don't reach Gungnir's resting place before the angels raze the pyramid, we'll never be able to defeat Lord Kerau forever.
m920185.……天使だけではありません。\n開いた状態の棺には魔物も潜んでいます。\n空中ば: …It's not just angels. Open coffins hide monsters as well. If you keep looking to the sky, you'll lose your footing.
m920185.……我らの役目はこれまでです。\nあとのことは先へ行った者たちに任せましょう。:
…Our duty ends here.
We'll leave the rest to those who went ahead.
m920185.……此度の遠征、一筋縄ではいかなそうですね。\n我が国と協定を結ぶ各国、各地域の: …This expedition won't be straightforward. I'll request assistance from the nations and regions that have treaties with our kingdom.
m920185.……王子、今の魔王ガリウスには\n我々を本気で滅ぼすつもりはないようです。\nで: …Prince, it seems the current Demon Lord Garius doesn't truly intend to annihilate us. Still, we should remain on guard.
m920185.……王子。\n先ほどの会談でのデシウスの話、どう思われますか？: …Prince. What do you think of Decius's remarks from the earlier meeting?
m920185.……総員、撤退だ！\n生き残った者は直ちに帰投せよ！: ...All units, retreat! Anyone who makes it out, fall back immediately!
m920185.……詳しい事情はよくわかりません。\nですが、貴方が私を救ってくれた\n恩人だと: …I don't fully understand the details, but I clearly remember you saved me, my benefactor.
m920185.……貴方が王子様でいらっしゃいますね？\n先日は私をケラウノスの支配から救ってい: …You are the Prince, aren't you? Thank you for rescuing me from Keraunos's control the other day; I'm truly grateful.
m920185.……間違いない。\nあれが『聖槍グングニル』が\n眠っているとされるピラミッドだ: …No doubt. That's the pyramid where the Holy Spear Gungnir is said to lie.
m920185.……面を上げよ、我が忠実なるしもべよ。\n予は汝の働きに満足しておる。: Raise your head, my faithful servant. I am satisfied with your work.
m920185.……？ \nデシウスが去るようですね。\n後を追ったほうが良いでしょうか？: ...? Decius is leaving. Should we follow him?
m920185.『聖槍グングニル』――。\nはるか昔に何者かが創造し、\n人類に授けたとされる神: “The Holy Spear Gungnir”... It's said to be a divine weapon forged ages ago and bestowed upon humanity, capable of slaying gods.
m920185.『聖槍グングニル』は砂漠の国に存在する\nピラミッドの一つに眠っているそうです。: The Holy Spear Gungnir is said to lie within one of the pyramids in the desert nation. Let's head there first.
m920185.あ……お、王子！ \nケラウノス様に依り代とされていた\n少女が息を吹き返しまし: Ah… Prince! The girl who was the vessel for Keraunos has revived!
m920185.あ、アイギス様――！？\nですが、私たちにはもう、どうすることも……。: Ah, Aegis-sama—! But there's nothing left we can do…
m920185.あ、貴方は……白の皇帝！？\n確かに白の帝国にも協力を要請はしましたが、\nまさ: Ah, you are… the White Emperor!? We did request the empire's aid, but I never imagined you'd come yourself.
m920185.あぁ……といってもその聖槍は\n直接持って戦うには大きすぎるシロモノらしい。: Yeah… except that spear's so massive it can't be wielded directly in battle.
m920185.あぁっ！ 体中ひどいお怪我です！\nいますぐ治療して差し上げないと……。: Ah! My whole body is badly wounded! I must heal you at once…
m920185.あらぁ、素敵じゃない！\n流石は三女、準備がいいわねぇ。: Oh, how wonderful! As expected of the third sister, always prepared.
m920185.あれは――デシウス！？\n王子、デシウスが女神の神殿を守って\n魔物と戦っていま: That's—Decius!? Prince, Decius is defending the goddess's temple and fighting monsters!
m920185.あれは……ゴーレム。\n聖槍グングニルの守護者というわけですか。\n……くだらな:
That… is a Golem.
So it's the guardian of the Holy Spear, Gungnir.
…Pathetic, shallow thinking.
m920185.あんなところでコソコソと……。\n一体なにを企んでいるのでしょう？: Sneaking around in a place like that... What on earth are they plotting?
m920185.いまは私たち人間が互いに力を合わせて\n危機に立ち向かうことが必要なのだと思って: Now I think humanity must unite and face the crisis together, rather than leaving our fate to a god we trust.
m920185.う、うむ。心得た。\nでは、我輩は先に行かせてもらおう。: Y-yes. Understood. Then I'll go ahead.
m920185.うむ。倒せるなどとは思わぬべきだな。\n奴は攻撃されると反撃してくるが、\n刺激: Indeed. Don't expect to be able to defeat it. It retaliates when attacked, but won't strike unless provoked.
m920185.ええ、そうしましょう。\n一人一人の力は小さくても、それを重ね合わせれば\nどん: Yes, let's do that. Even if each of our powers is small, combined they become a force that can't be beaten.
m920185.ええい、らちが明かん！\n王子たちはまだ来ないのか！: Damn it, the battle's about to start! Prince, aren't you coming yet?
m920185.お……愚かな、人間たちよ……。\nこの私を討ったこと……必ずや……、\n後悔する: O… foolish humans… Having slain me… you'll surely… regret it… someday…
m920185.お、落ち着いてください！\nこの子はもうケラウノス様では――: Calm down! This child is no longer Keraunos…
m920185.おいおいおいおい！\nそれどころじゃねえだろ！\nなんなんだよ、あのデカブツは！: Hey hey hey! That's not the point! What the heck is that huge thing!?
m920185.おぉ、ネフティ様！ よくぞご無事で！\n我々はこの方々に救っていただいたのです。: Oh, Lady Nephty! Thank goodness you're safe! We were rescued by you.
m920185.おりはる、こむ……？\n言い伝えでは、聖槍が危機に晒された際に\n不滅の怪物が目: Orichalc… what? Legend says when the Holy Spear is in danger, an immortal monster awakens…
m920185.お姉さま、このままじゃつまらないわ。\n――そうだ。ねぇ、私たちも参加しちゃいま: Sister, this is getting boring. — That's right. Hey, why don't we join in? We actually brought a riding beast tank for moments like this.
m920185.か……勝手なことを言わないでください！\nデシウスはこれから、私たちと共に――: D-Don't say such selfish things! Decius will stay with us from now on—
m920185.く……クイーン三姉妹様！\nず、随分早いお出ましデ……。: Ugh… Queen's three daughters! You… you're arriving far earlier than expected…
m920185.くっ……あと一歩、姉様には届きませんでしたか……。: Damn… I couldn't reach my sister by that one step…
m920185.くっ……皆さん、申し訳ありません！ \nこのピラミッドは間もなく崩落します！\n: Damn… Everyone, I'm sorry! This pyramid is about to collapse! Get out now! Hurry!
m920185.ぐ、ふッ……そんな、馬鹿な……ッ。\nこの、私が……取るに足らぬ……人間如きに…: Guh, fu… this… impossible…! I, I… a mere insignificant human…
m920185.ぐッ……が……ぁ……あああぁあああぁあッッ！！\n力が、抜けて……うぐぅッ！ こ: Guh… ga… ah… aaaaah!! My power… slipping… uggh! Is this… the holy spear Gungnir's god-slaying power…?!
m920185.ここは予定通り、この部屋を破壊して埋めるしか……。\n……おや、あれは……？:
As planned, we have no choice but to smash this room and bury it…
…Oh? What's that over there?
m920185.ここは方針を変え、人間たちの殲滅を優先しましょう。\n彼らにゴーレムを刺激させ、: Then we should change tactics and prioritize wiping out the humans. Letting them provoke the golem and cause their own demise could be entertaining.
m920185.この声は……キャリーさん？\nですが、一体どこから……？: That voice… Carrie-san? But where is it coming from…?
m920185.この水音は……！\n来るわ、王子！ 海からよ！: That water sound…! It's coming, Prince! From the sea!
m920185.この肉体から私の神としての本質を\n分離させでもしない限りはね……。\nですが、: Unless you separate my divine essence from this flesh… but that's impossible for mortals like you.
m920185.ご案内ありがとうございます……と\n言ったほうがよろしいのでしょうね。: Thank you for the guidance… I suppose that's what I should say.
m920185.ご苦労様です。\nそれでは大天使長よ、\n女神ケラウノスの名によって命じます。: Good work. Then, Archangel, by the name of the goddess Keraunos, I command you.
m920185.さ……左様でございますか。\nでしたらその御力、存分にお揮いくださいませ。: I—Is that so? Then please, feel free to use all that power as you wish.
m920185.し・て・く・れ・る・ん・で・しょ・う・ね・え？: Goblin Queen's Second Daughter: They… will… do… it… for… us… right…?
m920185.すごい……本当に天使たちを撃退するなんて。\nこれが王子たちの実力ですか。: Amazing… to actually drive the angels back. Is this the Prince's power?
m920185.そ、そんな……。\nピラミッドが崩落し始めるなんて……。\nなんという凄まじい力: N-no… The pyramid's starting to collapse… What an overwhelming surge of power!
m920185.そ、そんなぁ……。\n嘘、ですよね？ ケラウノス様……。: N-no… This can't be… It's a lie, right? Lord Keraunos…
m920185.そう。いまの私は人間の少女の肉体を依り代として\n降臨した存在。つまり神そのもの: Exactly. I now inhabit the body of a human girl as a vessel, so I'm not the god itself. Therefore, I'm not a target for the God-slayer's power.
m920185.そういうわけだ。王子、協力しろ。\n我輩だって貴様と共闘など不本意だが、\nあの: That's why, Prince, cooperate. I don't like teaming up with you, but we can finally bury Keranos. It's not a bad deal, is it?
m920185.そう願います……が、\n天使たちの言っていたことが気になりますね……。: I hope so… But I'm still curious about what the angels said…
m920185.そして、聖槍の力を発動させるには、\nそれを試みる者――つまり我輩の力を\n聖槍: And to activate the spear's power, the one who attempts it—namely me—must pour enough of my strength into it.
m920185.その功労者を是非取り立てたい。\nデシウスよ、魔王軍に入れ。\nそこが貴様の在る: I want to reward that contributor. Decius, join the Demon Lord's forces. That's where you belong.
m920185.その声は――アダマス！？\nば、馬鹿な……どうして貴方がここに？: That voice… Adamas!? N-no way… why are you here?
m920185.その思い上がり、後悔させてあげましょう！\n行きなさい、天使たちよ！\n聖槍の力: Your arrogance will be your regret! Advance, angels! Annihilate them before the spear's power awakens!
m920185.その神を殺す方法を見つけたと言っているのだ。: I'm saying I've found a way to kill that god.
m920185.その話が本当なら、確かに彼と協力して\n『聖槍グングニル』の封印を解く価値はあり: If that's true, it would certainly be worth cooperating with him to unseal the Holy Spear.
m920185.それでは……お言葉に甘えて、\nこれからは普通の女の子として\n生きていきたいと: Then… I'll take your words to heart and live from now on as an ordinary girl.
m920185.それと、この国で保護していただけるよう\n取り計らってくださったことも。\n本当: And also for arranging my protection in this country. I really don't know how to thank you enough…
m920185.それにしても、デシウスとシャディアは\n一体なにを話していたのでしょう？ \n気: Still, what on earth were Decius and Shadia discussing? I'm curious...
m920185.それは、人の子らが教えてくれたこと。\nケラウノス姉様。貴方が愚かだと侮った、\: That is what the children of man have taught us. Sister Keraunos, you will be defeated by the very humans whose hands you scorned as foolish.
m920185.そんな……それでは\n聖槍グングニルの力をもってしても――: That… then even the power of Gungnir can't—
m920185.そんな……やっとわかりあえたと思ったのに。: No... I thought we finally understood each other.
m920185.だが、それを実行するには……、\n王子、貴様の軍に協力してもらう必要がある。\n: But to carry it out… Prince, I'll need your army's help. It's beyond what I can handle alone…
m920185.だが、聖槍に秘められた力を発動させられれば、\n神はその強大な力の大部分を失う。: But if we can unleash the power sealed within it, the god will lose most of that overwhelming strength. Then even a mere human could stand toe-to-toe with it.
m920185.だが、聖槍グングニルはそう容易く持ち運んだり\n壊したりできるようなシロモノでは:
But the Holy Spear Gungnir isn't something you can just carry off or smash easily.
Besides, they shouldn't even know its exact location.
m920185.だろうな。だが、もしも天使どもが\n我輩たちよりも先に聖槍の在り処に辿り着いたと: That's likely. Yet, if the angels reach the Spear's location before us, destroying that chamber would let them achieve their goal.
m920185.つ、強がりもそこまでだ！\n聖槍が本物だということは貴様自身がいま証明した！\n: That's enough bravado! You just proved the spear's genuine—now I'll pour my power into it…!
m920185.ついに……ついに辿り着いたぞ。\n聖槍グングニル……これさえあれば我が宿敵、\n: At last… at last I've reached it. The Holy Spear Gungnir… with this, I can finally erase my nemesis, Keranos, forever!
m920185.ですから、その……。\n一言だけ、お礼を言わせていただけますか？: So, um... May I at least say a single word of thanks?
m920185.ですから王子……微力ではありますが、\n今後は私も貴方がたの戦いに\nお力添えさ: So, Prince… though my abilities are modest, may I lend my aid to your future battles?
m920185.ですが、ひとつだけわかったことがあります。\nかの女神の精神体の支配から逃れた今: However, there's one thing I do know: even now, having escaped the goddess's mental domination, my body still bears a faint miracle's power.
m920185.ですが、少しは胸を張ってもいいのではないでしょうか。\n私たちも王子のもとで、ゴ: Still, shouldn't we be a little proud? Under the Prince's guidance, we've become strong enough to stand up to the goblins.
m920185.ですが、早くしないと天使たちに――: But if we don't hurry, the angels—
m920185.と……飛んで行ってしまいました……。\nあんなすごい技術を開発してたなんて……び: And… they just flew off… I'm amazed they managed to develop such advanced tech.
m920185.といっても、残念ですが\n私自身には貴方がたのように戦う力はありません。: That said, unfortunately I lack the strength to fight like you do.
m920185.とにかくあの人たちを助けましょう！\n王子、ご指示をお願いします。: Let's rescue those people! Prince, give us orders.
m920185.どうする、追撃しとくか？: What now, shall we give chase?
m920185.な、なぜ天使たちがピラミッドから出てくるのだ！？: Wh-why are angels coming out of the pyramid?!
m920185.なっ……！\nそんな……デシウスが寝返るなんて。: No…! I can't believe Decius would betray us.
m920185.なにを案じる必要があるのです？\n地上の心配など不要ではありませんか。\n貴方が: Why do you worry? There's no need to concern yourselves with the surface. You'll all rot miserably here.
m920185.なら博士が私たちを守ってくれればいいじゃない？\n軍の予算をたっぷり注ぎ込んだ飛: Then just have the Doctor protect us, right? Use those flying cages you poured a fortune into. Heh heh, they must be top-notch, huh?
m920185.ね、ネフティさん……あの、足下に……。: Hey, Nephty… um, watch your step…
m920185.はぁ、はぁ……くそっ、天使どもめ！\n聖地を踏みにじっただけじゃ飽き足らず、\n: Hah, hah… Damn, angels! Not satisfied with trampling the holy ground, they're trying to take our lives too!
m920185.はぁっ、はぁっ……まったく。\n王国の政務官は……人使いが荒い……ッ。: Hah, hah… Good grief. The kingdom's officials… are so reckless with people…
m920185.はン、それがどうしたってんだ？\nピラミッドの中にいる天使どもを\n片っ端からブ: Huh, so what's the problem? We just have to smash every angel inside the pyramid and keep moving forward, right?
m920185.ば……馬鹿を言うな！\n下らんことを言っていると天使どもに先を越されるぞ！\n…:
D-don't be ridiculous!
If you keep babbling, the angels will overtake us!
…Hey, woman, stop collapsing and get moving already!
m920185.ひ、ひとまずここではなく、\nもっと落ち着ける場所で話を伺いましょう。: L-let's not discuss this here—let's find a calmer place to talk.
m920185.ふ……フハハハハ！ 我輩は暗黒騎士……！\n馬鹿め、我輩は仲間になったフリをして: Fu… Hahaha! I am the Dark Knight… Fool! I only pretended to be your ally. Prince, I'll crush you for all the trouble you've caused!
m920185.ふふ……待たせたな、魔界に棲まう者たちよ。\n行け！ 人間どもの血で大地を朱に染: Heh... I've kept you waiting, denizens of the demon realm. Forward! Stain the earth crimson with human blood!
m920185.ふふ……聞いたことがありませんか？\n依り代となる人間を用意することができれば、: Heh… Haven't you heard? If you provide a suitable vessel, you can summon a god down to this world.
m920185.ふふ。残念でしたね、アイギス。\n長きに渡り人間たちを守護するために浪費し、\n: Heh. What a pity, Aegis. After wasting ages protecting humans, your dwindled power is nothing more than this.
m920185.ふふっ、やってるわねぇ博士。\n面白いことになってるじゃない？: Heh, you're really pulling it off, Doctor. This is getting interesting, isn't it?
m920185.ふん。死に損ないのアイギスに\nなにができるとも思えませんが……いいでしょう。\: Hmph. I doubt a dying Aegis can do anything… Very well. I'll trample that sliver of hope right before your eyes.
m920185.へぇ、もう演習も佳境に入っちゃってるようにも\n見えるけど？ まぁそれはともかく: Hmm, looks like the drill's already reaching its climax, huh? Well, aside from that, it seems those princes' troops are pushing us back, don't they?
m920185.ほぅ……オリハルコンゴーレムか。\nこんなところで見かけることになるとはのぅ。: Huh… an orichalcum golem. Never thought I'd see one out here.
m920185.ま……魔王様！\nお出迎えもせず、面目次第もございません！\nおいでになるとはい: M-Master Demon Lord! I haven't even had the chance to welcome you—my apologies! I can't say whether you'll even show up...
m920185.まあ聞け。我輩はついに\nあのケラウノスを倒す方法を突き止めたのだ。: Listen up. I've finally figured out how to defeat that Keranos.
m920185.まさか……人間を滅ぼそうとしているとはいえ、\nケラウノス様は神の一柱なのですよ: No way… Even though he's trying to wipe out humanity, Keranos is one of the gods! He's… even when we corner him, he always…
m920185.まずは、ケラウノスのことです。\n人類滅亡の推進者であった\nかの女神を討滅して: First, about Keraunos. Thank you for defeating that goddess who was the driving force behind humanity's extinction.
m920185.もう、なにやってるのよ博士！\n私たちを守るってお姉さまに約束したじゃない！: Enough, what are you doing, Doctor! You promised sister you'd protect us!
m920185.もう、素直じゃないんですから……って、あれは？: You're still not being honest… wait, what's that?
m920185.もっとご協力できればとは思うのですが、\n戦う力のない私では、たとえ戦場に出たと: I wish I could help more, but without any fighting ability, I'd just be a hindrance on the battlefield…
m920185.や……やめなさい！ アイギス……アダマスッ！\n自分がなにをしているか、判ってい: No… stop! Aegis… Adamas! Do you even realize what you're doing!? …Gah, ugh… Aaaaargh!!!!
m920185.やった！\n肉体からケラウノスの精神体が分離したぞ！: Yes! The Keraunos spirit has separated from its flesh!
m920185.わ、私たちは遠征から帰ってきたばかりで……。\n貴方こそ、なぜ神殿を守って――: We…just got back from the expedition… Why are you defending the temple—
m920185.わかりました。\n王子、詳しい事情は不明ですが、\nここはデシウスに加勢しましょ: Understood. Prince, I don't know the full story, but let's back Decius up!
m920185.わわっ……天使さんたちが\n奥の方から大勢出てきました。\n一体何人いるんでしょ: Wa-wa… Angels are pouring out from deep inside. How many are there, I wonder?
m920185.アイギス姉様、事情は把握しています！\nいまこそ、私たち二柱の女神の力をひとつに: Sister Aegis, I understand the situation! Now is the time to unite the power of the two goddess pillars!
m920185.アーアー……コホン。\n諸君、聞こえてイルカ？: Aaa… ahem. Everyone, can you hear me?
m920185.ウグ……し、承知イタシましタ。\n我ガ傑作の性能、とくとゴ覧に入れマショウ！: Ugh… very well. I shall showcase the performance of my masterpiece!
m920185.ウフフ、気になる？ でも試そうとしちゃダメよ？\n貴方たち人間は、そんな安っぽい: Goblin Queen's Eldest Daughter: Heh, curious, aren't you? But don't even think about trying it. We humans won't need some cheap little switch—we'll wipe you out with our own hands.
m920185.ウム……デハこれヨリ演説を行ウ。: Um… now I shall give a speech.
m920185.グフフ……人間ども、丁度いいところに来タ。: Heh heh… Humans, you've arrived at just the right moment.
m920185.ケラウノスの依り代にされていた時のこと、ですか？\n……申し訳ありません。思い出: You're asking about the time I was Keraunos's vessel? …I'm sorry. I'm trying to recall, but so far I can't remember anything from then or before.
m920185.ケラウノスの武具が必要な際は、\n称号を『神殺しの英雄』に変更してください。: When you need Keraunos's armaments, change your title to “Hero Who Slays Gods.”
m920185.ケラウノス亡き今、かつての力が予に戻りつつある。\n実に良き気分ゆえ、予を滅ぼさ: Now that Keranos is gone, the power I once had is returning to me. I'm in such a good mood that I feel like toying with those fools who would try to destroy me.
m920185.ゴブリン軍も着々と力を付けてきているようです。\n我々も気を引き締めていかなくて: The Goblin forces are steadily growing stronger. We'll have to stay on our guard, too.
m920185.シャディア！？\n魔王親衛隊の貴様が、なぜここに……？: Shadia!? What are you, a member of the Demon Lord's elite guard, doing here…?
m920185.スフィンクスと共に、地上の人間を滅ぼしなさい。\n一人も逃さず、一切の慈悲もかけ: Together with the Sphinx, eradicate the humans on the surface. Spare none, show no mercy. Exterminate them completely, as if burning them to ash.
m920185.チッ……あのアマ、魔界の門を開きやがった！\n気をつけな！ 魔物どもがワンサカ出: Tch... that witch opened the demon gate! Watch out! Monsters are pouring out!
m920185.デシウス……どうしても行ってしまうのですか？: Decius... are you really going to leave?
m920185.ハァッ、ハァッ……くっ、さすがに堪えるな。\nだが、残りはあと半分といったところ: Haa… haa… Damn, it's getting hard to hold on. But we're about halfway through…
m920185.ハヒッ！？\nわ……ワタクシを捨て駒になさるト……？: Hah!? You… you'd discard me and turn me into a pawn…?
m920185.ヒ……ヒヒヒッ！ バカめ、騙されたナ！\n自爆スイッチなんて嘘なのデアル！\nこ: Heh… heh heh! Foolish you, you've been duped! The self-destruct switch was a lie! This… this is actually an escape device!
m920185.ピラミッドを破壊するだと！？\nくっ……天使どもめ、聖槍ごと砂漠に埋めるつもりか: Destroy the pyramid, you say!? Damn… those angels, they'll bury the holy spear right in the desert!
m920185.フハハハハ！\nそんな猫のような恰好をしているくせに\nネズミごときを怖がるとは: Hahaha! You dress like a cat, yet you're scared of a little mouse!
m920185.フン、行きかけの駄賃というやつだ。\n今回は貴様らに頼みがあって来たのでな。: Hmph, consider it a token for the trouble I've caused you. I'm here because I have a favor to ask of you.
m920185.フン。あくまで目的のために一時的に手を組むだけだ。\n礼などいらん。: Hmph. We're only allying temporarily for the goal. No need for gratitude.
m920185.一刻を争う事態だと……アダマスが言うんでな。\n集団でなだれ込むより……俺一人の: It's a race against time, Adamas says. Rather than a mass assault… I'm faster on my own.
m920185.一戦構えようってのか？\nいい度胸じゃねえか。王子、受けて立とうぜ！: You think we should clash? That's some nerve. Prince, let's take him on!
m920185.予は帰還する。\n臣下たちよ、後はうまくやるがいい。: I shall return. Ministers... see to it from here on out.
m920185.人の子よ、準備が整いました。\nこれより我が姉、女神ケラウノスの精神体を\n少女: Child of man, the preparations are complete. From now on I will attempt to separate my sister, the goddess Keraunos, from the girl's body.
m920185.以前は我ら一族の崇める神、\nバステト様の復活こそが\n唯一の救いだと信じていま: I used to believe that the resurrection of Bastet, the deity our clan worships, was the only salvation…
m920185.余計な詮索はするな、人間どもよ。\nわたしの怒りに触れて死期を早めたくなかったら: Don't pry any further, you humans. Don't tempt my wrath if you value your lives.
m920185.使い方を誤ればかえって不利にもなりかねませんので、\n以前の戦い方と状況に応じて: If you misuse it, it could backfire, so try to employ it according to the tactics and situations you've faced before.
m920185.倒せるのか……ケラウノスを。\n祖国を滅ぼした憎きあの邪神を、我輩の手で……。: Can we really defeat… Keranos? The vile deity that destroyed our homeland, by my own hand…?
m920185.先へ行った者たち、とはどういうことでしょうか？\n天使たちの目的はピラミッドの破: What do they mean by “those who went ahead”? Isn't their goal to destroy the Pyramid?
m920185.全くよぉ。演習の出来もさんざんだったし。\nせめて私たちが逃げるまでの\n時間稼: Goblin Queen's Second Daughter: Honestly, it's ridiculous. Our drills were a disaster. At the very least, they'll buy us some time to escape, right?
m920185.同じ神の座にある私なら、姉様の精神体を\n依り代の肉体から分離させられるかもしれ: If I, who sit upon the same divine throne, could separate my sister's spirit from her vessel, just as she once split Adamant's body and spirit.
m920185.天使たちの撤退を確認。\n……デシウスさん、大丈夫ですか？: Angels have retreated. …Decius, are you alright?
m920185.寝返る？ 勘違いをするな。\n貴様らなど最初から利用するつもりでしかなかったのだ: Betray? Don't misunderstand. I've only ever intended to use you from the start. Hahaha! Call me cowardly all you like!
m920185.己の無謀を、無能を、無力を呪いながら逝きなさい。\n卑小な人間たちが束になったと: Curse your recklessness, your incompetence, your powerlessness as you go. Even if you pitiful humans band together, you'll never threaten the throne of the gods!
m920185.待ってください皆さん！ 本当に大丈夫ですか？\nこんな悪そうな人に聖槍グングニル: Please, everyone! Are we really sure about this? Handing the holy spear Gungnir to someone so… evil? As its guardian, I'm honestly pretty uneasy.
m920185.心配すんなって。\n闇に染まったとはいえ、ヤツも騎士だ。\nここで裏切るような真: Don't worry. Even though he's been tainted by darkness, he's still a knight. He'd never betray us, even if it meant death.
m920185.愚かな……愚かな愚かな愚かな愚かな人間たちめ！\nこんな……こんな屈辱は初めてで: Foolish… foolish, foolish, foolish, foolish humans! This… this humiliation is something I've never felt before… I've taken you lightly, but I'll never forgive you now!
m920185.愚かな人間たちよ……。\n神のご意志に逆らう者は、粛清します。: Foolish humans… Those who defy the will of the gods shall be purged.
m920185.承知いたしました。\n全ては神の御心のままに……。: Understood. All shall follow the will of the gods…
m920185.探したぞ、デシウス。\n愚神ケラウノス誅殺の最大の功労者よ。: I've found you, Decius. The greatest contributor to the extermination of the fool god Keraunos.
m920185.敵部隊の撤退を確認。\nしかし、やけにあっさりと引き上げましたね。: Enemy forces are withdrawing. But they pulled back unusually quickly.
m920185.本当におめでたい方々ですね。\n聖槍グングニルのもとに辿り着いたくらいで、\n私: You truly are a celebratory bunch. You think reaching the holy spear Gungnir means you can defeat me?
m920185.本日の演習ハその集大成デアル！\nクイーン三姉妹様たちも見学ニいらっしゃるそうダ: Today's drill is the culmination of that work! The Queen's three daughters will be watching, too! So we must make it a success!
m920185.某所に封印された『聖槍グングニル』を用いれば\n数多の国を滅ぼした女神ケラウノス: Decius raved that if we could wield the sealed Gungnir, we could utterly bury the goddess Keraunos, who destroyed countless nations.
m920185.無論、ケラウノスはそれまで待ってはくれんだろう。\nだから……頼む！ 我輩が聖槍: Of course, Keraunos won't wait for that. So… I beg you! Hold out against their assault until I can trigger the spear's power!
m920185.無論、無闇に刺激しない方が賢明というものじゃ。\n奴の一撃は山をも砕くというから: Of course, it's wiser not to provoke it recklessly. Its single blow can shatter mountains.
m920185.王子……ここはなんとしても\n天使たちを退け、聖槍を守り抜きましょう！: Prince… we must repel the angels at any cost and protect the spear!
m920185.王子……本当によろしいのですか？: Prince… are you sure about this?
m920185.王子、あと一息だ！ \nなんとしても奴らの攻勢を堪えきってくれ！: Prince, just a little more! You have to endure their onslaught at all costs!
m920185.王子、まずいことになったぞ。\nどうやら我々は天使に先回りされてしまったようだ。: Prince, this is trouble. It seems the angels got the drop on us. They've probably been noticed by Kerau…
m920185.王子、聖槍の座に向かうがいい。\n我輩はケラウノスを葬れればそれでいいのだ。\n: Prince, head for the throne of the spear. I only need to bury Keranos. The spear is yours to wield.
m920185.王子！ ケラウノスの言うとおり、\n神であるヤツを滅ぼすことは不可能だ。\n……: Prince! As Keraunos says, destroying that god is impossible…—at least until the holy spear Gungnir's power is unleashed!
m920185.神は絶対の存在であり、封じることはできても\n存在そのものを滅ぼすことはできない: A god is an absolute being—while you can seal it, you shouldn't be able to erase its existence. Yet they claim that using this spear could completely wipe out a god's very existence.
m920185.神を滅ぼす唯一の方法が\nその聖槍を使うことだとすれば、\nケラウノス様から物質: If the only way to destroy a god is to use that spear, then there's no other means to protect the material world from Keraunos.
m920185.私たちに頼み……？\nいままで私たちに敵対してきた貴方が、\nいまさらなにを言う: You're asking us…? After all this time you've been our enemy, what are you saying now?
m920185.私はネフティ。貴方たちが探している聖槍の守護者です。\n私が道案内をする代わりに: I am Nephty, guardian of the holy spear you seek. If I guide the way, you defeat the angels. —How does that sound for a contract?
m920185.聖槍の力が発動すれば、ケラウノスは弱体化する。\nそうなれば人間の力でも互角に戦: Once the spear's power awakens, Keraunos will be weakened. Then even human strength can match him. I'll give the signal when it's ready. Then—
m920185.聖槍は見事にその役目を果たしましたし、\nピラミッドは再建すればよいのですから。: The spear fulfilled its purpose splendidly, and we can simply rebuild the pyramid. Our clan's faith isn't so easily shaken.
m920185.聖槍グングニルの眠る場所はこの先です。\n暗いので足下にお気をつけください。: The resting place of Gungnir lies ahead. It's dark, so watch your step.
m920185.聞け！ そして記憶しろ！\n我が名はデシウス！\n女神ケラウノスを屠る者なり！: Listen! And remember! My name is Decius! Slayer of the goddess Keranos!
m920185.自爆スイッチ！？\nそんな物騒な機能を\n飛行くぐつに搭載したというのですか？: A self-destruct switch? You actually installed such a dangerous feature on a flying cage?
m920185.興ざめだ。予は帰還する。\n臣下たちよ、後は適当にやるがいい。: How disappointing—I'm heading back. You lot, just manage as you see fit.
m920185.行け、勇敢ナル戦士たちヨ！\nこの一年の成長の証ヲ人間どもの肉体に刻むノダ！: Forward, brave warriors! Let us carve the proof of our year's growth into the humans' flesh!
m920185.見た目で人を判断するな、女よ。\nこの我輩が聖槍の使い手となった以上、\n我が宿: Don't judge by looks, girl. Now that I'm the wielder of the holy spear, it's only a matter of time before I crush my nemesis Keraunos.
m920185.話は後だ！ さっさと加勢しろ！\n魔物どもから神殿を守りたければな！: No time for talk! Join me quickly! If you want to protect the temple from those monsters!
m920185.詳しいことは私にはわかりかねますが、\n神が有していた武具ですので、\nおそらく: I'm not entirely sure of the details, but since it's a weapon the gods once possessed, it should hold an immense power.
m920185.諸君！ 我々魔物の復活カラ早４年が過ぎタ。\nしかし、未だに人間どもを駆逐スルに: Gentlefolk! Four years have passed since the monsters' revival, and we still haven't managed to wipe out the humans! Especially, we keep getting our throats slit by the princes' army!
m920185.貴様の功績は魔王様も高く評価している。\nなにせ、おかげであの御方はケラウノスの: Your deeds are highly praised even by the Demon Lord himself. Thanks to you, that… being has been freed from Keraunos's curse and is regaining his true strength.
m920185.迎えに来たのだ。\n魔王様の御力を抑制していた愚かな女神を殺し、\nその忌々しい: I've come to fetch you. To kill the foolish goddess who was suppressing the Demon Lord's power, and to claim the man who became the key to breaking that cursed bond.
m920185.遅いッ！ なにをしていたのだ、王子！: Too late! What have you been doing, Prince?
m920185.違うな。天使たちの目的は聖槍を使えなくすることだ。\nおそらく主であるケラウノス:
That's not it. Their aim is to render the Holy Spear unusable.
They were probably ordered to do so by their master, Keranos.
m920185.闇に身を落とした我輩には、\n闇の世界こそが相応しいのだ……。: Having fallen into darkness, the realm of shadows is where I belong…
m920185.隊列ヲ組んでノ戦闘ニモますます習熟シタ。\nワタクシの天才的頭脳の真髄デアル、\: We've become ever more proficient in coordinated battle. And thanks to my brilliant mind, we've succeeded in developing—and even putting into practice—flying cages.
m920185.（……とはいえ、いまさら彼らと共に\n陽の光の下を歩む資格があるだろうか？\n力: (…But now, do I even deserve to walk in the daylight with them? I've stained myself with darkness, using any means to gain power…)
m920185.（……なぜ我輩は王国へ行こうとしている？\n共にケラウノスを打倒した我輩に\n王: (…Why am I heading toward the kingdom? It's true the Prince urged me, who helped bring down Keraunos, to join the royal army…)
m920185.（……邪悪な意志に染まった力では\n聖槍の力は発動しなかったはず。\nこう見えて: (…The power tainted by evil shouldn't have triggered the spear… So Decius's will must have been pure after all.)
m920185.（くっ……まずいな。\n聖槍の情報をデシウスに流したのがわたしだと\n奴らに知ら: (Damn... this is bad. If they find out I leaked the spear's info to Decius, our plan could be blown.)
m920185.（くっ、この女に案内されては我輩の立場が……）: (Damn, being led by this woman makes me look… less than I am…)
m920185.（しかし、宿敵ケラウノスを葬るためには\nなんとしてもその聖槍を手に入れる必要が: (But to bury our nemesis Keranos, I must get that spear no matter what!)
m920185.（そのためには、いずれあの王子たちと\n共闘する必要があるかもしれん。\n暗黒騎: (To do that, I may eventually have to team up with those princes. Having lost the Dark Knights, I'm at a loss right now…)
m920185.（だが、率直に言えば案内者がいて助かるのも事実。\n内部の道までは情報提供者も知: (But honestly, having a guide is a relief. No one even knew the inner passages.)
m920185.（強い……さすがは王子の軍だ。\n隠れて覗き見するつもりはなかったが、\nつい奴: (Strong... as expected of the Prince's army. I hadn't intended to eavesdrop, but I couldn't help getting drawn into their fight.)
m920185.（聖槍グングニル……。\nピラミッドに封印された神殺しの聖具が\nそう簡単に手に: (The holy spear Gungnir... a divine weapon sealed in the pyramid shouldn't be that easy to obtain.)

m950000.――おや、じゃあこの戦いも\nレーヴの記録に残るってことかい？: —Oh, so this battle will end up in Reve's records too?
m950000.――くっくっく、知ってるか？\n聖霊にはすげぇ価値があるんだぜ。: —Heh heh, you know? The Holy Spirit's got huge value.
m950000.――王子さま、みんなを助けてくれてありがとう！\nうぅぅ、無事で本当によかったぁ:
—Prince, thank you for saving everyone!
Uuu, I'm so relieved you're safe…
m950000.――王子の、戦いの記録ですか？: —So, a record of the Prince's battles?
m950000.…………あぁっ！ その顔！\nもしかして王国の王子さま！？: ………! That face! Could it be… the Prince of the kingdom!?
m950000.……話を聞くには、落ち着かせるしかなさそうだねぇ。\n実力行使ってやつさ、王子。: …Looks like the only way to hear them out is to calm them down. That's what we call using force, Prince.
m950000.あっ、あなたの物語がぴったりかも！: Ah, your story might be perfect!
m950000.あなたたちも聖霊を捕まえる悪いやつ！？\nえーいっ！ やっつけちゃうんだからー！: You guys are the bad guys trying to catch the Holy Spirit?! Bring it on! I'll beat you!
m950000.あれ……あのちっこいの、聖霊さんじゃないですか？\nなんだか慌てているみたいです: Huh… that tiny one, isn't it a Holy Spirit? It looks panicked…
m950000.いいのいいの♪\nこの本に物語を描かれたみんなの\n技量を、私が高めてあげるね♪:
It's fine, it's fine♪
I'll boost the skills of everyone whose tale is written in this book♪
m950000.うぅぅぅ……アカシちゃん、\n無事に王子さまの所へたどり着けたでしょうか……。:
Uuu… Akashi-chan,
I hope we made it safely to the Prince...
m950000.うっひょぉ！\nそれじゃあこいつらを捕まえれば、\nしばらくは食いっぱぐれねぇっ:
Woohoo!
So if we capture them, we won't go hungry for a while!!
m950000.えぇ、未来の王国のためにも、\n王子の辿ってきた歴史を\n編纂する事業を本格的に: Yeah, for the future kingdom we're thinking of officially starting a project to compile the history the Prince has walked through.
m950000.えぇと……それじゃあ、お願いします……？\nと、ともかく！ これで一段落ですね。:
Well… then, please…?
Anyhow! That's a wrap for now.
Prince, shall we return to the Aegis Temple?♪
m950000.えっと、そうだ！\n悪い盗賊が仲間たちを捕まえようとしてるの！: Um, right! A bad thief is trying to capture my friends!
m950000.えっ？ これは物語というか王国史で――: Huh? This is more like a kingdom chronicle than a story—
m950000.おうよ、こいつらは戦士の技量を高めたり、\n新たな力を芽生えさせる奇跡を起こせる: Yeah, these things can boost a warrior's skill and even cause miracles that birth new powers.
m950000.おや、私たちも記録に残るのですか？: Oh? Are we going to be in the records too?
m950000.お礼に、私の力を王子さまの仲間にあげるね！: As a thank-you, I'll give my power to your allies!
m950000.お願い、王子さま！\n悪い盗賊たちから、仲間を助けてほしいの！: Please, Prince! Save my friends from those bad thieves!
m950000.きっと大丈夫ですよ！\n王子さまは、こういう時には必ず駆けつけて――:
I'm sure it'll be fine!
The Prince always rushes in at times like this—
m950000.こ、来ないで！\n少しでも触ったらぶっ飛ばすわよ！:
D-Don't come any closer!
If you even touch it a little, I'll blast you away!
m950000.それで、助けを呼ぼうと思って、\n王国の方まで急いで飛んでる最中で――: So I tried to call for help, and was rushing all the way to the kingdom—
m950000.ちっ、こうなったら仕方ねぇ！\n野郎ども、王子を捕まえて売っぱらうぞ！:
Damn, looks like that's that!
You bastards, we'll capture the Prince and sell him!
m950000.なっ……お、王国軍だとぉ！？\nどうしてこんな所にいやがるんだ！？:
Wh— the Kingdom troops!?
Why are you showing up here!?
m950000.はいはい、話は詰め所で聞くからな。\n生活に困ってるなら仕事も斡旋するから、\n:
Yeah, yeah, we'll hear the details at the holding cell.
If you're struggling, we can find you a job, but first atone for your crimes.
m950000.ふふふ、皆さんの記録もしっかり書き残しますよ。\nそのために、王子をはじめ、\n: Hehe, we'll make sure to write down everyone's records too. That's why, besides you, Prince, we've also had everyone off-duty today tag along.
m950000.わ、悪かった！ 改心するから！\n頼むぅ、見逃してくれぇ！:
I—I'm sorry! I'll reform!
Please, spare me!
m950000.わっ……た、助けてくれたってこと？\nごめんなさい！ 敵だと思って暴れちゃって…: Wha… you saved me? I'm sorry! I thought you were enemies and went wild…!
m950000.アイギス神殿近くの森ですよ。\n聖霊さん、そろそろ落ち着きましたか？: We're in the forest near the Aegis Temple. Holy Spirit, have you calmed down now?
m950000.大丈夫ですよ、どちらも怪我がなくて良かったです。\nそれで、いったい何があったの: It's okay, glad you're both unharmed. So, what actually happened?
m950000.当たり前ですよ！\n皆さんのことも記録しなくちゃ、\n王国史とは言えませんからね: Of course! If we don't record you all, it can't be called the kingdom's history!
m950000.慌てすぎてこっちに突っ込んできますよ！？: It's panicking so much it'll charge right at us!?
m950000.懐かしい思い出もあれば、\n辛かったことも、悲しかったことも、\nそれ以上に嬉し: There are nostalgic memories, painful times, sad moments, and even more joyful ones—so many.
m950000.戦い……？ って、わ、わー！\n王子、大変です！ 魔物の群れが！: Battle…? Wh-what! Prince, it's bad! A horde of monsters!
m950000.王国内で悪事を働くやつがいたら、\nそいつらを成敗するのも王国軍の役目だからな！:
If anyone commits crimes inside the kingdom, it's the army's job to punish them!
So just stay calm and get tied up!
m950000.王子、どうしますか――と、\n尋ねるまでもなさそうですね。\nそれでは聖霊さん、:
Prince, what will you do—well, it seems there's no need to ask.
Then, Holy Spirit, please guide the way!
m950000.王子、敵が来るぞ！\n聖霊を守りながらの戦闘だ、慎重な指揮を頼む！:
Prince, enemies are coming!
Fight while protecting the Holy Spirit; I need careful command!
m950000.王子と一緒に戦う中で、\nこれまで色々なことを経験しましたよね。: Fighting alongside the Prince, we've experienced all sorts of things, haven't we?
m950000.王子をって……そんなことさせませんよ！？: Capture the Prince… we won't let that happen!?
m950000.私は物語を通して、みんなに力を与えられるの。\nよーし、どこかに手頃な物語はっと:
Through the story, I can grant everyone power.
Alright, let's find a suitable tale somewhere…
m950000.護衛に付いてきて正解だったみたいだな。\n王子、皆に迎撃の指揮を頼むぞ！: Looks like it was right to have you on guard. Prince, take command of the interception for everyone!
